tei:div.tei:p: rtsom rig lha rtsal deb phreng 7 sku zhabs chab mdo shes rab lags ni 1 cu/ tsam ca du bod shar phyogs mdo khams chab mdo'i khul du shesno zhe sto 'khrungs zhing / lo ngo bcu gnyis skabs slob grar sgo sgo phebs kyang zla shes nas dgongs zhus kyis nor lug gi rdzi bor 'gro dgos byung 'dug de rjes chab dgon no byams pa gling du chos zhugs kyis bsdus gra dang /ba sum rtags/sgra gzhung /tshad ma/par phyin/dbya ma bar legs par gsan sbyangs mdzad/1 ji lor rgya gar du gros byol du yong skabs bal sa ta rta pa nir slebs mtshams ne+e pa li'i 〈snar srung bas 'dzin bzung gis slar rgyu mir rtsis sprod byas/ btsan byol du skusnang thengs gnyis pa 1073'o(ra bde ba〈snad zub nas gdan sa chen po dga' ldan du sgrig zhugs gnang / gzhis pha yul du snying rus cher skyed kyis slob gnyer byas pa'i lag 'khyer la byes kyi gdan sa'i rtsis med gnang stabs slar yang 'dzin rim dang po nas bgrod dgos byung bas gteri 'i sems pham dang sgyid lug gis slob gnyer rgyun chab mad shatra/ rab kyatra/ brtsamathe// mthud dka' ngal che tsam byung skad/nam rgyun khong pa'i dgongs par da lan bod kyi gnas stangs nyag phra'i skabs 'dir rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi srog rtsa skad yig rig gzhung 'di bzhin 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs su skul 'ded sku nga re mdzad nas 1777 lor tsa gangs ri'i zhol gyi brda sbyod sum cu pa'i sbyi don thon mi'i snying thig dang de'i mtha' dpyod thon mi'i 'dzum zer ri bam̐
'basku ring rlo rdzongal 'bab /sa ༄ /chab mdo shes rab kyis brtsams/mi3lo cas(/ 2gonayis lha'i/phyag ( /rtsom rig sgyu rtsal deb phreng 7

da//ཿsi 66bka 1 bod ni mi rigs kyi 'byung khungs yin pa/ 52 ngo da ni skad yig gi 'byung khungs yin pa/ 83 ro/da ni grags can spyi rgyal khab snga ba'i nang gi snga ba zhig yin pa/ 11 4 bod ni chos lugs kyi 'byung khungs yin pa/ 165 bod ni snyan ngag gi grong khyer 'ig yin pa/ 196 'dzam gling 'i bde 'i thabs lam nyag gcig 247 chab srid dang chodas lugs bar gyi 'brel ba/ 288 sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis chab srid ji ltar bsgyangs pa yin nam/ 319 pha yul gyi gnyen ston/ 3410 phyi dun byathag khag gnyis// 4411 pha yul gyi chodags pa 'ig phyir dran byas pa 'i 'char snang / 4812 'brog phrug gi 'tsho ba/ 5213 bral mo sgang gi sman pa/ 531 lho nyes ming la mi sgrag pa'i pho bod/snying rje skye 'os pa'i lkug pa/ 571〉 ja sngag bad gyi gtam gyur/le'u dang po/ 60le'u gcis pa / 67

16 sgro glu ring mo/ 7717 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab/ 9018 ka bshad the hrug ma/ 10219 gangs 'dabs kyi las dbang / 10820 dkar nag zhan 'byed / 11121 de tsho 'brog pa'i pha skad red/ 114 22 nga yi lung pa'i thun min khyad chos/ 11723 drang bden la bstod pa bcos min sgrin gyi rol mo/ 11924 byed la sdang zug byed phod dam/ 12425 dmangs gtso ni dngos po'i gnas tshod dang ran/ 12626 gna' deng zung 'brel gyis 'jig rten chags 'jig la bltas pa/ 12927 mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/le'u dang po/ pha ma thi zhing khral 'ul rgyug pa/ 134le'u gnyis pa/ chibs dpon gyi rngan pa reg cing khyim gyi nor phyugs sgor ba/ 140le'u gsum pa/ gasku1ga glas rgyug cing gcan gzan gyis gtses pa/ 145le'u bzhi pa/ rgya mi ma31nga zhing dmyal ba'ang maswā nga ba/ 15028 rgyang ring gi pho brang dmar po/ 16029 la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi 〈snas mo la 166

ngo da ni mi rigs kyi 'byung khungs yin pa/deng sang tshan rig pa sa mi ni spra sprel dag rim gyis spu dang mjug ma byil ba las gyur par 'dod la de las yar 'ded na rgya mtsho'i nang gi sel rdul la thug par bshad pa des/ bod kyi mi risas 'di spra rgyud 'phel ba las byung bar d+ku tshos sngar nas bshad zin pa de nyid bsregs bcad bad ra ba'i gser ba'in yid ches dang rin thang che ru song yod/mi ni spra rgyud las chad pa'i ri ga pa 'i gzhu'i lugs de thog mar bod nas byung ba ltar spra rigs mi la gyur pa 'i mi ri 'gro ba yang thog mar bod nas byung bar ma ngon rte/ spra spre'u na mas ni ri brag sku da sa dang snag par 'bras ldan gyi nags tshal na mas su sdudad pa las rang dgar spang ljongs dang /bye thad /'khyag gling na mas su 'tsho stod mi thub cing /'dzam gling na nags tshal gyi thog ma ni bod na byung ste/ 'dzam gling 'dir gya mtsho dang 'khyag rom/ sa do ri drag gi nem pa can las rim gyis rtsi shing gi rigs skye ba'i 'go tshugs la snga sgos ni zhir 'dzam bu 'es pa de yin/thing de ni yal ga dang 'o/ mas khebs pa/ 'bras bus dud pa / myang na zhim pa/bltas na mdzes pa 'ig sku da pas 'jig rten 'dir ngo mtshar che bar mthong nas de 'i ming gi che ba dang ldan par gling 'di la'ang 'dzam bu gling zhes ming brtags/de 'du'i shing de'ang mtsho ma dros pa 'i 'gram na rkang gcig rang skyes pa min par bod kyi ༷ phyogs rdza yul nas yar klung gtsang po'i rgyud kyi lung lag thams ba da khyab nas sku da kyang 'dzam gling spyi sku ngas nas blta dus mtsho ma snga ga pa'i 'gram du skyes par bshad pa la 'gal ba ci yang med/ yang na de skabs yar klung gtsang po 'i rgyud kyi nags tshal de rdza yul nas nub ka zhi smir bar sbrel nas yod kyang phyis hi ma la yi ri rgyud 'di 'bur du don pa nas stod khul du sa gshis la 'gyur

6 'bras/ ring chu bo dal 'bab//ba thebs te rtsi zhing skye ba'i nus pa nyams par gyur/ nga tshe'i mes po spu rigs de da ga 'tsho sdod bya yul gyi nags tshal ni de dag yin la bya dang ri dwags kyang mang por yod pas nags ma bya tshogs can zhes kyang zer/ nags tshal der spra khyu mang du 'phe la ba las 'tsho ba'i thog dka' ngal 'phrad de spu khyu 'ga' re nye 'khod gyi thang du 'ong nas sa 'og gi rtsa sdum bsko ba dang ri dwags zhi ba sogs/ kyi zha yang za dgos byung / de 'dra'i dka' sdug gi kyag kyog mang po'i khrod du nang sems kyi steng la nyams myong dang na ma dpyod che ru phyin pas lo tog spo 'dzugs kyi gsog 'jog shes par gyur pa dang / phyi lus kyi bkod pa'ang mi'i gzugs su 'gyur 'go tshugs/ de ni/ ma rmos 'bru za gos su zhing lo gyon/ /nags su ri dwags lta bur gnas pa yi/ /glo dang mi rgod lta bus bod yul gang / /zhes dang / mdzod las kyang / de nas rim bzhin ro la chags/ /le 'o sa gasku ga 'jog byas na sa ni/ /'dzin bcas na mas kyis 'ing dpon bsgos/ /'es pa ltar gnas pa'i dus skabs de 'i yan man zhig nas da ni ma 'ongs par 'tsho ba'i mdun lam thag gcod byed par yangs shing rgya che la phu na sum tshogs pa 'i yul ljongs zhig la brten dgos pa si mthong nas /ka khol ma las bshad pa ltar spra mi mang po zhig tshan pa tshan pa byas te mtho sgang 'di dang kha gyes nas shar lto nub byang gang sar mdun skyod byed ba'ig sa bab 'a phrod la thon khungs 'bel po yod pa 'i lung pa dang thug dus der 'tsho sdod byas/ der rang gi khor yug dang kha zas sogs kyi khyad par las kha dog gi cha nas skra na mas ser po gyur pa ma zad sha'i mdog kyang ser 'am yod pa'i rigs gcig dang / skra na mas gnag la 'dzings pa ma zad lus kyi mdog kyang nag po yin pa 'i rigs gcig dang / dbyibs kyi cha nas sna'i gzing mtho ba'am sna ldong ba'i rigs gcig dang / yang sna ljong pa'i ldog phyogs nyag pa'am stong pa'i rigs gcig ste rtsa ba'i rigs che ba ba'i byung bar phyis su (gnod sbyin nag pos bod la dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs tsam la ) mi na mas kyis de dag la se rmu ldong stong 'es pa'i rus ming re brtags pa ste dang po se ni yo rob kyi mi rigs lta bu dang gnyis pa rnu ni a pi ri ba'i mi risas lnga bu dang / gsum pa

bod ni mi rigs kyi 'byung khungs yin pa/ 7ldong ni rgya gar gyi mi ri sas lta bu dang / bzhi pa stong ni bod dang sog po rgya nag pa lta bu yin par sems/'dzam gling na nags tshal gyi jo ga ma 〈snad na byung bar bshad pa ni nang pa'i gsung rab na mas su zhing gi jo ga ma 'dzam bu zhes pa de mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram na sku da par bshad pa la gzhi bcol ba zhig yin pod/ spyir gnad don 'di'i thog nang pa'i bshad pa dang bod kyi bshad pa gnyis mi mthun te/ nang pa'i mdo sde na mas su bshad pa ltar na/ 'dzam gling 'dir thog mar sems can su yang med par gtsang zhing yid du co nga ba 'ig yin pas steng sdu gas nas lha kha shas shig mad babs nas rtsen zhing gnas pa las masturngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul na mas rim gyis nyams te mir gyur pa 'dod la/ nga tsho bod kyi bshad srol 'di ni tshan rig dang mthun par gna' bo'i dud 'gro'i rigs kyi spra rgyud ded nas rim gyis yar rgyas kyi na ma pa'i thog nas da lta'i na ma skusad can gyi mi yi 'gro ba 'di byung bar 'dod do//1667 45

bod ni skad yig gi 'byung khungs yin pa /de yang sum cu par/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / /rig byed smra ba na mas kyi rgyu/ /ming chig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /'es pa ltar shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag gi sngon du 'gro ba ni yi ge'i rig pa'am sbyor ba de yin la/ de yang gang la mi'i 'gro ba byung snga sgos yin pa de la skad yig rig gzhung sogs kyang sngar dar ba ni 'os zhing 'tsham pa yin pa'i phyir ro//nga tsho bod kyi yi ge 'di ni 'grel bshad mkhan po so sos laspru sogs yig rigs du ma jig bgrang nas 'di la ma phyi byas so 'di la ma phyi byas sku 'es bshad mod/ gyu mtshan ni de dag gi khrod na yi ge kha shas bon kyi yi ge dang 'dra ngo sku da pa la bsam pa las gzhan pa'i rigs pa yang dag cig bkod pa ma mthong la/ dus rabs bdun pa'i gong na yar klung tsho pa rang la thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge zhig med shas che yang spyir stod mis bkol spyod byed pa 'i yig rigs gcig kyang med pa la risas pa'i 〈sna du ma zhig nas gnod pa 'bab cing /bod kyi yig gzugs dang 'dra ba tsam yang phan tshun su 'ig ma phyi byas nas byung bar sgod dka' ba ma zad/'dzam gling na snga sgos su 'dod pa'i nyin ju'i yi ge yang bod kyi yi ge la ma pyi byas nas bakhros pa ma yin zhes sus kyang kha tshon gcod par dka' ste/ nyid dhu pas bod ni dbang phyug gi 'ing kham sa su khas len cing byed po nyer bzhi'i nang nas dbang phyug ni yi ge'i byed por khas len pas bod kyis bzos pa'i yi ge la dbang phyug gis bzos pa 'es bzhad srid de/ rgya gar du chu bo grags can gaṅgā zer ba bod nas babs pa yang dbang phyug gi ral pa nas babs pad bshad pa 'i phyid ro/ /da dung nyin dhu pas rang byung gi rtag pa 'dod pa'i rig byed kyi bstan bcos na mas su'ang ches gna' bo'i bod kyi bshad sgros min nam

bod ni skad yig gi 'byung khungs yin pa / 9snyam pa mang po zhig sku da pa de dag kyang rang byung gi bar snang nas byung ba zhig min par dbang phyug gi zhing khams nas byung ba zhig yin dbosgos kyang thams cad 'di ra bshad pas mi lang ngo / /der brten rgya gar gyi yi ge'ang rtsa ba'i bod kyi yi ge la brten nas rgya gar rang gi skad kyi gdangs dang mthun par gtan la phab ste rim gyis 'phel rgyas byung ba 'ig yin zhes khas blangs kyang / ro da de rgyal phran bcu gnyis dang sil ma ba'i cu tsam rgyas nas skad yig de ba'in 'phel rgyas 'gro bar 'gog rkyen mi nyung ba 'ig 'phrad ba'in yod pa'i skabs su rgya gar na rigs mtho ba na mas kyis sgra rig par do snang ha cang chen po byed srol byung ba ma zad/ sgra'i bsngan bcos kyang mang por byung nas rgya gar gyi skad yig de ba'in phun sum tshogs pa'i rtse mor slebs yod pas phyis bod kyi yi ge de bzhin ches 'thus sgo tshang la nang chos bsgyud nus pa'i don snying lngan pa jig tu 'phel rgyas gtong bar da ni rgya yi ga las legs cha tshur len dgos par chags mi srid pa rtsa ba nas min/na nga pa dang ye shu sogs kyi chos lugs rgya cher dar yang nang pa'i yi ge dang ye shu'i yi ge 'es thun mong ma yin pa zhig med pa ltar bon gyi chos lugs dar na bon gyi yi ge yod da gos pa 'i sgrub byed kyang med la/ gal te gang na dar ba'i yul der yi ge 'ig nges par yod dgos snam na 'ang / yi ge med kyang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos lugs kyi bag chags gting zab lngan pa'i mi rigs dang tsho pa de 'du de'i sang yang mthong ba'i phyir/bon po de 'ang zhung na dar bas zhang zhung gi yi ge zhig kyang yod dgos pa'i khyab pa ma nges so/ /'o na khyod kyis bshad pa'i gna' bo'i bod yig de gang yin snyam na/ de ni ches gdod ma'i skabs su bod mi rnams kyis phyi dun gyi rtags rdo dang shing la/ ri mor btab pa nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba'i yig rgas mar yig ces pa de yin/ yig rgas zhes pa ni ches ya thog gi yi ge yin pas na yig rgas dang / mar yig ces pa ni bzang yig gam bzang yul gyi yi ge 'es pa'i don yin la/de yang lo grangs 'ib par brjod par dka' yang gnya' khri nas kyang rtsis pa'i ches ya thog gi dus su bod 'dir srong btsan gyi skabs ltar

10 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab cig byung zhing rgyal po'i ming la gnod spyin nag po dang / yul gyi ming la bzang yul 'es 'bod pa las bod ces pa'i tha snyad ma byung / des na bzang yul gyi yi ge la bzang yig ces 'bod srid de/ bod yul gyi yi ge la bod yig ces 'bod pa bzhin no/ /yang na mar yig ces pa'i rma 'di a myes rma chen/ rma chu leb mo/ rma yul dar thang zhes bod yul stod smad kun tu gna' na sa da bar grags che ba'i yul lung 'di'i ming sna'i rma zhes pa 'di dang yang 'brel ba zhig med dam snyam/ dus phyis srong btsan gyi skabs su de nyid gtso bor legs sbyar gyi nang chos de da ga bsgyur zhus thabs kyis bcos sgrig mang tsam byas nas de nyid lag len bsngar ba nas bzung bod dbus phyogs su mar yig gi bed spyod de tsam med par gyur/ 'on kyang bon gyi gsung rab phal che ba mar yig tu lus yod cing de nyid zhang zhung gi yul du yun ring tsam 'tsho gnas thub yod pas mi tshos de la zhang zhung yig rgas dang / zhang zhung mar yig ces 'bod pa las/ mar yig de nyid thog mar 'ang zhung rang nas byung ba'i sgrub byed yang dag cig su la'ang bshad rgyu med do snyam//1667 7

21da ni grags can gyi rgya'/ khab snga ba'i nang gi snga ba zhig 6sen pa/de yang bod kyi lo rgyus deb zer na mas su gsal ba lngar na/ bod kyi yul 'di ches snga bo'i dus su mi ma yin rnams kyis dbang sgyur bya yul lam gan sa yul zhig yin par bshad/de ni ya thog gi skabs su bod yul 'dir 'dzam gling na skad grags che la 'jigs skrag che ba'i rgyal thog 'ga' byung yod pa ste/ gnod sbyin nag po/ bdud po re ti mgo yag srin po nyang rangs khrag mig grog krog 'dre'i rgyal po zer ba sogs rgyal rabs mang po zhig gi ri nga chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs gang ci srong btsan gyi skabs ltar dar rgyas ha cang che la lhag par dmag don gyi thad zil thugs che bas sus kyang 'thab pa'i ya bor ma 'pher te thams cad dngangs zhing sgrag nas gnod sbyin dang / bdud dang / srin po sogs su bos te gzhi nas mi ma yin du gyur pa mngon/ tshan rig pa kha shas kyis gnod spyin nag po ni tsho pa chung chung zhig gi dpon po 'dra zhes bshad pa ni mi bden te/ de ltar na gnod spyin ni rgya gar bas mi'i tshad las brgal ba'i stobs thugs can zhig tu brtsi dgos don med/dper na/lha'i gdon zha mas dang /nas/gnod sbyin gyi gdon zha mas dang /'es dang /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad na mas dang / /zhes pa ltar gyi bang 'ig bsgrigs nas 'jig rten na stobs che thos ni lha dang / de nas klu/ de nas gnod sbyin bzhag gi yod la de 'du'i gnod sbyin de ni ga'an su yang min par bod kho na yin te/ gnod sbyin ni byang phyogs su yod pa ra bshad la de yang rgya gar nas rtsis pa dang / gnod sbyin phyogs ni byang phyogs kyi mngon brjod kyang yin pa red/ gnod sbyin de dag la sgo phyusas

12 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//gnag lug mang ngo sku1da par ma〈snang nas cesar lha yin pa ra bsams te mtshams re rgya gar bas gnod sbyin ni nor lha'i gral du'ang bzhag myong sku da pa da nga / khyad mtshar ba zhig la rgya gad bas gnam gyi dgu tshigs ni gnod sbyin gyi kha rlangs red ces zer/ grang ngar gyi nang du kha rlangs ni da gu tshigs kyi mdog ltar gyur gyi yod pas bod sa mkhro'i grang ngar gyi nang nas sanod sbyin mang pos dus gcig tu kha rlangs btang ba dgu tshigs su 'gyur gyi yod pa re da bas/mas nas gnod sbyin gyi stobs shugs la sgug snang byed kyi sku da pa red/ yang gnod sbyin lag na dbyug pa thogs/ /nor skyong gdo na gyi tshogs bcas te/ /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod nge phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes nor skyong ste rdzi bo'i skad du'ang 'bod la/mcho da pa dang bstod pa dang phyag 'tshal ba sogs byed do//gswā da spyin nag ro / 'es pa ni sbra nag po'i nang bsngad pas sam/ lnga ma nag gi pags pa'i nga kho gyon pa'am de skabs re lde'i gos kyang gyon srol yod pas nag po'i sgra sbyar ba yin gyi/ bod kyi sa las brgal te song na gnod spyin gyi grib ma tsam yang rnyed mi thub/da dung sana' bo'i bod la rta ha cang 'brel po yod cing dmag dpung thams cad ling der rta dmag yin pa dang / de bzhin gna' bo'i rgya nag pas thon skyed gtso bo glang la brten gyi yod pa dang rgya gar lho phyogs su ma he la brten gyi sku da pa sa/ bdag cag gi ston nga/sa kyang / shar phyogs bgya sbyin glang la chibs/ /ldo phyogs gzhin rje ma he chibs/ /byang phyogs ga dod sbyin rta la chibs/ /'es kyang gsungs yod/ gnod spyin nag po 'es pa ni ming 'dog las cos/ med pas ming dngokun ni nem thos lta bu yin chog la/ de'i bu la zha ma thos kyi bu dar rnam thos kyi sras zhes bshad dam snyam ste/ nem khros kyi bu ni gnod sbyin gyi dpon nam rgyal po yin par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyal ce rdzong khongs gi gnod sbyin gang bzang zhes pa'i gangs ri ma tho tshad pi kri 714༷ lhag yod pa de gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad kyi nang nas gnod spyin gang bzang yin kyang zer yod/ skabs der rgyal sa gangs ri de'i 'ol zhig tu sku da dam snyam snge ri de'i ming gis/ byas pa'i gnod sbyin dad / gang bzang rgi bzang gis bad sa dungs nas ji

bod ni grags can gyi rgyal khab snga ba'i nang gi snga ba zhig yin pa / 13tsam khyab pa'i mnga' kho ngas la bzang yul zhes 〈snags sam snyam ste de dag ni dpyad par bya ba'i gnas yin no//da ni gnod spyin nag po'i rgyal rgyud kyi srid dbang ring mthar ji tsam gnas yod med sgod par dka' yang nyung mthar lo ngo brgya phrag kha shas gnas par dpog thub ste/ yud tsam zhig gis gnod sbyin zhes ha cang skad grags chen po de lta bur 'byung ba dka' ba'i phyir ro//gnod spyin nag po'i rgyal rgyud kyi srid dbang nyams nas ring zhig lon pa na slar yang 'dzam gling na de las kyang skad grags che ba'i rgyal khab cig byung bar rgyal po'i ming la re ti mgo yag dang /sras mo'i ming la dri ldan ma zhes zer/rgyal po de la lhag par mtshon cha chu gri dang /mdung ring / dgra snga/ tho ril/ sta re yu ring sogs thogs pa'i dmag gi dpyang chen po lus la re lde'i gos dang / mgo dang mtshon cha'i sked par bal dang rnga ma la tsag byugs pas brgyan pas rngam zil che la dmar zing nge ba zhig yod de/ deng sang yang rgya dkar nag sogs kyis bdu da kyi ltad mo 'khrab dus gyon pa nag po/ dgra sta thogs pa dmar zing nge ba zhig byed kyi yod pa ni sngar bod kyi bdud dmag de dag gi cha lugs la'ang sgrag thag chod pa'i bag chags kyi lhag ma da dung lus pa zhig red/ yang na re ti mgo yag ni dang thog gnod sbyin nag po 'i mnga' khongs kyi tsho pa zhig gam blon po zhig yin la rang gi rgyal po la ngo 'o ga brgyab nas sras mo dri ldan ma'i dpung gis yang yang dmag 'khrug bslangs pa la brten nas srid dbang thob pa zhig yin nam yang snyam ste/ 'di'i sras mo dang gnod sbyin kyi rgyal po gnyis dmag 'khrug byas pa'i lo rgyus zhig kyang yod 'dug pa'i phyir ro// ('di dag dmag 'khrug byas pa'i gtam rgyud rig byed kyi sgrang 'dra po zhig bla ma 'ga'i zhal las thos myong yang mthong ma myong / gal srid de 'dra zhi/ mthong na bod kyi gna' bo'i lo rgyus la dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs cher ldan yod par the tshom med/) gang ltar 'dzam gling 'di'i thog sto 'dul byang 'thab kyi dmag 'khrug thams cad nang sus kyang 'gran zla med pas kun gyis rbad de bdud du rtsis nas 'thab pa'i re ba lta bzhag ming tsam thos pas sgrag snang byed

26 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//gzugs kyi go la 'di la chag grum shor nges yin/ der brten thabs lam 'di ni nges par du lag len bstar dgos pa zhig dang bstar na don che ba zhig kyang yin/rgyal khab gang zhig rang nyid 'dzam gling na mchog tu gyur par 'gran rtsod pa rnams kyis srid dbang rgya skyed gtong bar dug po'i dpung sde 'du min rtsa 'dzugs dang / 'bar mdel dang 'phur mdel sogs gtor tshabs che ba'i dug po'i mtshon cha bzo skrun byas pa na/de las gzhan pa dag gis kyang rang nyid srung skyob kyi ched du dmag dpung rgya skyed dang /go mtshon bzo skrun ma byas thabs med du gyur nas 'jig rten thog gi thob thang yod tshad dmag don gyi dbang sgyur 'og tshud de ches dza dug dang dngangs skrag can gyi dus rabs 'di byung ba red/ nga tshos dmag 'khrug sngon 'gog dang zhi bde srung skyob dgos na/ mig snga'i 'dzam gling 'di'i steng gi rdzas sbyor dul phran gyi mtshon cha/ nad 'bu phra rabs kyi mtshon cha/sa 'og 'bar mdel/ gnam la 'phur mdel sogs che rim nas med pa bzo rgyu dang /lhag par mkha' dmag gi dpung sde mtha' dag med par bzo rgyu ni gal che kha tsha dgos gtug gi gnad don zhig yin/des na mtshon chabazo skrun dang bdag nyar thub pa'i nus pa'i 'byung khungs dang /dmag sde dpung chen gso skyong thub pa'i nus pa'i 'byung khungs gang yin shes tshor thub pa byas nas sdong po nyid dang po nas rtsa bcad gtong ba tshegs chung la do na che ba yin gyi/sdong po rang sor bzhag nas phyogs gcig gi yal ga rnams bcad kyang phyogs gzhan pa rnams lus rgyu yin pa dang / phyogs gzhan de bcad dus phyogs gcig nas slar skye rgyu yin pa ni gdon mi za ba zhig red/mdor na/ rgyal tshogs sam rgyal spyi'i ngos nas tshad ldan rang sgya 'phel ba'i mnyam 'brel sde tshan zhig rtsa 'dzugs kyis 'dzam gling rgyal khab che ba zhig la cha mtshon na/ dmag don dang mi 'bor/ sa bab dang goms srol/ mi rigs dang rig gzhung sogs la gzhigs nas gang la gang 'tsham gyis ha lam mnga' sde re rgyal khab re la cha bgos byed dgos/

'dzam gling zhi bde'i thabs lam nyag gcig 27de yang phyi tshul tsam min par don da maXs ngang btsan gyi khe dbang cha tshang sku da dgos/de bzhin rgyal khab che rim nas gang la gang 'os kyis sil bur bzo dgos/ de yang 'jig rten thog gi drag thugs kyi zhus pa de dag gtor thub pa'i ched du yin dgos//1667 11

chab srid dang chos lugs bar gyi 'brel ba/rang cag rkang gnyis pa zha mas dud 'gro'i gzugs dbyibs can gyi brgyud rim las mi'i spyi tshogs su gyur pa nas bzung / chab srid dang chos lugs gnyis ni dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang nam yang kha bral du med par gnas yod/ rtsa ba'i srid lugs dang chos lugs gang 'dra zhig yin min la ma ltos par 'gro ba mi zhig gi dgos mkho dang 'tsham par 'phel rgyas byung ba ni gcig pa red/chab srid ces pa ni chab 'bangs rnams srid pa 'i phun tshogs sam srid pa'i bde ba 'ig la 'god par byed pa 'i thabs lam zhig ste/ dmigs yul ltar lag len tshul bzhin bstar ba la chab srid tshul bzhin bskyangs pa zhes zer/ srid lugs zhes brjod tshe srid pa ni 'khor ba ste/ de yang dgra grogs bstod smad sogs las dga' sdug chags sdang 'os shing 'tsham pa re rang bzhin gyis skye ba dang / rang rang la stobs 'byor snyan grags sogs kyi che mthong 'ig dgos pa ni gzhi rim gyi 'jig rten srid lugs yin la/de'i steng chab srid kyi byed sgo khag srung skyob byed pa'i ched du gsar du gtan la phab pa'i na ma gzhag gam srid lugs kyang yo da/chos lugs zhes pa ni srid pa'i phun tshogs la rgyab kyis phyogs thing / dgra grogs bstod smad sogs las nye ring byams sngang sogs kyi blo skye ba ni tshul bzhin min pa yid la byed pa las byung zhing 'ching ba'i bdag nyid du gnas pas na/ de dag bzlog pa 'i don du chos na mas kyi gzhi'i gnas lugs gtan la phab pa'i slo nas dge sdig blang dor/ bden bzhi/ lam lnga sogs thar par bgrod pa'i na ma gzhag cha tshang ba yod pa'i lam lugs zhig gam ring lugs thig ste/ de yang nang pa 'i chos kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/de min tshe 'di'i 'khrig spyod kyi bde ba tsam gyi ched du byung ba'i chos lugs

chab srid dang chos lugs bar gyi 'brel ba/ 29kyang snang ba'i phyir ro//spyir chab srid dar spel gtong ba dang /chos lugs dar spel gtong ba gnyis rtsa ba'i rgya skyed kyi bsam blo'i ma lag gcig las byung bas byed las kyi cha nas mi 'du ba med mod/ dmigs yul gyi cha nas phyi ma 'di chab srid kyi khongs su gtogs med/gal te yul der cho sa lugs de spel ba'i dgos pa ni chos lugs de'i rtsa ba'i bsgrub bya gang yin pa de yul de'i 'gro ba rnams la mngon du 'gyur thabs kho na yin dgos pa las/chos srel mkhan gyi mi rigs sger dang / rgyal khab sger/ gang zag sger gyi khe phan gyi ched du dmigs pa jig yin na/de ni chos kyi dar rtags khyer nas chab srid kyi las ka byas pa zhig las/ chos kyi sdu tsam yang med pa ma zad chos spong gi las su 'gyur ba yin/ chab srid dang chos lugs gnyis ni sems kyi nang du khang pa'i mdo lhug tsam zhig yin pas de gnyis ni spyi tshogs khrod yun ring 'dris gzhib byas nas byung ba zhig yin la/ skabs 'gar chab srid kyis chos lugs dar spel btang yod pa ma zad chos lugs kyis chab srid la zhabs 'degs kyang mi lu nga ba zhus yod/ skabs 'gar de las ldog ste chab srid kyis chos lugs la ya nga snying rje med par drag gnon byas yod la chos lugs kyis chab srid phung ba byas pa'ang nyung nyung zhig gtan nas min/ rtsa ba'i 'dzam gling 'dir yo 'khrug gang zhig byung ba yang sems kyis byas pa zhig yin pa las 'a〈sna ba mi rnams ni sems med kyi rang bzhin zhig yin na/ spo bo'i yul gyi nags tshal ltar gzhib ste gnas pa las phan tshun 'khon 'khrug spu tsam yang yong don med/ sems ni gzugs can gyis gnod par mi zhus pa'i rang bzhin yin pas drag shugs dang 'jigs skul gyis 'dul bar mi sla zhing / chab srid dang chos lugs kyi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun zhig la brten nas sems kyi kha phyogs la 'gyur ba gtong dgos pa yin/chab srid bed spyad nas chos lugs kyi khe phan bsgrubs pa ni nyung tsam yin cing /chos lugs bed spyad nas chab srid kyi khe phan bsgrubs pa ni ha cang mang / gang yin zer na/chab srid kyi 'gal ba ni srid don mi sna'i dbar gyi 'gal ba zhig yin la/ chos lugs dang

30 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//mi rigs dbar gyi 'gal ba ni thun mong du khyab thub pa jig yin pas snga ma las gzhi rgya che bar gyur/ der brten srid don mi snas chab srid kyi 'gal zla de chos lugs dang /mi rigs/rigs rus sogs su kha phyogs bsgyur nas rang gi khe phan bsgrubs pa'i lo rgyus kyi zin tho ni rgyal rabs deb ther khag gi sgrom gzhi zhig tu gyur/ chos lugs kyi rang bzhin ni gser ltar dag la mnyen lhug ldan pa zhig kyang yin pas/ srid lnga na pa'i mgar ba na mas kyis ① ba srid kyi rgyan cha ci yang bdung thub kyi yod/ char pa ni rlung la brten nas 'gro skyod byed pa bzhin/ chos lugs ni chab srid sim 'dzul byed sa'i sgo mo yangs sgos zhig red/ri bo ni nyi 'od phog sa'i thog ma de yin pa bzhin/ chos lugs ni chab srid kyi shugs rkyen phog sa'i thog ma de'ang yin srid/chos lugs mi 'du ba zha mas ni mi na mas kyi khams dang mos pa mi 'dra ba la brten nas byung ba 'ig yin mod/ chos lugs grub mtha' gcig nyid kyang khag du mas gyes nas yod pa ni chab srid kyi gnas sngangs dang 'brel ba dam zab yod par gor ma chu ga nga tsho bod la chos brgyud mi 'dra ba mang po zhig byung ba ni bar skabs bod kyi chab srid sil bur gyur pa dang 'brel ba nges can zhig yod de/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po nas bod sil bur ma 'thor bar chos brgyud mi 'dra ba ma byung la/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang pa'i 'og tu'ang chos brgyud gsar pa zhig byung med/ sngar rgya gar du bye smra la sde pa bco brgyad du gyes pa'ang shar nub kyi sde pa dang / nyi 'og pa/ yul dbus pa/ kha che bye drag smra ba 'es sogs ming 'dogs stangs la bltas na/ skabs der rgya gar nang rgyal phran sil ma mang por byung ba dang 'brel ba yod par mthong thub/thog ma'i chos brgyud gcig pa yin kyang yul so sor gnas zhing chos srid gang gi yang 'brel ba med nas yun ring gyur pa na/ chos kyi lta grub dang byed sgo'i lugs srol so sor gyur nas rim pas 'phel rgyas zer na'ang 'du/ sil bur zer na'ang 'du/ gang ltar phyogs gnyis su 'gyur gyi yod la/ de'i mjug 'bras ni nam thig phan tshun ris su bcad pa'i rtsod rnyog 'thol pa zhig 'byung gi yod pa de red//

sgrung lde'u nge na gsum gyis chab srid ji ltar ba//juratraṭa pa shusgon na3//de yang gna' ba'i bod kyi chab srid sgrung lnge'u ston gsum gyis bskyangs 'es yongs su grags mod/ de gsum gyi ngo bo gsal po 'ig brjod pa ma byung zhing / 'ga' zhig gis ngos bzung ba'i don des kyang chab srid bskyangs tshul len po 'ig 'grel bshad byed thub kyi med/dro nga btsan sgam po'i bar gya la rabs sum cu so gsum gyi ring bod kyi chab srid de gsum gyis bsgyangs pa dang / 'ga' jig nas lnga tho tho ri'i bar rgyal da bas nyi shu rtsa drug bar 'es bshad kyang 'du/ gang lta ra tshig gi nus pas de yan chad du bod kyi chab srid de gsum gyis bskyangs kyang / de nas bzung bod kyi chab srid de chos kyis bskyangs pa'i chos rgyal rim par gyon pa las bod de chos lngan gyi zhing khams zhig tu gyur pa'i don du snang bas/de gsum char nang chodas kyi 'gal zla zhig tu ngos 'dzin byas par gsal po mthong thub/ srong btsan yan chad du bon gyis bskyangs kyang de'i man du cho sa kyis bskyangs pa red ces bshad na chog mod/ sgrung 'es pa 'o/ rgyus kyi sgrung dang / lnge'u 'es pa gab tshig la bshad nas srong btsan yar sngon du lo rgyus kyi sgrung dang gab tshig gis chab srid ji ltar bskyangs tshul dang /de nas bzung de gnyis kyi chab srid bskyangs pa'i zhus pa ji ltar nyams pa sus kyang gsal bsgod byas med/ de ni bod kyi gna' bo'i chab srid de gtam rgyud dang gab tshig gis bsgyangs pa'i dpe mtshon gsal 〈sna zhig brnyed kyi med la/ gal te sku da dbang du btang yang nang chos dar ba'i 'og tu de gnyis la dung rdeg phog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig mthong thub kyi med pa'i rkyen gyis red/

32 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//spyir sgrung dang lde'u zhes pa gtam rgyud dang gab tshig la go ba'i skabs yod du chug kyang /skabs 'di'i de gsum ni nang chos kyi ldog zlar gyur pa'i gna' bo'i chos lugs rnam pa mi 'du ba khag gsum yin cing / 'di gsum gyi rim pa'ang deb ther rnams su mi mthun yang / lde'u chos 'byung ltar na/ dang po sgrung zhes pa'i chos lugs kyis chab srid bskyangs pa dang / de'i 'og tu lde'u zhes pa'i chos lugs dang / de'i 'og tu bon zhes pa'i chos lugs dang / de nas nang pa'i chos lugs kyis bsgyangs pa yin la/ chos lugs gang zhig gis chab srid de bskyangs pa'i go don ni/ khrims lugs kyi gtsos pa'i chab srid kyi byed sgo khag chos lugs de la gzhi bcol nas byas pa'i don yin gyi/ chab srid kyi khrod bed spyod btang ba tsam gyis chab srid bskyangs par 'gyur na/ sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyi grangs 'dren ni ha cang nyung ba'i skyon du gyur pa shes thub/ ches gna' ba'i dus kyi gdod mi'i chos lugs ni mi'i spyi tshogs khrod du rang byung khams la gsol mchod byed pa'i lugs srol tsam zhig yin gyi/ de las lhag pa'i chos byed kyi mi sna dang / zab cho sa dang sgog chos/ gzhi lam gyi na ma gzhag zur pa ci yang med/ de'i phyir de la sgrung zhes bshad chog ste/ sgrung zhes pa 'das pa'i lo rgyus dang lugs srol la go ba ni de dag bshad pa na sgrung bshad ces grags pa'i phyi ra ro/ /lde'u zhes pa'ang don gang zhig gab nas te sbas nas ston pa'i gab tshig tsam zhig min par/ sbas don lkog gyur gyi ri ma pa zha ji / lha 'dre'i 'phrul gyis sam gab rtse'i brtag thabs 'du min gyis gsal bar byed pa'i cho ga gam chos lugs shig yin la/de 'dra de ni bon chos kyi 'byung khungs yin par thu bkwan pas bshad/ bon 'es pa ni gna' srol tsam dang chosgo ga tsam zhig min pas ga'i lam gyi na ma gzhag cha tshang ldan 'ing / theg pa rim dgu can gyi yongs grags kyi bon 'es pa'i da lta'i chos brgyud 'di yin pa ra snyam/spyir 'gal zla can gyi chos lugs dang /mi rigs/sgog khag gang 'du zhig yin yang yun ring gyur pa na 'ga' zhig rim pas yal 'gro ba'am/ yang na phyogs gcig tu sdud 'gro gi yod pa ni 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi chos nyid cig tu gyur yod/ de'i phyir gna' bo'i

sgrung lde'u bon gsu ma gyis chab srid ji ltar bskyangs pa yin nam/ 33bod kyi chos lugs sgrung dang lde'u sogs rigs khag mi 'du ba ji tsam yod pa thams cad rim pas bon po'i nang du 'dzul zhugs byas yod pa ni bshad ma dgos/ mdor na 'dir bshad bya'i gtso bo ni/ gna' bo'i bod kyi chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs/ zhes pa'i bon po ma zad sgrung dang lde'u gnyis kyang chos lugs thig yin la/ de yang gna' ba'i mi na mas kyis rang byung khams la 'dzin pa'i lta tshul las byung ba gang zhig la/spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur dang mi'i dgos mkho dang 'tsham par 'thus sgo tshang du btang ba las na ma pa 'gyur ba'i gdod ma'i chos lugs khag gsum yin zhes pa de red//1767 12

pha yul gyi gnyen rnyedan/mig lam du ser che ma chem zhig gis gnyid lam gyi zhing khams ba༄sna brgyad de sil bur gtor/ ci yin nam/ phar bltas pas zhogs pa'i nyi ma las gser gyi skud pa dang 'du ba'i 'od zer mang po zhig nga'i mig la phog bzhin 'dug ma ga'i de ring grong pa 'i ston mo ma yin nam/ ma〈snags par yar langs te 〈sna la don pas/ 〈snang rogs lha gzi tshang gi phyogs bzhi la g.yu 'brug gnam la langs pa lta bu'i lha bsang re btang sku da pa dang /mna' ma la bsu chang khur mkhan dang / rten 'brel du lam bar chu josnam chus gang ba khur mkhan gyi chu ma dang / batherdzon sdu tshe( mas gang ba khur mkhan gyi bcasna ma skyes yag na mas rim gyis thon bzhin 'dugad dung sgo 'gram phyi nang tshang mar mi tshogs mang po 'dus shing gzab 'phyor gang zab byas pa'i stag zhar dang sman shar mang po zhig kyang 'dug pa ni de nyin gyi ston mo'i 'khrug cha slong mkhan gtso bo 'ga' yin pa ni smos ma dgos/ yud tsam zhig nas 'khor gsum dug tsher dang 'dra ba'i rta ba bcu grangs shig thal 'tshub phyur re 'byor/ ya kho re dka' i thal mi dka' ma thal mi ru bde mo i red su mi 'dug gam mi ci bde mo red da nang dme lung nang nas me mda' khur ba'i skya ba gsum chu tshur rol la slebs byung / nga tsho mthong ba dang lam chen du ma yong bar srib lam brgyud de shar rgyag phar phyin song / de min su gcig mi 'dug span lung nang bsu chang khur mkhan tsho slebs byung / de nas nga tsho sngon la yong ba yin ’ ‘ da yag po byung khyod tsho nang la song nga 'thung sgog tre( tsi/ de dag su yin nam/ ma gzhi nas lang tsho dar la bab pa'i gzhon hūṃ ma zhig yin phyin rang yul du phan tshun brtse sems kyi mdud pa sgod mi thub pa'i dga' rogs

pha yul gyi gnyen ston/ 35zhig med pa ni ha lam mi srid/'on kyang mi che'i nang gi 'tsho ba'i thog gi gal che'i gnyen sgrig ni pha ma'i 'dod pos kyis thag gcod byed kyi ye da stabs/ las 'gros mdud pa thebs pa'i gzhon hūṃ gnyis kyi rang dbang dang / dam bca'/ brtse sems rnams la brtsi 'jog spu tsam yang ma thob par gyes bral gyi skyo gdung ni ci 'dra'i che ba zhig red ang /der brten pho gzhon mang po zhig gis tshul der rgol lan gzhan slog thabs med par lam bar nas 'drephag bcom gyis mi bsad khrag sbyor mang po thon gyi sku da pa ni lam 〈snal de'i nang g.yol thabs med pa zhig chags yod/ da nges kyi gzhon hūṃ ma 'di la'ang yul der pho gzhon skad grags can zhig dang 'brel ba dam zab yod skad thos nas/ nga tsho'i lung pa'i nang gi bu nga rgod zer ba bcu grangs zhig lam bar so lta byed du mngags pa de dag phyir 'khor ba zhig red/ de nas cang ma 'gor bar snyed slebs song /da ngo ma slebs song gra sgrig gyis zi mna' ma 'bab sar phying dkar gyi steng du gro yi g.yung drung bris/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su mda' dar btsugs/ gnye bo 'bab sar chur ba ya gcig dang / mar do gcig sha gzugs gcigaja 'khor gcig bcas brtsegs/ skabs der lha gzi tshang gi pha rgan dang / bu rgan pa/de min mi kha shas nas mgo'i sgra sgre ga rkang gi lham sgrerdzog bo sa kyi skad rag na mas legs par bsdams te ral gri skad la gzer nas 'dzing cor+shag ang sar byas nas bsdad/ de ni gzhan min par mna' ma khyim du yong skabs zhwa mo de gnye bo nas sgo'i them pa'i thad shar 'bud dgos kyi yod/ gal srid phyir phyogs pa yin na g.yang rnams bu mo'i nang 'gro rgyu yin pa dang / nang du phyogs tshe de las ldog te 'byung gi yod par bsams nas gnye bo nas drang po ma byas tshe/ dga' ston gyi rten 'brel de gri 'dzing gi g.yul 'khrug cig tu 'gyur gyi yod pa red/de nas slebs rim bzhin rta kha sne shan gyis mna' ma'i lag tu mda' dar bzung ba dang lhan/ der yod rnams la dgra lha kha dkar yin zer ba'i 'o ma dkar yol gang re drangs pa gnye ba nas srin mdzub kyis lan (gsum gtor nas /

36 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//mchod mchod mchod/rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo mchod/bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong phrag mchod/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogasayalho'i kha ba dkar poyanub kyi gangs dkar ti se byang gi gnyan chen thang lha shar gyi rma chen sgom ra ma rigs sum brgya drug cu rma 'khor stong dang lnga brgya mchod mchod mchod/pho lha dgra lha mo lha zas lha 'go ba'i lha lnga klung rta sde brgyad skyob pa'i lha dgu yul lha gzhi bdag tham sa cad ma chod/ phar 'gro gi skyel ma/tshur sku nga gi bsu ma/bu la dpa' rtsal/rta la bang kha/mtshon la rno ngar/mdor na kha 'dzin rgyab rten skyel ma rogs ram rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de 'o ma btung zhing phu dung gi nang nas dar dkar po zhig ston te sgo lung la bkon nas na re/nga gnye bo bsam 'grub dar rgyas zer rgyu de gar song sa la lo yag gar bsdad sa la g.yang chags/ bosnam gsum 〈snas na bkris/ chig gsum bshad na don 'grub/ ab ra chung yang rtsa bzhi/sbal pa chung yang klu rigs/spo tho chung yang ri rgyal gyi chags tshul zhig yin na/rten 'brel gyi rdzas la che chung dang bshad pa'i gtam la mang nyung med zer ba'i dpe ltar/thar gyi sgo chen 'di la bshad pa dang bstod pa mdor bsdus zhig brgyab na/ sgo shing lha zhing zhug pa red/bzo mi bi sgo ka ma red/sgo ru bzhi rgyal chen bzhi yis bslangs/ya them ser po gser las grub/ steng phyogs lha yi pho brang mtshon/ ma them dkar po dngul las grub/'og phyogs klu yi pho brang mtshon/ sgo glegs me long drug gzhib 'dis/ khams gsum 'khor ba rigs drug mtshon/ smad la nag po byug pa 'dis/ ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas rnams mtshon/ stod la dmar ser byug pa 'dis/ bde ba can sogs dag zhing mtshon/ yar phye rna 'ur gyis 'gro ba 'dis/ yar dag zhing la 'ur gyis 'a〈sna ba mtshon/ mar brgyab na khrig se tham pa 'dis/ mar ngan song gi skye sgo 'geg par mtshon/ sgo sbub chu srin kha chen 'dis/ khams gsum dbang du 'du bar mtshon/ kha nang nor bu bzung ba 'dis/ nor longs spyod sgo drung 'ong ba mtshon/ de la me tog brgyan pa 'dis/ rigs rgyud me tog bkrag par mtshon/ sgo zhwa sngon po nam mkha'i mdogadabu 'phang dgung las mtho bar mtshon/sgo lham dmar po byu ru'i mdogasnang dgra bo'i

pha yul gyi gnyen ston/ 37blosna snying rdzi bar mtshon/ lho lung lcags thag sil sil 'dis/ snyan grags 'brug la 'gran par mtshon/sgo mtha' lcags kyis zhan pa 'dis/de la 'phel 'grib med par mtshon/
