shas lam gyi sgo/ sems skyed theg pa chen pa'i sgo/ dbang lung rjes sa/na ri sngag/sa kyi slo/ sgo 'di 'dur byon dang bsam don 'grub/ sgo 'di 'drar byon dang bkris 'byung / bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun 〈sna bzhin/ /snyan grags chen khro nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis 'grub/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkris shog /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bzhin/ /sems can re ba slong mdzad pa'i// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkris re ga /ces zer nas mna' ma nang du khrid/ rgyab 'o1ga mi tshogs kyi dkyil nas/ ( kho re zhwa mo ga 'dus phud song yag po ltos a 2 'o yag po byas song drang po red kyi khyim du slebs nas rang rang bab bstun gyi gdan la 'khod/ skabs der khyim gyi phyag tu mcho da pa tshar du dngar ba 'bul bsham dang 'brel bla grwa bzhi sde zhig nas phyag tu mda' dar bsnams na gasku1ba tsam gasku1ba tsam gyis 'di skad snga //kye/ spro zhing bag phebs gnas kyi g.yang / /de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon/ /zhim mang ra 'dzoms pa zas kyi g.yang / de ring dro 'jam 'dzoms pa gos kyi g.yang / de ring — 'gro zhing myur mgyogs rta yi g.yang / de ring 'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin 'bri yi g.yang / de ring stobs chen khur theg khal ma'i g.yang /de ring skad bzang nor srung khyi yi g.yang /de ring brtan zhing brtul phod pha khu'i g.yang / de ring — mdzangs zhing gtong phod ma spu'i g.yang /de ring dpa' rtsal 'dzoms pa bu tsha'i g.yang / de ring gzugs mdzes yid 'ong bag ma'i g.yang / /de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//zhes tshig mtshams der slebs pa dang spyan mig mna' ma'i ༷ gas la gzigs tsam dang btsum tsam 'ga' byas rjes 'angethon pa'i sgra yang gsal la mi gsal zhig tu gyur/spyir nyin der 'dzoms pa'i rgan mgo se man chad/chung lte

38 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//dmar yan chad kyis mna' ma'i gdong pa mthong re chen po byed kyi yod pa ni bshad ma dgos zhing / mna' ma rang gis kyang mi tshe'i nang gi 'tsho ba bskyel sar gyur pa'i mkhar dang lung pa'i chags tshul/ tha na rang gi gtan grogs de la'ang ci 'du zhig yod dam snyam nas mthong 'dod chen po zhig yod pa ni de bas kyang bshad ma dgos/ 'on kyang tshe sngon gyi bag chags zhig yin nam/ rnying zhen gyi dri ma zhig yin nam/ sdar ma'i ngang tshul zhig yin nam/ mdzangs ma'i yon tan zhig yin/ gang ltar de dag gi grib ma tsam yang lta mi phod par mgo bo thur nas thur du gug nas bsdad yod stabs mna' ma'i gdong pa ji bzhin sus kyang mthong mi thub/ gal srid gcig gis zur tsam zhig mthong ba yin na'ang khos rang 'dod kyis 'grel bshad ring po zhig rgyag rgyu yin par the tshom med/ de nas bza' ba la sha mar thud gsum gyis ri bo brtsegs/ btung ba la ja chang 'o mas mtsho mo bskyil nas phud kyis lha tshim/gtor bas bya chim/ gsur sdus 'dre chim/ lhag mas khyi chim le zhig byas nas 'ur thing nge rol/ der bza' btung tshar ba dang mnyam du gnye bo bsam grub dar rgyas des ga 'u nang nas dar dkar po srid na ring ba zhig bton te gral dkyil du yar 'gro mar 'gro lan 'ga' byas nas 'jigs pa'i nyams dang bcas 'di skad do//oṃ su sti/ bde legs su gyur cigade ring gnam la skar ma yag pa phur bu rgyal gyi nyi ma/ sa la dus tshod yag pa rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus chen/bar la lag nye yag pa ma bsgrigs rten 'brel rang 'grig gi nyin mo 'di la/gnas phun sum tshogs pa ja stag nor bu'i sa cha/'khor phun sum tshogs pa lha sde 'bras dkar spungs 'dra/ bya ba phun sum tshogs pa mi rabs brgyud pa'i gzhung zhing / 'khor ba chags pa'i gzhi ma/rta rtod kyi phur pa/zho chags kyi dbri ma la/lha bla ma gnyis kyis brtag bab de yag skra btsug lag rtsis kyi 'bras bu de bzang / 'byung ba lo zhing spar kha de mthun nas/ bos rngu 'i a lan de shar gyis don/ btab pa'i 'bru drug de sa nas smin/ btsos pa'i

pha yul gyi gnyen ston/ 39'bras ① nga de dbus nas langs te/ mthon po la ri rgyal rtse mthud/ ring po la chu sna gzhung mthud/ 'jam po la dar dkar yug mthud kyis/ sngar nye rnying pas gdan bting /da nye gsar pas gur phub/ bar yul mi lha snge mgron du bos te/ bkra zhis mnyen ston gyi rten 'brel 'di ni/ gling ge sar dar nas rta rgyug sru 'brug mo dar nas glu len/ chung a theg dar nas rtsed ra dar bsdad rgyu de la/ rten rnying pa la rten bshad gsar pa/ gos rnying pa la gong ba gsar pa ci dgos kyi ma red de/ tshig gsum gyi 'dra ma ma bshad na/ pho thos pa che yang don mi go gom gsum gyi gom pa ma spos na/ thang yangs pa gsum gyi ltad mo mi rig zer ba'i dpe ltar/dang po phyi snod 'jig rten chags tshul/nang bcud sems can byung tshul/steng na rje'i gdung rabs/ lugs gnyis khrims kyi na ma gzhag stong sde srid pa chags tshul/ lha na pa sangs rgyas byon tshul/ston pa'i dam chos dar tshul/ 'dren pa dge 'dun bzhugs tshul/ sgos su bod kyi lo rgyus/bstan pa snga dar phyi dar/rgya gar chos kyi gong ba/rgya nag khrims kyi zhal lce/ge sar dmag gi lo rgyus/ da dung stobs dpa' rtsal can gyi dpa' bo'i skyes rabs/ rtsal grub rtags can gyi bla ma'i na ma thar/ gtam kha mtshar can gyi a khu'i 'o1 rgyus/ maswā bya rgyal rgod pos nam 'phang gcod lugs/ dma' chu nang nya mos gathog 'gyur rgyag lugs/ bar sgo sprin phyug mo sa sbrang char phab lugs/ skyid nyi zlas gling bzhi bsdo ra lugs/ rkyang ga mas byang thang ga〈snag lugs/ stag dmar yag la ri mo lnga da lugs gzig khra yag la thig le rgyas lugs/ seng dkar mo la g.yu ral thog lugs sku gas rgyas shing rgyas pa ba shad bsdad na/dpyid khu byug sngon mos drug 'gyur rgyag pa'i nyin dang / ston sha ba rog pos ngur sgra 'byin pa'i nam la bshad kyang rdzogs rgyu ci ma red de/ nyin ma thung thung la gro yan ring po byas bsdad na/ nyi na kha dkar ngo dkar de mun la thug phyin/ chung a theg gi thod pa de rdo la brdeb/ma sru mo'i 'khu ra de ka la brdeb/ pha khu bo'i ya thod de sgo la brdeb pa'i nyen che bas/de las skabs su bab pa'i gtam/dus su smin pa'i 'bras bu/sngon rgya'i sras mo me tog rang 'khrungs de/ bod chos rgyal chen po'i khab tu bsus pa'i tshe/ 'gar rig pa can de'i bshad

40 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//srol/gos de la yod pa'i gong ba/sha de la yod pa'i tshi lu/dpon de la yod pa'i thob/thob de la yod pa'i tham/ nyi ma'i 'od/ zla ba'i dkar cung zad bshad na/ sngon sna sa de la cha bzhag na/bya skya ka phra pos grogs skad rgyag sa/ khu byug sngon mos drug 'gyur 'then sa/ ngang pa dang 'jol mos gshog rtsed rtse sa/bod dbu nag gi spros kha dar sa/sde khra bo la kha 'eng che sa/nor longs spyod kyi gter kha rdol sa/ pho ya rabs kyi dbu 'phang mtho sa/ 'bri a ris ngur rgyong byed sa/lug ma mo sa 'bag tshag ldir sa/rta masngatshe ba'i bang kha skyen sa/stag shar pa'i mda' kha tsha sa/ sman bu mo'i glu kha rgod sa/ shar gyi ja stag snge pa'i nang gi lha gzi klu dpal tshang zer rgyu de/ pha rgyud de tshangs pa lha nas chad pas/ byams snying rje ya rabs kyi rigs rgyud/ ma rgyud de gtsug na klu nas chu da pas/ nor longs spyod 'byung ba'i rigs rgyud/ sngang ba da gra la thug na/dug tsher gnam la gzeng 'du/ smar mo'i mnyen la thug na/ nor bu dar gyis sgril 'dra/ brgya gral nang gi gtso bo/ stong gral nang gi 'go ma/ gro yus nang gi khra khra/ sgo nga nang gi ser ril/mi pho bzang po la sma ma phog rta pho bzang po la grum ma phog mkhan 'ig yin le de/ ma bshad 'on pas kyang go ma bltas 'o/nga bas kyang gsal bsdad le la/ lhag pad bu rgan pa bkris don 'grub 'di/spun gsum nang gi che ba/pha khya na mas kyi blo gtad/snge pa chags pa 'i ga'i ma/sbu gur phu ba pa'i gzhung zhing / 'dzam bu gling gi mi g.yang / sngang dgra bo'i steng la ngom rgyu/ nye smar mo'i steng la 'phyar rgyu/ ki byung na sngon la 'gro mi/ zas ster na gzhug la len mi/ rku lag na bzhag kyang len mi shes/ rdzun lce la ba'ag kyang lab mi shes mkhan/ stobs chen 'brong dang 'dra le/ shed shugs dred dang mnyam le/ dpa' rgod dom dang mtshungs le/ mdod na bang rkyal sbe gsum/ mda' the mcho nga gsum/ bris yig rtsis gsum ste/ skyes pa pho yi rtsal dgu ༄ ga po'i rtsal sna bco ba gyad de/ chung ma las skyes nas rang chas su yod pa de 'dra yin na/ rta po'i sngon la rta bshad dang /mdzo pho'i sngon la grus grangs bshad ci dgas/da rgyab pha ming de la cha bzhag na/ dbus 'gro de rgya la bskor/ rgya 'gro de dbus la bsgor ba'i rgya bod hor gsum/ hor khri 'dan gsum gyis bstod sa dang smon sa yin le la/

pha yul gyi gnyen ston/ 41gnam 'khor lo rtsibs ba gyad kyis gur phub/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyis gdan bting / bar bkra zhis rtags brgyad kyis rag bskor/ phu gsum gangs kyi ri bo/ gangs la seng ge 'kho ra sa/ seng la g.yu ral rgyas sa/ bar gsum nags kyi ri ngo / nags la rgya stag 'kho ra sa/ stag la 'dzom drug rgyas sa/ mda' gsum rgya zhing phyur po/ zhing chu ma la 'bru drug smin sa/ 'bru re re la 'bru bgya btags sa/ gangs la dung dkar rang byon/ srung la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal/ brag la seng ge 'gying 'du/ shing la 'bras bu sum 'ango gas/ thang la sman sna bcu 'dzoms/ chu la bdud rtsi zegs ma/ yul la dge bcu 'dzoms sa nas/ nub kyi sa 'dzin ru ba zer rgyu de/ bshad na bshad rin chog pa/ smug po gdong gi mi rgyud/ bsdad na khri 'bol gnyis brtsegs/ song na rta la thog dom/ nyam chung skyong ba'i pha ma/ btsan po dung ba'i tho ba/khyad par bu mo me dog lha mdzes 'di / spun gsum nang gi chung ba/ skyed yag le lha yi bu mo/ngag snan le sba dkar gling bu/ sems gsal le shel dkar me 'o nga / dkar sa dkar la bltas na/ gangs la nyi ma shar 'du/ dmar sa dmar la bltas na/ mtshal la me lce dze1ga 'dra/sku gzugs rtsa ri'i smyug ma/ sgra lo pho rog smug zhag spyan mig la kha'i skar chen/ so dkar dung phre nga rkyong 'dra/ ru ba chags pa'i gzhi ma/ phyi'i lcags ri/ nang gi nor bu yin le de/ shad mi da gos jo ma'i dbu s+t+ra/phyi mi dgos dngul dkar gyi me long de 'dra red/da nga'i lag na bzung ba'i 'jam po bkris kha dar 'di nyid/ me dar me ri dmar po/rlung dar sprin pa kha sprod/sa dar gser gyi 'od can/chu dar chu srin pa ṭa/ma grub pa rgyal mo'i tshe dar/ nya spra ba kha yi khog dar/ nag po rgya yi pha zog g.yang mi 'gyur byug gi dbri ma 'di nyid/ tshong dpon nor bu bzang pos nyos tshun chu da/ lag do skar ma bkra shis kyis bkal tshun chad/ rgya drel mi cag 'dzi mos khur tshun chad/ chu chen po la gru gla ma spud/ la mthon po la la btsas ma gaskuris/ shā bla ma la mjal dar ma phul/ gong da pon po la khrims dar ma bzhagarta mgyogs pa'i mgyogs dar ma byas/pho dpa 'a bo la dpa' dar ma spud/ mdzo khyung dkar gyi ra da ra ma byas/ lug g.yang dkar kyi na dar ma byas pa 'di nyid/ ser po gser dang mnyam

42 'bras ring lu bo dal 'bab//brjes/ dkar po dngul dang dgu skor/ dar stod la sangs rgyas stong sku/ chos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel/ dar sked la 'dod yon sna lnga/ nor longs spyod 'byung ba'i rten 'brel/smad la rgya nag lcags ri/sku srog brag las sra ba'i rten 'brel/leb la nyin mo bde legs/ 'dzar ma la g.yang gi lcags kyu/ ma btag kha tshar nyi le/ ma bris ri sa 'khyug se/ma phyis 'od mdangs lam mer/ gangs dkar yag las dkar sha che le/ sa dog mo las kha zheng che le/ gnam a sngon las khyab rgya che le/ chab sngon mo las gzhung thag ring le/ phyar na dgra lha 'khor le/ g.yug na phya g.yang khug le/ gsol na bsam don 'grub pa 'di nyid/de ring dkyil ka dpag bsam ljon zhing 'di la gsol pa'i tshe/ steng khang rim pa bcu gsum de/ byin chen rten dang bla mas gang / bar khang rim pa bcu gsum de/ gnyen dang nye ba zhag pos gang / 'og khang rim pa bcu gsum de/ gser dngul mu tig nor gyis gang / mkhar thog so gsum de phun sum tshogs/ dga' skyid gnyis kyi nyi ma shar/ ma btab 'bru drug sa nas smin/ma 'tshos sgo phyugs ri nas 'phel/ yar thab gser thab khra mo nas/ dkar gsum zas kyi gter kha rdol/ mar thab dngul thab khra mo nas/ mngar gsum bdud rtsi'i char pa 'bab/shar srung gya stag khra bo de gra ma nyam/s+ho srung g.yu 'brug sngon mo de mchu ma skam/nub srung bya chen dmar mo de sgro ma 'thor/ byang srung rus sbal rgya bo de skad ma chag steng srung sprin pa dkar pos la ma brgyab/ 'og srung rgya mtsho sngon mo sas ma non par/ lha tshangs pa rgya byin gyi bsti gnas/ klu dga' bo 'jog po'i pho brang / byang na ma thos sras kyi bang mdzod/ g.yang dzam bha lha yi ra ba 'di la/ pha khu ri rgyal bzhin du brtan pa dang / ma sru mtsho chen ba'in lce brling pa dang / grong pa phu zhu bzhin du mthun pa dang / rigs rgyud me tog bzhin du bkrag pa dang / sngag shar mda' smyug bzhin du bskyed pa dang / klung rta yar zla bzhin du 'phe la ba da nga /longs spyod dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa dang /snyan grags g.yu 'brug bzhin du khyab pa yis/bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig ces kha dar de dkyil ka la gaskusnal nas slar gal la 'khod/ der mi tshogs kyi khrod nas khag cig ni snyan thag chod nas bstod

pha yul gyi gnyen ston/ 43bsngags byas/ la las de tsam gyi legs khro zhig ma red zer nas ma 'gu ba'i tshul bstan/'ga' zhig ni don gyi 'dra ma ji bzhin ma go yang lad zlos 'du byas nas 'ur thing nger gyur/de nas mi rnams rol rtsed la 'jug rgyu'i sta gon byas/ru ya kho re stag tsha thog bag rgyag thong ’ (min/nga la gro dung dgos red zer gyi 'dug mi2'o na seng grags sgog gyis dang mi spyo seng grags bu mo tsho'i cha la glu kha tshad de bsdad 'dug pas khyod kyi rta de sprad kyang yong gi ma red ’ spyo khyung thob kyis ga re byed kyi 'dug mi2 kho sgrung bton nas yong gi min zer mi 22wa ye 'brug chen bag rgyag gi yin pas ru rta la rta dang rde'u la lug bzhag na rgyag chog mi rngu 'grig gi red sgog ziskabs der nga rang yang de lta bu'i gro glu gzhas gsum sogs zlos gar dang / rta rgyug mda' 'phen/ bang shugs sbe gsum 31gas rtsal 'gran dang / 〈sna bag zhags gsum skusnags rgyan rtsed de dag gi bro ba zhig 〈snang 'dod 'o1sa sku da/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang gzhon nu'i skabs su 'jig rten rnam grangs pa'i rol rtsed ji sted cig gnang ba ma yin nam/ 〉(na kyang rab byung zhig de lta'i rgyan rtsed la g.yeng ba ma〈snang ba na yul mi tshos dngos thugs ci rigs nas dma' 'bebs kha gtong byed nges yin stabs nyob snang zhig skyes nas/ smad na mi dga' bstod na dga' ba'i 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rta la zhon nas rang khyim la 'o1ga phyin pa yin//1666 3

phyir dran khag gnyis/1 sngon ma nga rang bod du bsdad skabs zhig la grogs po blo brtan nas/ ‘ ra shas grang ba na gi yod pa dang /lug shas tsha ba na gi red zer bas de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/’ zhes sdus byung bas ngas lam sang ci zer med nas ra sha ni chu yi khams dang / lug sha ni me yi khams nged/ ces bshad pa yin/ sha tsha/ kho ni rgyu mtshan gyi lho nas tshig gi za 'jal mi shes pa'i 'jig rten khyim pa zhig yin pas slar yang de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mi 'dri bar mgo bo lcog lcog byas nas yid tshims pa'i na ma 'gyur bstan sku nga /da ni khos gzhan la'ang 'grel bshad chig rkang gnyis po de rgyag snyu yin par the tshom med/ des na ngas yang bsgyar de'i skor bsam gzhigs byed dus sngar don zhig yid la wa le shar byung / nga yi spun mched ni rdzong rim pa'i sman pa zhig red/ kho pha yul du yong nas rtsa che 'i ri skyes sman sna mang po nyo sgrub byed kyi yod/ nga tsho'i lung par sman dzi ba zer ba'i sdong po khru gang tsam yod pa thang zhing 'dra ba zhig yod pa de ni bzi kha yod pa'i tsha ba'i sman zhig red/ 'on kyang lung pa kha byang bstan gyi dzi ba ma gtogs ltor bstan gyi dzi bas tsha ba la phan pa'i tshab tu gnod kyi sku da tshul bshad pa go myong / de ni gzhan min par kha lhor bstan gyi skye dngos de dag la nyi ma'i drod tshad phog thugs che bas de dag gi zhus pa'ang tsha ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dang /nyi 'od phog tshad nyung ba'i kha byang bstan gyi bsil ba'i khrod du 'tshar skyed byas pa'i skye dngos de dag gi zhus pa'ang bsil bar gyur pa red/nga snu'i mig gis ma༄ nga ba'i skye dacosas na mas la dul rdzas brgyad ma mtha' la 'dus dgos kyi yod/ des na rang gi grub cha spu la rdzas gang mang ba de'i dbang du

phyi dran byas khag gnyis/ 45'gro ba yin/ lug ni bal gyis grang reg 'gog srung nan po thub cing drod tshad gsog 'jog legs po byed thub pas/ lug sha lta bu rang gi grub cha la tsha reg mang ba slebs nas zhus pa'i rang bzhin drod du gyur pa dang / ra yis drod tshad de tsam gsog mi thub pa'i khar mtho sgang du 'tsho ba'i ra na mas la grang reg phog tshad mang ba slebs kyi yod pas sha yi nus pa bsil ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa red/ dper na/ zhing chu ma'i nas dang /ri ma'i nas kyi rtsam pa so sor chu mang nyung gcig par blug kyang snga ma sla po dang / phyi ma gar po chags kyi yod pa des chu ma'i nas kyi grub cha la chu dul mang tsam slebs yod pa dang / ri ma'i nas la de ltar slebs med pa'i khyad par gsal po mngon pa zhig red/bya rigs kyi spus drod tshad gsog shas che bas de'i sha zha mas drod kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa dang sbru med kyi sha na mas bsil ba'am stoms pa yin/ 'on kyang phyi'i zhus pa'i 'byung khungs la ma ltos par rang gi kha zas kyi zhus pas de'i sha khrag gi nus pa la dbang sgyur byas pa de 'dra yang yod/ de bzhin tsha ba'i khul du skyes shing nyi ma'i 'byung khungs kyang phun sum tshogs pa yod mod sa 'og nas grang ba'i reg bya can gyi dul phran mang po 'then gsog byas pa'i rtsi shing rigs khag cig kyang bsil ba'i rang bzhin du gnas yod/ des na gnad 'gag de ni phyi'i nus pa'i 'byung khungs dang / nang du rang gi grub cha la gtso bo gang zhig 'tshol bsdus phung gsog byas yod med gnyis la rag las yod par snam 31//2 sngon ma nga rang pha yul gyi dgon par bsngad skabs der rgya dmag stong phrag brgal ba bsad pa'i skad grags kyis chod pa gsa' ri tshe dbang nas/ 2 sngon ma zing 'khrug skabs ngo da mi shi ba rnams kha 〉(ga la bltas nas zhi ba dang /rgya dmag na mas kha gnam la bltas nas shi gi 'dug dpe cha'i nang du kha 'og la bltas te zhi ba ni ches ma rung ba byas pa'i skye bo sdig can na mas kyi zhi stangs zhig yin par gsungs 'dug na/ bod chos ljan gyi sa la skyes shing dge sdig blang dor khas len mkhan zhig rgya mi las thi

46 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//stangs ngan pa ci yin nam/nyi zhes sdus byung bar de skabs lan yag nge zhig brgyab ma thub pas da cha yang bskyar bsam gzhigs byas tshe/ de ni dge sdig dang / ya rabs ma rabs kyi bya spyod mtshon byed cig min par yul gyi khyad par las goms srol dang 'phrod bsten la 'brel ba yod pa zhig red ces bshad chog snyam/ nga tsho bod pa rnams nyal dus gathe gas g.yas gasku1na gang rung zhig sa la phab nas rkang pa brkums zhing mgo bo mdun du bkug ste nyal srol yod pa red/ de'i ngan 'bras kyis lo na cung mtho ba na gzugs po dang sgyid khug gug gug chags nas 'gro sdod kyi dka' ngal 'phrad kyin yod/ 'chi khar yang sngon goms pa'i dbang gis gzhogs sa la phab nas mgo bo mdun du bkug ste yod na 'chi ba'i tshe mgo bo'i ljid kyis gzugs po mdun du 'then te kha sgub tu 'gyel ba zhig red/ rgya mi ni nam rgyun nas gan rkyal du nyal gyi yod pas rgas dus kyang lus srong por sdod kyin yod la 'chi khar yang de ltar nyal bas de nyid du 'chi ba red/de yi rgyu rkyen ni gzhan min par yul gyi dro grang las yin par shes thub/bod kyi yul ni grang ngar gyi pha yul yin pas mgo dang lag pa pus mgo na mas mdun du rub rub kyis nyal ba ni drod bskyed sla ba'i khyad yod pas red/ rkang lag na mas bkrams te greng nas nyal ba ni bsil ba'i khyad par sku da pas rgya nag skusnags tsha ba'i khyal du nyal stangs de goms gzhis su gyur pa red/ nga rang chung dus gan rkyal du nyal skabs a phas/ spyo de ni rgya mi nyal stangs red zi ces bka' gyon yang gnang ba dun gyi 'dug gan rkyal du srong por nyal ba ni lus kyi rtsa rgyus rnams mi 'khum zhing rgas pa'i tshe srong por 'gro thub pa dang / mgo'i dbyibs zlum por chags pa/ mig 'bras phyir mi 'bur ba/ kha'i mchu to mi nar ba/ gdong gor zhing bzhad pa'i mdangs thon pa/ phrag gong rgyas shing thad sor gnas pa/ lto dang rkub mdun rgyab tu mi 'bur ba/ rkang lag na mas drang zhing snyoms pa/ mdor na lus thang pa dang tshe ring bar sdod cing gcig sgos la de las ldog pa'i ngan 'bras 'byung ba gdon mi za/ cane kyang gan rkyal du nyal skabs sdur

phyi dun byas khrag gnyis/ 47pa 'then sla bas gzhan dag gnyid dang bsam gtan sogs dkrog pa dang / rgya gar sogs tsha ba'i khyal du nyal gos srab pas mdoms kyi thad rnam 'gyur ngan pa 'byung zhing / gzhan dag chags pa skyed pa sogs dgag bya dgos pa mang po la gzigs nas/gzhogs g.yas sar phab kyi seng ge ltar nyal ba ni mchog yin par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs myong / de min gzhogs g.yon phab nas 'khum ste nyal ba na snying dang /mgo bo sogs kyi nad kyang 'byung zhing gzugs po'i bde thang la gnod skyon tshabs chen phog bzhin yod par mthong //16khu/ 73

pha yal gyiho|gas pa zhigaphyird wa /ring — 0 — 0 — ༷༷/thegashe byas pa'i 'char snang /kha ba yi sa gzhi/ risprin pa yi gur khang /gangs ri yi ka ba/brag dkar gyi rtsig pa/'khyag rom gyi mchod rten/g.yang dkar gyi lug khyu/mar dkar gyi ril lu/zho dang 'o ma ste/dkar po dgu yis bskor ba ni mtho sgang gi 'jig rten te nga rang gi pha yul/ dgung sngon po'i ga'al yas nas bskal pa'i me yis 'tshig pa lta bu'i sprin dmar rnams dum bur gyi da de dmar po nas rim gyis nag po gyur mthar 'ur sgra dang bcas byang shar gyi rdza ri'i rtse mo brgal/ dbyar ljang ga'on gyi lang tsho smad nas ngom 'ing ston gser mdog gi cod pan thod du bcings pa'i nub phyogs kyi spang ri'i rtse por 'ogs pa'i nyi 'od ser lham mer shar yang /gnag khyu thang la bkrams pa lnga bu'i sgrin nag gi grib ma 'jigs su rung ba 'ga' yis bsgrigs pa ni rin chen dang po'i snang brnyan la mu man gyi phra btab pa dang kun nas mtshungs/gser gyi sa gzhi la g.yu yi khu ba byug pa ji bzhin spang ljongs kyi ngos su ri bo la mun pa babs pa lta bu'i sbra nag bco brgyad bcu dgu zhig yod pa de dag nas du ba phran bu re sngo

pha yul gyi zhogs pa zhig phyir dun byas pa 'i 'char snang / 49thur thur du 'phyur/ sbra nag de dag 'khor lo'i dbyibs can gyi ru bsgrigs nas yod pa ni mtshan mo rwardor lug na mas dkyil du bcug nas dgra jag gcen spyang gi gnod pa 'gog bde ba'i ched min na ci yin/ gnam khrel med kyis char pa ma btang yang sa drin chen gyi drod gsher las thon pa 'i rtsa na mas zil pa khrom khrom byas nas langs 'dug kyang / gnag lug na mas ni lhas ra'i nang du ra co g.yug tsam dang / na co dkrug tsam byas te ldad 'chu 'a bzhin mgo bo rnams phyogs phyogs su gtad de da dung ma lang bar nyal 'dug sems can de dag gi mig la bltas na/ dga' sdug dang thob sgor gyi re dogs med par rang bzhin gyi zhi ba'i nyams zhig shar 'dug par de snga su zhig gis shes yod dam/ gzugs bong 'grong dang 'dra la/ stobs shugs dred dang mnyam pa/ dpa' rgod dom nag las che ba'i 'grog khyi de dag ni rang gis nor na mas srung ba'i dus kyi thun mtshams las yol bar shes nas ji mi snyam pa ra mgo bo do khug tu bcug ste khul sim mer nyal/ sbral dang 'dra ba'i thag phra ring mo la rtod pa'i gyi ling gi rta mchog na mas ni mtshan gang bzazlo kyang da dung long ka ma gang bar rwa za bzhin mgo bo ze ze dang ne mchog krong grong / gom 'gros ldem lngem gyis spyang mdog dang grung mdog byas kyang don la sngar ma'i ngang tshul zhig mngon 'dug skabs der nga'i a mas thab steng nas chu skyog phyed tsam blangs nas sgo la don nas skyog yu ske bad btsir nas chu phra po stod de lag gnyis gtsang mar bkrus rjes slar nang du 'ongs nas lag gnyis me'i steng du gang 'tsham zhig g.yulas/ de ni dreg pa rnams chus bkrus pa dang grib dang mi gtsang ba gzhan dag me yis bsal thub dun sku da shas che/de nas thog mar mcho nga bong na mas 'phyid dgos snyam pa min nam gang ltar yang mchod khri steng du lta tsam byas pas/sku gsung thugs rten phran bu 'ig stabs bde'i sgam chung du blugs na sa bzhag yod pa'i mdun na mar me na mas da dung ma gzim par lhab lteb du 'bar ba'in yod par mthong nas tshags khri'i steng gi bzhon zo zhig blangs te sgo la thon nas 'bri na mas bzho bar gom stabs lhas ra'i phyogs su bsgyur/ su zhig la lab pa ra ma shes kyang nga'i a

50 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//mas lhas ra'i nang nas/ 2 da nang therdzogs pa sprin pa skrag sma tshig 'dug pas chig mjug rdzogs long ma byung gong yar grong tshang dbyangs mtsho sgo la don yod pa 'dra/‘ dgong 'tshig me la zhogs 'tshig chu zer ba yin pas char pa gtong rgyu red/ a mas/ spyod ni bod blo brgyad pa'i mar cas la slobs zin pas kha ba 'bab pa las char pa galta nga gi ma red/ ma gzhi da lo'i dpyid zla gnyis pa'i kha ba chen po de'i gangs lan 'bab ran tshod yin/ g.yang mtshos/’ nga tsho dgun mtsher la ma〈snags tsam sgo thub na a/ mi de tshos da dung sdo thu ma tshar ba ci byas bsdad pa yin na/ song nas zla ba gcig zin pa sku da/kha ba 'bab na nga tsho nyog dang nag mo tshos ci gang byed thub kyi ma red/mi nged tshang dang thag ring ba'i dud tshang 'ga' yi sgo 'gram nas kyang yar 'bod mar 'bod 'dra po mang po zhig byed kyi 'dug kyang don gyi 'dra ma 'bras bu ji bzhin go mi thub/ nga rang ni nam rgyun dang mthun par thab steng gi chu na mas khol rjes yas ka la khyis ma lha ba tsam gyis bkal ba'i gla thun gyi ja khug la pags pa 'i dzar 'o1 dang / gzig dang bya glag gi sder mo dang / skyung ma'i yas mchu dang / gla pho'i mche bas brgyan pa zhig yod pa de las ja che tshad cig btab/ khro zang steng gi rdo g.yam gyi kha leb de phar 'bud de 'o ma'i kha dkris mang tsam zhig blugs/ khrog sgam nas lug lpags kyi tsa he bstar ba'i rtsam khug nas rtsam pa chur ba ha lam mang nyung mnyam pa zhig 'dug pa de las 'o ra pa'i nang nyung tsam blangs/ 'ogs mar pu ril zhig brgyab nas 'phyar tsam byas te de'i steng ja blugs nas gtud mar snga ra pa gsum tsam btung / de nas 65 mas 'bri rnams bco sa tshar te nang du log nas/ dzo rtog khyod kyis zog rnams yar tshad gzhan tsho'i cha la 'ded de sgoga.a mas 'ogs ja 'thung rgyu yin/nyi ngas thog rnams rdang las sgod de 'ded bzhin ga'an tsho'i cha la slebs skabs der grong pa'i rdzi bo rgan pa blo brtan nas/ rgyu de ring nga tshos zog na mas rdza 'khris yar 'ded 'gro/ der t+t+waṃ yag po bsdad yod kyang sang gnangs ru spos pa nas bed med gyur pa red/ we rdzi bo rnams dgong dag chu tshod gsum pa ma zin tsam nas sgog ma gtogs do dgong thog rug gu 'dus kyi ma red/mi skabs der nga'i sems la nyin

pha yul gyi zhogs pa zhig phyi ra dran byas pa'i 'arngo ra snang / 51gung chu tshod gsum par chur ba 'thag i yong / chur ba'i 'og tu me+e rgyun chad med par ma btang na su ru'i me ni 'bar sla ba dang shi sla ba nam mkha'i glog dang 'du ba zhig ma yin nam/a mas ni nang la 'o ma mang po dkrog dgos pa dang / phyi la chur ba skam srung byed dgos pa ma zad/ me zhing su ru yang 'thu dgos/ da dung ra lug be'u sogs phar mngags tshur btags byed dgos pa ni ci 'dra'i rnyog dra tsha ba zhig ma red dam/ gang ltar nang mi nyung ba'i nged ma smad gnyis kyi dka' tshegs na mas re re bzhin blo yul du 'khor//drang bden/tsho mi rtse/ phyi zla gsum pa'i 'don thengs kyi thog grangs bzhi pa nas zur du phyu nga pa'o//

'grog phrug gi 'tsho ba/lo brgyad kyi byis pa gsum g.yang dkar gyi rdzi bo la song /rtsi tog dang me tog btus nas chu la bsgyur te g.yengs/spung thang gis lug khyu rnams bsad mas kyis phyogs ba'ir gtor/bya rgod kyis nam mkhar gang zhing pho rog gis sha skad ba khyab/zhub phyogs nas glog dmar 'khyug cing thog ser gyis gnam sa sbrel/'brug sgra dang rlung pos me tog nems kyang 'dar yom yom byed/nyi ma'ang sprin nag gi bang rim nang 'dzul nas thog dmar 'phe na/a ma'i 'bod sgra dang khyi'i skad sgra na mas je nye dang rje nyer gyur/spang ljongs steng gi spro snang de ni rgya mtsho'i phar mtha' la thims/'jigs sgrag dang phangs sems kyis na ma shes kyang phyi la phud/

bral 31 sgang gi sman pa/rdul rdza zal mo sgang gi gyog mtshams zhig na sman pa skad grags can zhig yod pa de la glang nag 'phags pa zer/khong ni rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas zhing lhag par spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lcags po ri sman rtsis slob grwa nas thon pas/ sman rtsis gnyis la gzhan dring mi 'jog par g.yu phyag rnam pa gnyis dang sgo kun nas mtshungs/ rig gnas gsar rje'i skabs su chos ni dug rtsa dang / yul srol goms gzhis mtha' dag rmongs dad dang / sku gsung thugs rten nems ni mthong mi rung ba'i lha 'dre gdon bgegs kyi lag char rtsis te rtsa med btang ba dang chabs cig khong la'ang gral rim gyi zhwa mo g.yogs te nad dbyad sman ster mi chog pa'i khrims gzhi bsdams/'on kyang 'gro ba mi zhig yin phyin rang nyid srog la thug pa'i nad kyis mnar ba na sman pa zhig la re ba mi rgyag mkhan su zhig yod/ der brten nad pa mang po zhig nyin gzhung sgo nas 'gro ma phod kyang mtshan ltag sgo nas 'dzul te/ rtsa bstan chu bstan gyis srog rta rnga tsam de mi chad par ci dug gi skyabs 'jug zhus/ khong gis kyang tshong dpon gyi bu chu 'bab skam la thon pa'i nya la brtse ba dang rjes su mthun par zhum pa dang bag tsha ba med par nad can de dag 'jigs pa med pa'i dbyags dbyung / tshul de rim pas rgya khyab tu song na sa rdzong rim pa'i las byed pas shes rtogs byung 'phral slar yang khong la mi mang mgo skor bslu brid kyis gsar rje ngo log byed 'char yod pa'i skyon 'dzugs byas/ skabs der khong gis/ ngas nad dpyad sman ster byed pa ni thad shar nad pa'i gzugs gzhi bde thang la 'brel ba yod pa dang /de yang ngal rtsol gyi zhus shugs dang 'brel ba yod pa/mthar gtug na rgyal khab kyi yar rgyas dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig las nang bsam blo'i chab srid dang 'brel pa spu

54 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//tsam yang med pa'i snyan zhu ring mo zhig bris nas rdzong mi mang srid gzhung la phul/ snyan zhu de rdzong dpon 'o wang gi lag tu slobs nas bltas rjes thad mar lan 'debs kyi spobs pa ma rnyed nas g.yo thabs kyi bsam ngan zhig yid la shar te/ hū ci gzhon pa krang gyi rna rtsar 'di 'du dang de 'dra zhes tshig kha shas thub shub tu bshad/ de nas lam sang ru khag dang po'i ru dpon sang nyin nas 'di gar 'byor dgos pa'i brda tho me 'dra ba zhig btang / ru dpon 'byor ba na rdzong dpon lo wang nas bshad don/ ru khyod la drang po bshad na nga la nad gzhi lci po zhig sku da sma da/ rgya nag nas sman pas nad codus ma zin par nad med yin par 'grel ba1snad byas pa dang / gzugs bo|ga che tshad dang zha rgyags tshad yin pas gzugs 〈snabs yag pa'i gral du rtsis nas krung dbyang gis nga la mtho sgang du 'ablo dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba red/'dir slebs dus nad gzhi log nas dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad kyi 'dug de ring nga'i gcin pa zhig bzhag sku da pa de khyesgod kyis khyer nas glang nag la nad gzhi gang yin lta ru chuga'on kyang de khyod kyi pa pha'i gcin pa yin tshul bshad dgos pa las nga'i red ces bshad na kho 'drog 'go lang nges red/ gang ltar nad gzhi gang yin shes na 'grigs/mi zhes bshad pas ru da〈snan nas dzulags sku nyi zhus te shar rgyag glang nag sar sku nga / glang nag nas ( de 'dra'i nyin mo 'ang sku nga nas nga'i gral rim ci zhig yin mi shes sam/mi zhes bshad pas ru dpon nas/ rung ni ru dpon yin pa dang thad dar yong ba yin dus ha lam dogs pa za gi ma red/ zer bzhin gcin pa batshe na nas rdzong dakhro na gyis bslab pa ltar rang gi pha na ba yin tshul bsnyed/ glang nag nas 2 khyod ni de 'dra'i spyang po yod tsong ru dpon du slebs pa red/mi zer gad mo dgod bzhin gcin pa ka sku la du blugs ma nyid nas/ wa ye ga re rtsa gzan gyi chu 'dra po 'di/’ zhes bshad pas ru dpon gyi sems nang de ni rgya mi sngo tshal la dga' po sku1da pas yin gyi red snyam/ yang thu rus dkrugs tsam byas nas ‘ phag pa'i chu 'du khro zhig kyang red/’ ces bshad pas ru dpon gyi sems la de ni rdzong dpon de dag gis mi mang gi ngal ('ol sku nga 'bab na mas bag med du bzas nas phag ltar nyal zhing rgyags pa'ang red

zal mo sgang gi sman pa / 55 'dug pas dngos gnas 'dra po byung bsams nas gad mo gting nas shor/ skabs der glang nag gi sems la da res kho sa nga la nyams sad byed pa 'di ni snyad r+shasna 'aro da zhig yin par thag gis chod/ ngas kyang don de kho la go tsam zhig byed dgos bsams nas/ ru ru dpon lags kyi pa pha'i mgo la ra skyes skusnad dam/mi zhes sdus par ru da〈snan nas lce nar tsam zhig byed pa las lan ci yang ma btab/ glang nag nas ‘khyo da kyi pha'i mabo| la ra med kyang rkang la ne khe yod pa thag bcad thub/ bden pa bshad na pa pha'i stod la glang gi na tsha sku da pas rtsa chu yag po ster nas gso skyong byed dgos/ smad la phag pa'i na tsha sku da 'dug pas phi gu drug tsam skye srid/nyi ces bshad de gom zheng chen pos rang gi nyal khang du 'dzul nas sgo mo 'ur gyis brgyab ste nyal khri'i steng du 'gre ldog rgyag bzhin bsdad/ru dpon nas don de rdzong dpon la ji ltar zhu dbo sa snyam nas 'tshab 'tshub tu gyur kyang da ni drang wa bshad pa las tshe(sa med snyam ste/ rdzong dpon gyi drung du de lugs zhib par bshad/ rdzong dpon lo wang hang sang nas hū ci krang skad btang ste/ 2nga gnyis gyi gsang ba (glang dang phag pa'i gcin pa bsres pa )de phyir gyar pa ni mi srid/gang ltar sman pa des cha tshang ha go shag mices bshad pas hru ci krang nas tshul de ru dpon la zhib dri byas par ru dpon nas kyang yang skyar 'ib cing phra ba brgyud bshad byas/ krang hū cis/ dzo de ni mo ston gyi lung ltar stes dbang gi lam 'gro byung ba zhig yin shas che/ glang gog de ni lo na che tshad red 'dug pas gso skyong yag po byed dgos zer ba ni bden pa red/ can kyang phag pa de la phi gu ga tshod skye min blta chog bcas bshad de khong gnyis nas phag pa de la phi gu ga tshad skye skusnang min phag rdzi mar blta rgyu mngags/ nyin zhig phag rdzi dbyags hal bzhin rgyugs yong nas thu phag yo de la phi gu lnga skyes song nyi zhes snyan seng phul/ kho nga gnyis nas sman pa des brgya cha dgu bcu tsam zhig shes 3snags thub 'dug ces bshad bzhin pa'i mur slar yang phag rdzi ma rgyugase sku nga nas ‘ nga da lta mar phyin nas blta dus phag mo de la slar yang phi gu tha ma gcig skyes 'dugakhyon bcadams phi gu drug tag tag 'dug ces zhus pas kho1nga gnyis hang sang nas gcig gis gcig la lta bzhin

56 'bras/ ring lu bo dal 'bab//gang 'tsham lus/ de nas krang hū cis/ nga kho'i brtag thabs de ni rtog pa 'char yan pa'i snodangs dad kyi chod ga zhig min par rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi brtag thabs thig yin par nges/ krung dbyang nas bod kyi rig gzhung mtha' dag slongs dad sha stag tu bshad pa ni nor 'khrul zhig min nam/nyi zer nas mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed bzhin byung rim de ji lnga ba bzhin rang gi mi tshe'i nyin deb nang bris sku //10rtse/ 1

nyes ming la mi skrag pa'i pho rgod/snying rje skye 'os pa'i lkug pa/nyes ming la mi 'dzem pa'i gna' bo'i pho rgod khyu gcig dbang chen dang stobs chen/ khrims dang sgrig gzhi/ las dang rgyu 'bras gang la yang mgo mi sgu bar sa phyogs gang dgar bya bzhin lding zhing / gang mos kyi 'tsho ba la ci dgar spyod nas 'chi ba'i tshe gang la'ang 'khreng sems zhe chags med par mdun nas mdun du bltas te bde ba nas bde bar 'gro ba byed do zhes gleng ngo / /'ga' zhig ni nyes ming nag po zhig rang gi thog tu 'ong bar skrag nas ya rab kyi brtul zhugs grags pa'i 'ching thag ring mo zhig gis dam du bsdams te lcags kyi dra ba'i nang gi bye'u bzhin 'jig rten gyi 'dod yon longs spyod thams cad mig gi ltad mo tsam las mi myong bar lnga pa'i lam du slebs tshe/ phangs sems dang 'gyod gdung gis phyi ltas byas pas rkang pa 'dred nas dmyal ba'i khro zangs nang kha sbub du 'gyel/ khro chus lus bsregs pas phyir mchongs kyang lcags sreg gi sa gzhis de las kyang rtsub par mnar bas nyi mo bye tshan la g.yug pa ltar 'gre ldog rgyag bzhin bsngad yod skad thos/ de ni chos can byas pa can gyi rnam gzhag dang mi mthun yang chosi nyid 'dus ma byas kyi bka' lung dang mi 'gal ba yin mi srid pa'ang min/ gang zhig lha chos mi chos thams cad kyi nang du ma rab kyi las su gtan la phab pa'i rkun jag khram gsum gyi ming de rang nyid kyi steng du 'ong bar mthong ba na sbrul gdug pa zhig dang 'dra bar de las g.yol thabs zhig byed pa ni 'jig rten 'di la 'os su che ba zhig yin yod/mtho sgang gi ri sul du gnas pa'i gna' bo'i pho rgod khyu gcig gis khram pa dang jag pa 'es pa'i ming de 'dzem zon med par dang du

58 'bras ring lu bo dal 'bab//blangs nas ri sul nas ri sul brgyud/ rta pho g.yu 'brug 'du ba zhig zhon/ me mda' thog dmar 'du ba zhig khur/ ral gri shi bdud 'du ba zhig btags/ wa zhwa nyi zla bsgribs le zhig gyon nas/nga khram pa'i bu la mgo sba med/gnam a sngon khram pa'i mgo sba yin/nga khram pa'i bu la pha ma med/gri me mda' khram pa'i pha ma yin/zhes dang /bog khra ring khur sgog khram pa'i bu/rdza khra yag zur la shu gsod 'gro/shā sod gda' zer le ma red kyang /bog 'phangs gda' zer le mi bzo re/zhes dang /rogs dga' mo gshong ring gasgong nas thogarkang lham chung chu la zon bzhin thogang khram pa sgang ring sgang nas yong /mgo wa zhwa rlung dang rtse bzhin yong /zhes dang /rta bra 'dzi na so gsum pa red/sa thag ring mi 'gro ci la zer/nga khram pa lo na yar dar yin/rogs dga' po mi 'tshol ci la zer/zhes dang /sgang la kha ya na zhwa zhig phud/rdo dkar pos jag lha gsos le yin/mda' lung khung ma na zhwa zhig phud/chab sngon mos jag lha mchod le yin/zhes dang /nga jag pas jag lha gso le la/lha jo bos phrag dog ma mdzad rogs/jag tshur 'khor gser gyi rting ma des/lha jo bo khyed la gser gsos 'bul/zhes dang /rta 'do dga' g.yang gis srung 'gro dgos/sa thag ring shugs kyis gcod rogs gyis/nga snang ngu jag 'gro dang po yin/ drin pha ma yid la 'khreng bzhin gda'/ zhes sogs jag glu drug 'gyur ring mo zhig len bzhin gnam sngon po'i mar 'og sa ljang khu'i yang steng na pho rang las lhag pa zhig med snang gis seng ge nags na rgyu ba ltar 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba med par spobs sems dang spro snang gis khengs bzhin rang gi mi che'i 'tsho ba bskyel gyin yod pa ni mi tshe 'di la mtshon na ci 'dra'i bag yangs kyi skal bzang zhig red ang /yang snying rku jag khram gsum zhes pa de dang po nyid nas rang chas su sku da pa min par/rgyu nor che chung ji ltar yang gzhan gyis ma mthong bar lkog tu brkus pa na rku ma zhes zer/

nyes ming la mi skrag pa'i pho rgod/ snying rje skye 'os pa'i lkug pa/ 59de ni zhin tu smad de/pho rab kyis mi byed rku/ mo rab kyis mi byed gzhang / zhes dang / dpa' rtsal drug 'dzom pa'i pho rab des/ nong yar langs dmag jag so nam byed/ dpa' snying khams chung ba'i snar ma des/ nub ma nyal rku rdzun 'khor lo bskor/ zhes zer srol yod pa las rku jag gnyis kyi khyad par 'byed srol ci 'dra zhig yod par dpog thub/ khram pa zhes pa ni rtsa ba'i grub cha phyed jag pa dang phyed tshong pa lta bu la che dgu khrims lugs gang la'ang mgo mi sgur bar sa 〈snags gang dga' 'khyam skye da byed mkhan zhig ste/ rgya nag pa'i gtam rgyud nang 'di 'dra la yul khams bsgor mkhan gyi pho rgod ces zer/ gna' bo'i pho rgod de dag gis la rgya mang po zhig srog dang zlos nas srung srol yod pa ste/ pha ma la drin bzo ba/phya hūṃ la ngag 'jam pa/ rgan pa la bkur sti byed pa/ 〈snags po la dam chig brtsi ba/ phan byas la drin 'jal ba/ ngan byas la 3snal lan slog pa/ btsan 〈sna la dbang mi bkur/ nyam chung la dpa' mi bkong / rgyu nor la ser sna med pa/ dgra bo la mgo mi sgur/ phyi gros mi rgyagamachi ma mi gtong / rku mi byed/ rdzun mi bshad/ mna' mi za ba sogs ni pho rgod de dag gi sems kyi rang bzhin la zhugs pa'i dam chig gi phyag rgya zhig red/ 'on kyang nang sems la dug gsum gyi me lce 'bar yang phyi lus ngag gi du ba mi thon pa'i thal bas g.yogs pa'i me dong gi brtul zhugs ni mi shes/ rang 'dod kyi rna mchog dgung la thug cing phyogs lhung gi mtshan ma sa la 'dus kyang g.yo sgyu'i gzig pags gyon nas gzhan gyi lo tog za ba'i stangs ka ni mi 'jon/ nang sems gyis gang dran lus ngag gis dmar rjen du ston pa'i smyon pa dang / lus ngag gis nyes spyod gang byas nga'o zhes khas len pa ni ci 'dra'i lkug pa snying rje skye 'os pa zhig ma red dam//10gyi/ 4

ja stag bar gyi gtam rgyud/re/'u dang po/ ja stag bar gyi pho rgod du ma'i khrod/stobs shugs glang chen smyon pa'i do zla ste/'aX nga thub 'a rdzog snyan grags 'brug la 'gran/'dzam gling sa chen po'i byang gi phyogs/ gangs can bod chen po'i shar gyi char/chu chen po 'bri rdza gnyis kyi bar/la chen po ja stag gnyis kyi mtshams na 'brog pa'i ru dud stor zhig thar thor du gnas/ yul lha rnge rgyal rdo rje 'bar ba zhes pa zhig sku da pa de'i brdas drangs nas yul gyi ming la rnge lung khra mo dang /chu yi ming la nge chu sngon mo zer zhing rgya sgod du mar brgyu da zla chu dang 'brel nas wo ru brgyugs/ lung pa de'i byang dang shar lho'i phyogs gnyis ni rdza ri dkar po du ma yod pa'i yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtsa thang sha stag yin pa ni 'brog dud de da ga gi dbyar zla gsum gyi mtsher sa red / spyir lung pa de byang nas lho ru nar zhing shar ni ja pha da dang nub kyi phyogs ni stag ma la'i ri rgyud yin/byang du song na sga skye rgu dang nye la sto ru song na go brag gi 'brog pa dang thugabar sted rnams su shug pa dang / stag ma/ sur dkar sogs skyes pa'i sprang ri spang gshongs zhe cig yin la de dag ni ston dpyid gnyis kyi mtsher sa yin/ lung pa'i smad ni lung lag mang 'ing drag phrang mang ba rbad de nags tshal gyis gang zhing gu ngo ga tsam yin pa'i nags klung de ni 'grog pa de dag gis dgun zla gsum la bzung ba'i pha mkhar gyi btsan rdzong 'ig red/lung pa der gna' bo'i mkhar shul gyang ro du ma zhig yod la/'ga' zhig nas zer na/ lung pa der sngar bon po'am snying ma'i dgon snge gang rung yod par phyis sog po'i dmag gis gtor bcom btang ba jig yin nam yang zer/ mi mang kur sre'i skabs gyang ro de dag

ja stag bar gyi gtam rgyud/ 61zhing sa bzos pa dang / chu yur 'du ba/ tha na khang pa rgyag pa sogs kyi skabs sa 'og tu si sa pa'i keng rus 'bor chen zhig don gyi yod la/ lung pa de'i da lta'i mi'i gzugs tshad ni che gral zhig yin kyang keng rus de dag dang bsdur na lo brgyad byis pa'i tshad las slebs kyi med/ der brten keng rus chen po de dag la tshan rig gi lam nas zhib 'jug byas tshe gzhi nas lung pa der mi'i 'gro ba ga dus byung min bshad thub/ 'on kyang bar skabs thig nas yangs shing rgya che la rtsa chu bzang ba'i lung pa yid du 'ong ba de 'dra zhig bdag med ri dwags kyi mtsher sa zhig tu gyur pa na/ mi bsad dpon 'gran/ ha log bun 'ded sogs gyod gzhi 'khon 'khrug sna tshogs kyis rkyen pas rang khyim rgyab tu bsgyur nas gros byol du yong ba'i nyes yol ba mang po zhig phyogs mtha' dbus med nas lung pa der gcig 'dus gnyis 'du sa kyis mthar mi tshang lnga bcu sgor 'ig gzhis chags/ phyug po la gso 'phel gnyis zhes smad na gso ra ba dang stod na 'phel rgyas tshang gnyis la ni rta po chen brgya lhag yod pa dang / 'bri g.yag stong phrag las brgal bas 'byor phyug ha cang che/bcan po la a khrom gnyis 'es a mtsho dang khrom bsgrags tshang gnyis la bu spun mang thing a phrug kyang mang la spo lag 'og rta rang 'grig yod pas btsan tshod med par mi rgyu yos ltar 'gam/ rang gi gza' zla las de min pha ma spun mched med la sbra sgor nor lug lta ba'ag khyi 'ig kyang med pa'i mi tshang yang nyung nyung zhig min cing / go lag 'og rta rang 'grig re las 'dus shul lhag shul ci yang med pa'i jag khram pho hreng yang mi nyung ba tshig yod/ phyug po yin kyang rang rgyu mi za zhing / sprang po yin kyang mi rgyu mi slong bar mchog dman med par rkun jag khram gsum dang / bun rgyan ngon gsum gyi so nam kho nar byed de 'tsho thabatheg byazla// —lung pa'i mda' na yul gzhan nas mi bsad kyi rkyen pas gros byol du yong ba'i pho gzhon zhig slebs pa des kyang rngon jag rgyal 'jog kho nas 'tsho thabs byas zhing / ring min lung pa'i bu mo 'ig dang mnyam du sbra chung lu nga zhig phub nas 'jig rten khyim thab kyi las

62 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//la 'jug khong gi ming la 'a rdzog dang / 'ga' zhig nas spu rdzog zer zhing / ming bdog la 'grong thub 'a rdzog ces 'bod la khong ni sgrung pa bdag gi zhang po zhig kyang red/ kho'i mi phyags ni be ri yin cing / de yang bros ma myong rgya tsha gom gsum gros/ zer ba'i dpe ltar dpa' rgya tsha yin kyang / phyir 'gyed sgor ba'i gdong be ri nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi mi rgyud 'khrul med yin skad/ gzugs po'i ring tshad phi ṭi bdun tsam zin cing / mgo bo dang mig sgam che la gru bzhi yin pa/ sna rtse rno la kha che zhing gtam bshad pa'i tshe skad kyang che la ngag 'dar ba zhig yin/kho'i gzugs po'i stobs rtsal la ni skye bo bcu phrag kha shas kyis do zla mi chogakho la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos zhig yod pa ni mtshan mo'ang nyin mo bzhin du mthong thub pa dang / gnyid khug pa'i tshe ri dwags nang bzhin sngar bzas pa'i zas rnams slar bskyugs nas sos zhib por ldad de slar mid bzhin sku da pa ni ngo mtshar che la skyug mer lang pa zhig kyang red/ mtshams re sgo la rta nor lnga bcu drug cu skor yod pa de dag ni gzhan nas 'phrog bajosnam byas pa dang rgyan 〈snab pa sha stag yin la/ mtshams re de dag tshang ma rgyan du re ra nas sgo 'gram la khyi nag po zhig las su yang med par gyur/ der brten kho'i rgyu nor dang 'tsho ba la nges brtan med kyang kho la'ang ci byed kyi sems khral tsam yang med/thengs zhig ru sgo skabs stabs ma legs par kho'i brlig 'bras la g.yag gi ra co phog ste yud tsam ring dran med du brgyal/ brgyal sangs pa na khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar nas g.yag sum grus de'i ra rtse nas bzung ste klad la bsgor zhing rdo la brdabs nas bsad/de nas bzung kho'i 'khris su rtsal 'gran dpyang ngom byed phod mkhan su yang med/ da dung khos rgyu g.yag ma dgos 'brong sum grus zhig yin na'ang rdo la brdabs nas gsod thub/’ ces 'u thob bshad par brten mi tshos kho'i ming la 'grong thub 'a rdzog ces 'bod/ nyin zhig kho rang gcig pu lung pa'i phar phyogs su zha ba ngon du song / zha pho chen po zhig la mda' phog te nyin gang 'ded rjes de dgong bsad thub tsam byung / skabs der bod zla lnga pa'i tshe shar yin stabs khrag ra sdu ra bzhi lnga tsam gnyis skusnad pa de tshur bskasnag nas khrag dang rus pa dbye ba med par

ja stag bar gyi gtam rgyud/ 63mnyam du bzas/ da ni nyin gang gi dka' dub dang khrag ras gzugs por drod 'khol rkyen nyal snying 'dod pa zhig byung ba dang / sa yang yongs su rub par brten me mda' gzhogs su bsnyal te zha ro de'i mjing pa la sngas byas nas nyal ma thag gnyid du yol/ mtshan byed yol tsam nas khrag ra'i stobs shugs kyis slom tshad brgyab ste byang khog nang me 'bar gyi yod pa'i snang ba shar nas gnal las sad/ cane kyang ri rgod kyi mgo la chu thigs pa gcig kyang med par shes te sdug rus byas nas bsdad kyang gang 'tsham nas kha nang gi lce yang hrag por gyur pas skrag snang skyes/ de nas khos thabs shes zhig rnyed de sha ro de mgo mjug ldog nas bzhag rjes mjing pa'i khrag rtsa gris bcad pas khrag dmar phyog lhog tu 'bab pa las nyob 'thung byas/ des kyang ma phan par sngar las lhag pa'i sgom tshad 'bar bas ri gzham du chu 'tshol du mi 'gro dka' med byung / rgyug chu'i 'gram la slebs rjes chu ngom par 'thung rjes mgo bo g.yug g.yug byas nas/ dzu da res me mda' dang sha ro gnyis bo de mar dbor yod na 'dir nyal chog kyang / de'ang ma dun par nga'i bsam blo ni ci 'dra'i lkug pa zhig red ang / ’zhes chig lab rgyag bzhin slar ri sgang du 'dzig nas sngar bzhin nyal nas bsdad/ri sgang der nyi ma shar bas mig lam du ser cham cham zhig gi ngang gnal las sad pa dang su'i yin mi shes pa'i sgra khyad mtshar zhig rna bar thos/ glo bur stod lang byas nas lta dus rang dang rgyang thag gzhung 'dom bcu grangs las med par dred mong gsum dri snom rgyag bzhin rgyug yong gi yod par mthong / khos lam sang gzhogs su bsnyal ba'i me mda' de bton kyang bod mda' ni 'phrul mda' dang 'du ba rgyag chog chog cig ga nas yod/ gzhan pas bya long med par me mda'i sgo ru de dred yong dang po de'i kha nang shed kyis btsugs/ dred yong gnyis pa des kyang me mda'i sgo ru nas zin te 'then pas kho'i lag nas be mda' dred yong la sgor/ dred yong gnyis kyis me mda' de phar 'then tshur 'then byed kyi yod pa dang /dred yong gzhan de the tshom med par kho'i steng du mchong rgyug byas/ khos kyang 'phral mar gri bton nas ya lan sprod bzhin pa'i skabs der me mda' 'phrog mkhan gyi dred yong gnyis

64 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//pos me mda' dang slo ru so sor phral rjes sa la g.yug nas kho la rub par yong gi yod par mthong / kho'i sems la dred mong gsum gyi lag tu thebs na kha gtad mi chog bsams nas ral gri thur bzung byas nas gyen du gros/ spyir dred mong dang thug tshe thur du gros na mig lngags thur du lug nas mthong mi thub pa'i khyad par yod mod/ da res ni dred mong gsum po 'og nas yar mchong bzhin yod pas thur du bros sa med/ rdo pha bang chen po zhig gi snang la 'dzeg nas mar blta skabs dred mong gsum yang pha bang de'i 'khris su bcar zin/ rdo pha bang de'i ltag pa gyen la sngas yod la steng du rgyag rdo che chung mang po nyil nas yod pas/khos gri sa la g.yug nas do che tshad cig blangs te kha gdang mche gcigs byed bzhin pa'i dred mong de'i kha nang du gzhus pas so na mas kyang gnam la 'thor nas gzhogs shig tu 'gyel/ yang skyar rdo gcig blangs nas gzhus pas dred mong gzhan thig gi mkhal ma'i ngos la phog ste cung zad rbab tu ril nas de ma nyid du thi/ khyad mtshar ba zhig la dred mong gzhan de sgrag thag chod nas bros kyang ma thub par rkub sa la btsugs te brang ngos kyi zhu ma chen po gnyis bstan bzhin lag pas phyag rgya yang yang byas/ 'on kyang 'a rdzog ni ya nga snying rje rtsa ba nas med mkhan zhig yin pas/ ‘ ltas ngan khyod kyis nga la dad pa'i phyag rgya byed na ngas khyod la gnang rgyu'i byin rlabs ni de ga rang yin/nyi zhes lag gnyis kyis klad la btegs pa'i rdo ril de mabo la gzhus nas lnga lam du btang / de nas ngal gaskusna gtogs tsam byas rjes ro bzhi po de ri sgang nas me zhing 'dud shul gyi gasgongs sa chen po zhig yod pa de brgyud de ri gzham du rbab tu bsgril/ der yul mi zhing pa mang po yod pa tshang ma ltad mor 'dzom pa'i dbus su khos zha ba dang dred mong bsad pa'i tshul rnams zhib cing phra bar bshad pas/ yul mi tshos kho'i gzugs po'i stobs hrag dang rjid nyams che ba de mthong nas gang bshad pa de the tshom med par ngos len byas pa ma zad/dzu kho ni lha 'dre'i sprul pa'am gzhi bdag gi brdzus bu zhig yin pa las 'gro ba mi'i bu zhig ma red/ 〉 ces gleng nas kho'i stobs rtsal gyi mtshan snyan de nags ri la mched pa'i me lce bzhin du yul gru du mar lhab lhab tu 'bar/

ja stag bar gyi gtam rgyud/ 65yang dpyid zla gsum pa'i nyin zhig gi gung gi char 'a rdzog tshang gi phyogs nas ki rgyun mar btab bzhin yod pa chu'i phar tshur dud tshang lnga drug cig yod pa de dag gis thos nas blta skabs/ 'a rdzog tshang gi sbra de ni yongs su 'gyel yod pa dang / zhib par ngo rtags mi chod kyang mi bcu grangs zhig ki rgyag bzhin 'dzing res byed kyi yod pa'i snang tshul de ni 'jigs su rung / nyi 'od kyi ngos las ral gri phar btab tshur bsnun byed pa'i bkrag mdangs kyis mig kyang rab rib tu gyur/ mi tshang de dag gis 'a rdzog tshang gi steng du jag pa babs par bsams nas/ phan tshun brda galta nga gis rta zin sga zin byas nas gcig rjes gnyis mthud du 'a rdzog tshang skyob par chas/ bltas na mig gis mthong thub kyang song na chu tshod phyed tsam 'gor ba'i rgyang thag gis chod/ yul mi zha mas der slebs skabs 'a rdzog dang khong gi gza' zla gnyis nas sbra 'gyel ba de yar phub bzhin yod pa dang / nye 'khris nems su mi brgyad tsam zhig khrag ral sku ga sku ga ngang ril nas sku da par mthong / zhib par blta dus de dag ni yul gzhan gyi jag pa 'ig min par lung pa de'i nang gi jag dpon a rdo ma spun gsum dang de'i a phrug rnams yin par shes nas skrag snang dang the snum gyi du bar tshud nas ci sgod 'di sgod med par lus/ 'a rdzog la lta dus lag g.yas pa'i mdzub mo gcig las khrag cu zad thon gyi yod pa las de min rma shul khrag rjes gcig kyang med/de ni gzhan min par zla shas kyi gong du jag dpon a rdo spun gsum dang / kho'i a phrug lnga/ 'a rdzog dang bcas mi dgu thun mong thog rnga phad la gzham nas drel kha shas yod pa'i tshong pa zhig 'phrog bcom byas/de'i tshong zog ni bu ram da nga /sna tha/kha dar zhe cig yin pas dngul sil mar tshong sgyur byas rjes bgo grabs kyis 'a rdzog tshang sar 'dus/ 'a rdzig nas de dag gi rin pa nas dgu cha gcig dgos pa'i bsam tshul bton kyang a rdo'i phyogs nas mos mthun ma byas par ‘khye da la brgya cha gcig gi phyed tsam las sprod mi 'os/ kyi zhes bshad/ 'a rdzig khong khro'i me lce mkha' dbyings su 'bar nas/ 2 nga la 'os tshod kyi thob skal sprod na spud sgog gal te spud 'dod med tshe nga tsho tshang ma sgo la thon pas cho ga rang gi skal

66 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//ba'i ched du zhi bar phangs sems spu tsam med/zi ces bzhad de go khri'i steng nas dpa' dam zhig bton te skad la gzer nas 'dzing chog ang sar byas/ tshul de jag da〈snan a rdo mas mthong ba na ( ha ha 〉〉zhes gad mo chen po zhig sgor nas/smyo ngas de snga phan chad mi srog rtsa ltar bcad/ mi rgyu sku sa ltar 'gam ste chab brag bosna gsum/ 〈sna star stosna gsum/ 'ba' li rgyal gsum/ snge nyag tre gsum/ khyung nag sku1ga gsum nang nga la kha gtad gathe ga snga da mkhan su yang med nas jag dpon 'es pa'i ming 'di thog pa red/ khyod kyis nga la gtug 'dod pa ni gzig tshang nang la gla bas 'pha gas tshag ba gyab pa dang gcig pa red/mi ces bshad nas slar yang ( ha ha mi zhes gad mo bgad/ 'a rdzig de bas khong khro che ru langs te/ ru gsum tshan mang po de bzhin ngas mi shes kyang gang ltar khyod tsho mi brgyad la nga'i mdzub mo brgyad las 'gul dgos don med/nyi ces bshad/ skabs der a rdo spun 'bring ba de ni khong khro tsha la ngar sla ba zhig yin pas/ kho mi gcig gis nga tsho mi brgyad la 'di ltar bshad phod pa ni ci 'dra'i shi na'ang khur mi thub pa'i brnyas bces shig ma red re bsams nas/ skad cha bshad 'o nga med cing slo la thon long med par ral gri bton nas 'a rdzog gi steng du bshar/ a rdo can gyis mi gcig gis kho'i kha gtad mi chog par shes nas kho tsho brgyad po dus gcig la 'a rdzig gi steng du rub/ 'a rdzig gis kyang ral gri thubs nas tsu ngas te 'jigs snang med par ya lan gcog rkyang byas/ phub pa'i sbra chung de ni sku ngas su 'gyel/ bkol ba'i ja thab bslogs pas thab gsur gyi du zhags 'khrigs/ sgo khyi nag po de'ang rgyang ring du gros nas ngu zug byed/ bza' zla sgrol ma'ang phar tshad du gros nas ‘ jag pas mi bsad thong /nyi zhes 'bod skad bsgrags/ mo'i 'bod skad ni sus kyang ma thos kyang pho rgod na mas ngar ba'i ki sgra ni de las gyang ring du khyab/ bza' rla sgrol mas phyis ltas bslogs dus rang gi zla bo ni da dung 'gyel med par lag res gri re bzung nas 'dzing bzhin yod pa dang / mi brgyad po de dag nas gsum 'gyel zin la da dung rim bzhin 'gyel 'a〈sna yi skusgod par mjophang / tshul des bza' zla sgrol ma spobs pa skyes nas sked la btags pa'i gri chung yu dkar de bton te

ja stag bar gyi gtam rgyud/ 67kha phyir bsgor nas rang gi zla bo'i 'dzing rogs su bshar/ 'on kyang mo 'khris la slobs pa dang a the can mi brgyad 〈sna thams cad 'gyel te sa la 'gre 1snag brgyab nas 1snad pa las su la'ang 'thab pa'i re ba med par gyur zin par shes/ mos rang gi rla bo ni sus kyang kha gtad 〈snag par mi zhus pa'i dpa' rtul zhig yin par shes nas dga' yang dga' la mig nas mchi ma'ang sgor bzhin gri chung sa la g.yugs te/ lcug phran ltar mnyen pa'i lag zung kho'i skad pa la dam du 'khyud cing / pa da ma'i 'dab ltar 'jam pa'i bzhin gyi mkhur tshos kho'i brang ngos su sbyar/ gang ltar de nas bzung 'grong thub 'a rdzog gi snyan grags de me 'bar ba'i steng du zhing gzhags pa bsnan pa ltar du gyur/da ni 'a rdzog bza' tshang gnyis phan tshun gcig gi gcig la lhag par brtse ba'i ngang /chu tshod kyis 'ag po nas/ zla bas lo'i stong cha na mas kha gsab byas zhing dbyar ston dgun gsum skad ci ga gis yol nas slar yang lo gsar pa'i dga' ston la rol bzhin pa'i nyin ngo shes pa'i mi thig 'ongs nas skad cha dum bu thig bshad rjes 'a rdzog khyo shug gnyis ni bsam ga'igs kyi rnyi dong nang du lhung nas lus/ yang snying mi de su yin pa dang des gang 'ig bshad yod med le'u phyi mar mthud rgyu yin//le'u gnyis pa/lding dpon ngang gis pho rgod bsdu rob skabs/pha ma jag pas bsad pa 'i rkun po bkras/rang nyid jag tshogs 'bod pa'i pho nya byas/da ni 'brong thub 'a rdzig gi bza' zla mngal sbrum nas btsas la nye ba dang / lo gsar pa 'i dasa' ston la'ang khel nas skusnad pas/ tsha/ tshong / rkun/ jag gang la'ang ma skusnang bar bza' mi gnyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig la byams zhing / gsar 'o'i tshes bzang dus bzang jig

skyes dman dang bu phrug yin stabs 'dzing mo 'pher ba'i mi bzhi las med pas/ snag ngar ma dang 'dra zhing shi rgyur mi sgrag pa 'i jag pa de tshor kha gtad gcog ga nas thub/ khong bzhi po re re bzhin tsam der/ a khu dar rgyas dgon pa 'i tshong dpon ngo g.yog bcu grangs zhig gis rta drel brgyad cu yas mas shig 'ded nas nam nyin ltos med du yong gi yod pa dang 'khel/ de dag ni kho'i bskyar btsas kyi 70 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//bton cing /zhim po'i zas ster/'jam po'i gos bkon/snyan pa'i gtam bshad de dre'u zhig la bskyon nas de zhub la chen po de yongs su brgal/ phyi nyin gung gi mtshams su khams ja stag gnyis kyi 'dus mdo/ rnge chu sngon mo'i zam so la slebs pa na/ a khya tshong pas kho la gnang sbyin gya noms pa zhig sprad de bshad don/ ‘ khyod rang lo shas ring 'di bar g.yog las 'du byed sa e rag gis sdod cig yo lnga drug mtshams nas do po bkal thub pa'i pho sar stag nang bzhin zhig tshar kyi red/ de skabs a khu tshong pas khyod rtsad gcod byed de rgya dkar nag gang sar nga dang dgos pa ni ci 'dra'i dang len byed thabs med pa'i gnad don zhig yin na'ang / zhu ba byas kyang phan thogs med par shes te lags sdu zhes pa'i brda la mgo bo gug tsam zhig byas nas mig chu lhung lhung phar tshur g.yog glas byas nas lo brgyad dgu zhig phyin kyang a khu tshong pa'i grib ma tsam yang mthong rgyu med cing / yul de'i bu po mig dmar zhes pa zhig la lan chags kyis sems pa yongs su sgor nas tshong pas rtsad gcod yong ba'i re ba de yang chung du phyin/ de nas rim pa'i 'grong thub 'a rdzig dang / a khu 'phrin las/srog bdag gnya' yu sogs dang ngo shes 'grogs 'dris byung ba nas khos stabs bde'i 'tsho ba zhig spyod 'go tshugs/ stabs bde'i 'tsho ba spyod stangs sgod 'go ma tshugs gong 'dir bshad dbo sa pa zhig la/ ja phad la brgal nas sku(nga na la gsham du slebs pa na lam kha de gnyis su gyes zhing / lto ru brkyangs pa'i lam gyi sne mo nas bltas na nga thog g.yu chu zhes pa shang shang dang 'ur 'ur gyi sgra ci yang med par g.yu 'brug mtsho la babs pa ltar/'gyar ma 'gyur gyis mdzes zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sbang ljongs rtsa thang rnams kyi gzhung

ja stag bar gyi gtam rgyud/ 71gzhags nas 'gro ba ni ci 'dra'i lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig red ang / 'grul pa rnams kyi mig lam du lta na sdug pa'i yul ljongs de'i bkod pa rnams khra lam lam 'char pa na nga tsho 'gro sa'i lung pa ni de min nam snyam pa dran srid/ 'on kyang de ni sngar stag gling g.yul 'khrug skabs blon zhwa dkar ldan pas gyad kyi mi brgya rta brgya khrid de so la yong ba'i lam shul yin kyang zer/ gling ge sar rgyal pos sum pa mdzo rdzong phab skabs mdzo pho ru ring gros pa'i shul yin zhes kyang zer/ gang ltar de ni dbyar dus ru lam dang / ston dbyed rnams su dgra lam dang jag lam tsam las de min tshong 'grul byed sa'i lam kha med/ stag ma la'i phyogs su kha nub la gtad de yong na nge lu sngon mo'i zam so ma slebs bar lung pa ring po zhig brgyud dgos la/lung pa de'i smad ni thang zhing nags tshal yin kyang rgya yangs tsam yod cing / stod ni rbad de spang gzhung gnam sngon sa la 'phos pa 'dra ba zhig yod/ bar sked kyi nyin ngos su shug pa rdzob la srib ngos su stag ma dang glang ma 'dres pa'i lam kha gu dog tsam sku da pa ma zad brag 'phrang lam ngan yang mi nyung ba 'ig sku1da/ shar phyogs nas ja phad brgyab nas yong mkhan zhig yin kyang de zhub lung pa der sdod dgos la/ nub phyogs nas stag ma brgyab ste yong mkhan zhig yin kyang de las brgal te bgrod mi thub/ der rten lung pa der lam 'grul zhag sdod byed mkhan ni ha lam chad myong med ces bshad na'ang 'grigs/da ni a 'phyar bkra rgyal gyis lung pa de rang gi mi tshe'i 'tsho gos thag gcod byed par las dbang gi bgo skal du blangs nas/ lam ma〈snan nyam chung rnams btsan 'grog dang /stobs che ba rnams tshugs sdod byed pa'i skabs dang bstun mtshan smag nag gi mun pa grogs su sbran nas gser dngul/ gzi byur/ rgya ja/ bod phrug do po ci tsam zhig brkus yod pa su yis bshad thub/ brgya yar 'gro stong mar yong su 'dra zhig yin kyang lung pa de'i nang nas ca dngos rku la ma sgor ba zhig ha lam med/der brten lam mgron tshos lung pa de'i smad la sgor ba'i lung pa dang / bar na sgor ba'i 'gag stod na sgor ba'i thang zhes bos pas ming de yongs grags su thogs/ rgya 'gro dbus sgor myong pa'i pho ngar ma su 'dra zhig yin kyang lung pa de

po nang la phebs zhiganyi ces bshad de lag pa nas 'jus te nang du gad na dungs/ thab kyi 'khris nas sgrol mas kyang dka' las 'dri bshad byed zhor ja drangs zhing / lug mgo dang gro ma/ sha mar thud ja stag bar gyi gtam rgyud/ 73sgod lhod kyis sdod dang / 'di ni nga'i khyim dang gnyis su med pas gang zhig za 'dod pa de len rkyang byed chog ces bshad/ 'a rdzog gis rtab rtob pos/ ci o'o phye mar lo gsar gyi/ri zhes bshad de yar thab kyi steng du spungs pa'i sder ma'i nang gi chur ba de bkyag bzhin/‘ nga la 'ebyu gsar gyi dgos mkho gzhan dag sku da kyang phye mar bzo sa'i rtsam pa med/ 'di phye sku da/ ces bshad /'a rdzog gis gad mo dang bcas/( deng sang sgor ba nang gi las ka de lam 'gro yag po byung yod sa red/mi ces sdus par khos kyang gad mo zhig dang sbugs/ 2drang po bshad na lam 'gro zer dus nga rang gis gang byas byas red 'dug ste/ chab mdo tshang dang mdo smad sa dbang gnyis kyis nga 'dzin bzung gis med pa bzo dgos pa'i bskasgod khyab mang 〈sna gto nga bzhin sku da dus bag phebs pa 'ig dang sdugs dal po zhig rtsa ba nyid nas mi 'dug stabs yag pa zhig la nye sngon yul 'di'i 'go ba bsgo gtong byas pa'i lding dakhrodan u pa tshang dang shag 〈sna mna' bzhag byas pa nas bzung blosna bde bag phebs byung la/lding dpo na tshang sar 'ange la gdan nyis rtsegs dang sum rtsegs byas nas kha sha chang dang mi bral ba bsdad chog pa byung / lding dpon khong ni dpa' bo pho rgod rigs dang shag po bsgrig rgyur dga' ba dang / dam tshig la rgya 〈snag ltaḥri krung mkhan 'ig dang rgyu nor la 'dzad pa med cing ser sna'ang med mkhan zhig red/ khong gis rtag par 'brong thub 'a rdzog dang shag po bzo 'dod sku da pa'i gtam bshad byed kyi sku da pa ma zad/ da res 'o/ gsar gyi skabs dang bsdun gal che'i mgron gnas su 'aro da rtsis byas kyang / khyod kyi bza' zla phru gu btsas ran pa shes rtogs byung nas skad ma gtong ba red/ 'on kyang khong gis da nges khyod gnyis la lo gsar gyi rten 'brel zhu bar 'di gar mar rdog gcig dang / thud ril gcig zha dkar gzugs gcig a rag grod pa gang / de min bza' zla na skabs spyod gyu rtsam pa dang / yus/ sbrang rtsi phran bu bcas bsgyur nas nga ched du btang byung / ring min bza' zla drag skyed byung mtshams

74 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//'bod mkhan gtong gi yin pas nges par phebs rogs shod ces nga la yang yang gsungs kyi 'dug ces bshad/gtam de thos pa dang 'a rdzog ni dga' yang dga' la ci sgod 'di sgod med par sde la ma'i gdong la blta tsam byas/ sgrerdzol mas mabo khrom g.yug g.yug byas te/ru lding dpon ngang tshe zer ba de ni chab mdo tshang gis bsgo gtong byas pa'i dpon rigs zhig yin pas rogs gzab gzab ma byas na chag sgo mgo thog tu babs dus 'bye da pa rtas mi zin/mi ces bshad de yid ches med pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ a 'phur nas mi sgrol ma khyod rang sems chung gis de 'dra'i dogs pa byed dgos don med/ khong yul 'di'i 'go pa mngags gtong byas nas 'o gcig kyang 'khor med na'ang kho rang ngo mas jag thengs gsum tsam bcad zin pa red/ khong gis nam rgyun gsungs ya la 2ngas dgra jag 'aX ga bcom byed pa ni mi tshang nyam chung na mas kyi khral rigs chag yang gtong thub pa'i ched du yin/ gal srid rang gi 'tsho ba'i don du 'a chad ñtsa thug gis thabs lam de 'du ma 'tshol dka' med byung ba na mas la gshin rje chos rgyal gyis kyang nyes pa gtong shes kyi ma red ’ces gsungs kyi yod/ chab mdo tshang gis bsgo gtong byas pa'i dpon po gzhan su 'du zhig yin kyang yul mi tshos dbyar la dbyar khral dang / dgun la dgun khral/ tha na chu dang me thing yan res mos kyis 'thu len byed dgos kyi yod kyang khong gis nga tsho'i lung pa'i nang nas khral spu 'jag cig kyang bsdu gi med/ nang gi g.yog las pa de tsho'ang rang 'gul gyi thog nas yong ba'am/ dang po nas khrid yong ba zhe cig yin pa las btsan po dbang skusnad byas pa gcig kyang med/ g.yog pho mo su 'du zhig yin kyang lding da pon rang dang mnyam za mnyam 'thung byed pa las za gyon la khyad par ting 'bru tsam yang 'byed srol med/ khong la yul 'di'i chen po dang phyug po rnams kyis brgya 'bul dang stong 'bul ji ltar byas kyang ngom pa med par len gyi yod kyang nyam chung zha mas kyis chur ba 'bo gang phul yang len gyi med/

red/ da dung jag dpon a rdo ma spun gsum dang a phrug kha shas/ ༷sag bdag spun gsum gasku(ga drug bcas kho nga gi 'khris su sdod sdod ma red/mi ces bshad/ gtam de thos pa dang 'a rdzog zhin tu dga' mngags pa'i don 〈snangs su 'grub sesnang snyam pa'i dga' tshor dang bcas slar 'gre ba'i snga bo na byas/ 'a rdzog gis sa thag ring tsam dbar bskyal nas grogs po'i lag mgo nas bzung ste/ 2 lding dpon dkar nag shan 'byed/dkar nag ces pa ni kha lnga ga gi khyad par 'ig yin kyang /dkar nag ces pa'i chig gnyis khrod de mi na mas kyis bzang ngan mtshon byed du bed spyod byed kyi yod pa red/ de yang mi de dkar po red dkar po dkar rkyang red mi de nag po red nas po nag rkyang red ces dkar po de bzang po'i dpal dang / ya rab kyi rgyan/ dung bden gyi dpang rtags zhig tu brtsi bzhin yod pa dang / nag po de de las ldog ste tshul ba'in ma yin pa'i skye bo ma rab cig mtshon thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang mi yi bsam blo'i dkar nag ni kha dog nang bzhin las sla pos shes thub kyi med pas mi mang po jig nas/ gang mang ba'i phyogs de dkar po dang /nyung ba'i phyogs de nag po red bsam pa dang/ khag ci ga nas/ gang srid gzhung gi langs phyogs dang mthun pa de dkar po dang / de dang ma mthun pa de nag po yin gyi red bsam gyi yod pa red/ de ni rtsa ba'i rgyu mtshan gang gi steng nas dkar nag 'jog dgos ma shes pa'i bsam tshul zhig red/ bcom lngan 'das kyis 'dzam bu gling 'dir thog mar chos gsungs skabs 'kho ra lnga sde bzang ngo zhes mi lnga las med par mu stegs sku gas ga'an pa ni ches zhin tu mang po yod pa red / skabs der ston pas dpe jig gsungs yod pa ste/ lung pa jig gi mi dmangs kyi kha la smyo chu reg nas smyos pa na khyal po'i kha la spyo chu ma reg pas sems gnal du gnas kyang / smyon pa zha mas kyis rgyal po 'di ni rang re su dang yang mi mthun pas nges par spyo ba 'ig go bsams nas kun gyis de ltar smras pas mthar rgyal pos kyang spyo chu 'thung dgos byung ba red/ ces gsungs yod/ dpe des smyon pa yin min de mang nyung la blta rgyu med pa bzhin/ gang jig yang dag pa yin pa/ gang zhig yang ma dag pa yin pa/ gang zhig

mang nas 'khang ra byed kyi yod pa dang / nga tsho shar phyogs pa'i khrod du'aju spyi tshogs gsar rnying mang po zhig gi nang rgyal khab mang po 'ig gi chab srid kyi langs phyogs nor 'khrul can bzung nas ches dbul phongs dang rjes lus kyi gnas su lhung yod pa des/ skabs de'i srid gzhung gi ches mtho'i mi sna mang po zhig da cha yang rgyal khab de dag gi mi mang gi khong khro'i yul du gyur yod/des 'dra bar dus rabs dang spyi tshogs ga 'du 'ig 'das kyang mi na mas

da shar nag shan 'byed/ 113kyis bsngags 'os su 'gyur gyi yod pa ni 'das pa'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus las dpog thub/dper na/ gzhan dag rgya nag pa'i gtam rgyud lta bur zhig bltas pa yin na'ang / sung rgyal rabs skabs kyi gzhung gi chab srid kyi byed po gung blon bzhi gtsos dpon ngan za ju ma can de dag gi bya spyod mthong ba na da lta rang gsod rgyu byung na bsam pa'i khong khro skye ba dang /de dag la kha gtad bcar mkhan rku ma dang / jag pa/ pyod 'o1ga pa skusnags kyi nyes ming khur nas bston khang dang / nags khrod/ mtsho gling rnams su gnas 〈snad byed mkhan de dag la gdung sems mnyam skyed kyis rgyab skyor byed dgos pa 'byung gi yod pa ltar red/ de'i phyir dkas nag gnyis po legs par ngos zin par byed de tshe 'di'i khe phan cung zad kyi ched du nam yang rdzogs dus med pa'i pham kha thig len mi nyen no//166/ gyi

de tsho 'grog pa'i pha skad red/khyod kyi a pha skal bzang red/de'i pa pha a mnye red/cag mnye'i pa pha yab mnye red/yab mnye'i pa pha sum mnye red/dgu nye tshun chad nye du red/a pha'i lhun mched a khu red/a khu'i sring mo a rne red/ khyod kyi a ma lha mdzes red/65 ma'i 65 ma cag bu red/a ma'i ming pho a zhang red/a 'ang sring mo a sru red/65 khu a ni cag 'ang dang /a sru na mas kyi bu phrug ni/khyod dang pha ma bu spun red/spun gyi bu phrug tsha bo red/tsha bo'i bu phrug yang tsha red/yang tsha'i bu phrug sum tsha red/dgu tsha tshun chad rtsa lag red/

116 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//khyod ni da lo o yo red/rgyab ma'i 'o/ la 6/ lag red /de'i rgyab ma khyi thong red/khyi yi tshe tshad lo dgu red/de tsho 'brog pa'i pha skad red /phag pa 11nga bu bya the gsum/grus na ci rtsi ro'i pas shes/mi rtsi na yang rong pas shes/de tsho 'grog pas shes le min/1(bye6byeji 6)

120 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//ga'is lus nge da nang gsar lam 'ga' mchis kyang //ngo bstod g.yo zol kha ta'i ag skad las//phyan tshogs sbrang char 'gug pa'i ko ki la'i//drug 'gyur rgyag pa'i rang dbang zhin tu phra//byes 'byor bod 'dir rgyal jus langs phyogs sogs//bsgrags pa'i gzhung 'brel gsar sgog 'ga' mchis mod//lo la cher dbang 'dzin mi sna 'ga' zung gis//na nga khul 'bur 'jom byed pa'i lag cha gyur//dmangs la hre nga po'i lam bzang ston mdzad pa'i//mtha' gnyis ma 'khyog tshangs pa'i thig shing chag/rgya ba srid blo gros g.yur du za ba'i gzhi//dge legs dmangs gtso'i myu gu gsar pa skam//la las gna' bo'i lugs 〈snal tsam 'ig gleng //'ga' zhig gzhis lus bod mi'i bde sdug tsam//de yang phal cher lung tshan re zung tsam//sgrogs pa dag kyang de tsam don yod min//chu bo bzhi las dbu ba dkar po'i rtse dga' dgod cing dge legs bye ba'i zegs ma 'thor//snang che na drug las 'dzad med nor gyi gter kha ba dol zhing gangs seng dkar mo'i rigs rgyud bkrag/

122 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//rnam dkar 'jug pa yangs pa'i lha yi lam//phan sems blo ga dmar mdzes pa'i myed rag can//lhag bsam chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i gur khang nas//drang bden sbrang char me tog zol du bsnil//sbyar char 'bab kyang mi 'dzin pa 'i// bye ma'i gling la sngo ljang med//bden gtam 'brug sgra mi bzod pa'i//the'u rang na mas ni brag la yibs//rogs skyob dbya khral smyos chus mi ngom 'ing //rang 'dod 〈snags lhung sna zhags ring brkyangs nas//chab srid rdzing bu dkrugs pa 'i glang po na mas//brtul byed drang bden gyo ba don po yin//mtho la sprel lad mi byed ci'i //dma' la khyad gasdu da mi byed par//gang la nyes pa de la bsnad//dung bden las kyi gshin rje 'dra//gyu skar dbus na blo ba dang //gser ri'i dbus na lhun po ba'in//gsar phredag dbus na drang bden zhes//grags snyan gzur gnas mkhas pas gleng //

drang bde na la bstod pa bcos min sprin gyi rol mo/ 123rjod byed tshig gi 'dab ma yang //bslu med drang sdudang bden chig las//rang 'ag da gzhan na mas phung byed pa'i//lngas si na 'ug pa'i rdzun chingaka min//brjod bya don gyi 'bras bu spo nga //bden don bdud rtsi'i snying po las//ci tsam dmur yang mi myang ba'i//rta rgas thi ba'i rus gog min //de lngar drang bden mchod sbyin mi 'dzad shar ri'i phrag gi nyi ma dang // yar ngos phyogs kyi zla ba ri ba'ig rim gyi bgrod cing 'phel ba la/sngang da nga log pa'i bsam sbyor 'char rnams nyid 'od reg pa'i ba mo dang //zla zer phog pa 'i 'dab brgya ba'in du 'i thing zum pa nyid gyur cig/drang bden/166/phyi zla dang pa 'i 'do na thengs nas zur du phyung pa'o//

khyed la sdang zug byed phod dam/de nas dmangs sasto tshags gsar 'grems spel mdzad rim la/rnam dpyod dang ldan 'ing blo gzu bor gnas pa mang po zhig gis dga' bsu thob yod la rang don phugs bcangs kyis skabs 'tshol ba khag cig gis de las ldog pa'i las 'gul yang spel yod/ 'on kyang /bstod pa sa nga rgyal gyis ma bsnyems zhing / smad pa dang sdigs ra skul yang dpa' ma zhum par tshags thog 'di bzhin 'don gnang mdzad dang / mdzad bzhin/ mdzad par 'gyud ba bcas kyi rlabs chen gyi dam bca' ni nam yang nub tu med/mi mang gi khe phan blos gtong ba la zhum pa med cing / rang don du gzhan 'chi ba la mi sgrag mkhan gyi dpa' bo na mas kyis 'di la 'jigs skul dang dma' 'bebs byed phod/dmangs gtso lags/ na ning chu sgang gi sgor mang dag cig 'don gnang mdzad skabs/mi khag cig gis 'di ni drang bden yin pa/ yid brtan 'pher ba/ gzhung nas ngos len yod pa/ khungs lung dang bcas par gsal bshad kyis tshags sgog 'di bzhin tshad mar bsgrub pa'i sgrub byed snyan po de khyed kyis go yod shag red/ de rjes khyed nas bka' blon khri pa dang /'os bsdu'i 'gan 'dzin gyi sgor 'don gnang mdzad skabs mi de dag gis/ 'di ni drang bden mig pa/ khrims mthun min pa/ da krerdzog gtam yin pa/ gceter bzhig yin pa/ khungs lung med pa / yid brtan med pa/7gong sa mchog gi dgongs bzhed dang ma mthun pa sogs kyi 'grel bshad rgyag kyin yod pa la ltos/ dmang sa gtso lags/ khyed la skyon brjod dang / 'a jigs skul byed mkhan tshang ma ni rgyu mtshan de dang de 'dra ba sha stag las byung ba zhig red/ khyed gi sa tshogs pa dang mi sger so sor phog thug 'gro min la ma bltos pa ra bod spyi la sman

khyed la snang zug byed phod dam/ 125thabs kho nas gang ci lhur len mdzad pa ni rang gi rgyal khab dang mi mang la sri zhu de las che ba zhig med pas de la bsngags brjod dang rgyab skyor yod/dmangs gtso lags/ khyed kyis chen wabyu rnams la gcam bu kho nas mgu ba lhur mi len zhing / nyams chung la khyad gsod dang 'jigs skul de bas kyang mi byed/ khyed kyis ma rung pa mthong tshe bshad phod cing / dam pa rnams kyi yin lugs kyang kun la ngo sprod byed/khyed kyis 'das pa rnams ngo spyod dang ma co(ngas pa la tshod dpag da lta ba na mas lag mthil du skyur ru ra bzhin bstan/ dmangs gtso lags/ khyed ni drang bden gyi tshangs pa'i thig zhing yin/ khyed ni slongs mun sel ba'i nyi ma yin/ khyed ni sgro skur gyi mdud brgya bcad pa'i ral gri yin/ khyed ni dus rabs nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i bod mi'i son rtsa yin/ a ma'i sto na gnas pa'i phru gu tshos ma 'ongs par khyed la bsngags brjod byed/dmangs gtso lags/ khyed kyi mdzad rjes ni nam yang nub tu med/ sa steng 'di na nyi ma ltar 'bar/mi rabs phyi ma'i snying la shes rab kyi 'od snang 'byin/a tsi/khyed la sngang zug dang sdigs skul su yis byed phod dam/dmangs gtso/1677/12/31 'don thengs nas zur du phyung pa'o//

126 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//dmangs gtso ni dngos po'i gnas tshod dang ran/de yang da skabs nga tsho bod btsan byol gyi gzhung 'di gcig sdud dmar sgog las gzhan mi gang zhig gi rang dbang dang thob thang la srung skyob thub pa'i lam bzang zhig tu skyod ba'in yod pa de la/ dmangs gtso dang / mang gtso gang zhig brjod dgos min sgor la dpyad rtso ma sna tshogs zhig thon gyin yod/ spyir bod kyi ming tshig dang tha snyad kyi gnad don ni bod kyi rig gzhung gi gnad don zhig yin pa dang / bod kyi rig gzhung ni bod rgyal khab 'di'i 'chi gson gyi gnad don zhig kyang yin/ khyad pa ra bod kyi ri ga gzhung ni tha na goms gshis tshun chad nas chos dang yo ngas su 'brel nas yod pa 'ig yin pas/ 'di che sa mtho'i srid gzhung gi 'gan khur rkyang pa ma yin par chos ba rgyud chen po ba'i la sogs pa'i nang bstan dang rig gzhung srung skyob tshogs pa khag gi khrod du'ang babs yod pa lta bur snang / bod kyi nang don rig pa'i tshig sgrub dang tha snyad kyi 'gros 'ig yod pa de dang ma mthun pa'i 'grel bshad sna tshogs byas pa yin na/ mthar tha skad mang ngo zhig 'di cho sa ༷snags nas bshad sngangs dang / 'di srid ༷ gas nas bshad snangs yin zer na sa khag gnyis su chags te /rgyal khab 'di'i cho sa srid zung 'brel la phan thogs med khar dka' rnyog ston ma 'ig yong nyen sku da/ gzhung chen po rnams ltar na/ dmangs 'es pa dman par 'byu ga pa'i dbang du btang yang / dmangs gtso zhes pa'i dmangs de dman pa la bo dgos don med de / spyir phyogs zhes pa bsgrub bya la go yang phyogs cho sa 'es pa'i phyogs de bsgrub bya la go mi dgos/de bzhin/don dam 'es pa zab mo stong pa nyid la go yang don dam bden pa zhes pa'i don dam de de la mi gokun rdzob ces pa de don dam las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad la go

dmangs/ gco ni dngos pa 'i gnas/ tshod dang ra na/ 127yang / kun rdzob bden pa zhes pa'i kun rdzob de de thams zhe da la go mi thub/'on kyang de dag tha snyad 'thad lngan du 'jog thub pa'i rig pa'i 'byu ga pa ra sbyor ba de'i tshe/ya gyal re re da sa snga ma'i don la steg mi steg gnyis 'byung bar shes dgos/ lar dmangs 'es pa 'di da man pa'i don la'ang go don med de/ rigs gang 'ig la mang nyung
