ba'ag dgos pa las de lngas ma ba'ag pa'i phyir dang mi la'ang dmangs rigs 'di rim pa gsum par ba'ag nas bram ze'i rigs de rigs ba'i'i grangs su ma bgrangs pa'i bstan bcos kyang du mar snang ba'i phyid ro/ /spyir dmangs rigs la rigs dman pa yin pas khyab pa sku da med kyang brtag dbo sa rte/ maro/ las/ khyim bdag gi rigs sa la lta bu yang skusnad do/ /'es gsungs pas/ de dmangs rigs mi na na rigs bzhi po gang yin 'chad dgos la/ yin na sā la ni zhing thams cad kyi nang nas che ba dang mtho ba ltar de nyid rigs kyang che ba dang mtho ba la go dgos pa'i phyir/mang nge sa bkur ba 'es pa'ang de skabs kyi mi dbang dug pa dang kha btsan pa mang tsam zhig tshogs nas rgyal por bkur ba las/ da lta'i dmangs gaphu'i lam srol 'di bzhin mi re'i ngo re'i rang dbang dang thob thang bed spyad nas min par gsal 'ing de tsam 'ig ni da lta'i rgya nag dmar po'i lugs 'di la'ang sku da pa sa nga tsho'i gzhung la mang gtso 'es brjod

128 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//dgos pa 'i sgrub byed du mi 'gro snyam mo/ /dbyin skad du ḍi mo ko re sī zhes pa rgya skad du gang zhig phab sgyur byas sku da pa de nyid slar yang bod skad du bsgyur ba las dmar lugs kyi 'asnga da tshul dang mthun pa ra bsgyur ba'ang min la/ dmangs rtsam dang dmangs gzhas zhes pa sdudags kyang rim pa 'og ma zhig la 'byu ga par bden mosnad/ de yang rim pa tshe(ga ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'jug par ma yin par rang gi zla ro rim pa bosnang ma la lho sa nas ches mang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa bston du med la/ gal te yin du chugs kyang sngar ma'i sgrub byed du mi 'gro ba ni gong du bshad pa lngar ro//de gnyis gang zhig brjod bde ba yang / phra ba phra ba'i mjug thog tu/ 'es sogs kyi skabs su sems phra ba'i 'jug 1snag de ma thag tu sems phra rags gnyis las phra ba bskyed sla ba dang / rags pa'i mjug thog tu rags pa bskyed sla ba gsungs pa ltar/ mang lnga bu sgra zhan pa 'ig gi mjug de ma thag tu gtso lnga bu sgra dug po 'ig brjod mi bde zhing / dmangs ni gtso dang drag 'an pha la cher mnyam pas dmangs gtso zhes brjod bde ba 'di byung ba yin no/ /mang gtso 'es pa'i tshig 'di klag tshe dbang med du ma'ang gtso lta bu'i sgra thon gyi 'dugargyu mtshan 'dis phra ba srid rtse nas rags pa 'dod par sgoms par 'jug pa'i tshe srid rtse'i lci da chung dgas par ba shad pa da gzod dngos po'i gnas tshod yin par shes so/ /spyir ming tshig ke ra spru da sogs gang la'ang brjod bde zhig dgos pa ni thon mi'i dgongs par sems shing / mang gtso zhes brjod na mang po zhig las mi re'i ngo re'i thog nas dmangs gtso'i khe dbang dang thob thang sogs cha tshang ba jig 'grel bshad byed rgyu yang khag po yin snyam ste da dung yang das da pa ra bya'o//dmangs gtso/166ca/3/31 'don ther sa nas zur du phyung pa'o//

gna' deng zung 'brel gyis 'jig rten 63bkatra/ 'jib/ 'i/ ba'urgatra/ pa/mthong dang thogs pa'i reg byas stong zhing mtha' dang dbus zhes su dang gang gis tshad bzung mi spobs nam mkha'i dbyings//dag dang ma dag 'byams su bklas pas gcig dang gnyis zhes 'o/ dang bskal bar brjod mi zhus pa 'ji ga rten khams//me dang chu sogs 'byung ba na mas kyi stobs dang nus pas rags dang phra ba'i go la sna tshogs tshom bur bkod//stod dang bcud kyi bye drag mtha' yas rten dang brten pa gnas dang rgyu ba'i rang byung dkyil 'khor de la 'dud//byed pa po med brten nas byung / /ga'ig pa po med brten nas 'ig /chags dang 'jig pa'i 'khor lo can//da nga byung khams la gzigs mo spro//rgyu ni sngon du ma song bar//'bras bu 'byung ba mi srid pas/ /'jig rten 'di las byung ngo zhes/ /thog ma brjod pa mi dus kyang //sngon gyi dus su bskal ba ni/ /dga' ba ldan pa zhes bya ba/ /nyi zla dang ni rgyu skar da nga / /mi yi 'gro ba dag kyang byung / /mthar ni rgas shing 'thor ba'i tshe/ /mu mtha' bral ba'i mkha' dbyings su/ /phra rab rdul na mas so sor las/ /gong bu ci yang yod ma yin/ /tshogs pa'i shing rta gsil ba na/ /yan lag sku sku ra gnas pa ltar/ /yan lag de dag na mas gsil na//rdul phran so sor gnas par byed/ /de ltar yun ring gan sa pa las/ /phra rab de dag g.yos gyur te//gcig gi phyogs su gcig 'gro bas//slar yang 'du ba'i sbyor ba brtsams//phra rab

130 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//nye rgyu las yin na//ce la las shes pa'ang skye 'gyur bas//stong pa'i bskal ba na mas su yang //phra rab du la tshogs yod par 'thad / /rtag dang mi rtag ji ltar yang / /phra rab 'di dag cha med phyi ra/ /rang gi rigs 'dra gnas pa la/ /gegs byed pa yi dngos po med/ /phra rab bdu na la du la phran gcig /chung dul de bzhin 'bring dang che/ /rags dul bdun la nyi zer gcig /de yan mdzod pa'i lugs ltar rtsi/ /rtsom byed dul phran brgya lhag skor/ /bshad pa des kyang 'bring du la las/ /chung dul dag kyang mthong min na/ /ce la phra na phra rab smos ci dgos/ /kha cig phra rab yan gar du//gnas tshe mig gis mi mthong yang //bum sogs rags pa'i ngos bltas tshe//phra rab dag kyang mthong bar 'dod//khyod kyi lag pa'i sor mo'i ngogs//gzugs can srin bu grangs med na/ /khyod kyis mthong ba cang yod dam/ /med na phra rab mthong ba 'gal/ /phra rab phan tshun sbyor ba na/ /ngos dag reg par mi 'gyur yang / /chu sogs 'dzad pa mi 'gyur bar/ /bar du rlung gis bkag ces zer/ /rlung gi phra rab de yang ni/ /sa yi de ngos mi reg pas//chu mi 'dzad la des ci phan//reg na de dag cha med nyams//slar yang de'i bar lce nga gis bkag /de ltar bas na thug med pas/ /khyod kyi sa yi bum pa 'ig /stong gsum 'di na shong mi 'gyur//dul rnams dbyas su 'du bzhin du//rim gyis rim gyis dwangs snyigs phye//dwangs ma steng du 'gro ba snge/ /snyigs ma na mas ni 'og tu lhung / /dwangs ma la'ang dwangs snyigs te/ /rang rang go lar grub pa las/ /'og min la sogs mas rim ba'in/ /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu drug chags/ /snyigs ma la'ang de bzhin te/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pho brang dang / /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i gnas na mas dang / /lha min gnas 31gas mas rim chags/ /snyigs ma'i nang nas rags pa 'ga'/ /nyi ma la sogs me skar dang / /phur bu la sogs rlung skar dang / /la la 'khyag pa'i skar ma dang / /kha cig drag rdo 'ba' zhig snge/ /phal cher rigs mthun tshogs pa can / /khams drug ldan pa 'jig rten te/ /gsum nas lnga tsam lngan pa'ang yod/ /nyi ma la sogs brtan skar la/ /rang rang 'khor skar rnams kyis bsgor//'khor skar la yang 'khor skar te/ /de dag lci yang nyid kyis yin/ /nyi mar 'khor ba lo yin

gna' deng zung 'brel gyis 'jig rten chags 'jig la bltas pa/ 131la/ /rang 'khor zhag yin nye ring dad / /mgyogs dang bul ba'i khyad par las/ /lo dang zhag grangs ma nges gyur/ /'khor skar spen pa'i lo gcig la/ /nyin mtshan nyi khri lhag 'byung yang //spa sangs la ni nyin mtshan gnyis/ /'dzam gling 'di na sum brgya 'das/ /rnam rgyal bo la'i lo gcig la/ /phur bu'i lo ni bdun yin zhing / /'di na mi lo brgyad bcu lhag /de bzhin drod sogs khyad par ldan//yar ngos tshes gcig zla ba ni//nyi ma dang ni nye bar gnas//rim gyis rim gyis rgyang du 'gro//des na dkar cha rim gyis gsal//ji ltar yar ngos bco lnga na//zhub nas nyi ma nub pa dang / /shar nas dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /bar gyi 'dzam gling 'di nas mthong / /de yang thad dar gnas pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer 'dzam gling 'dis/ /ji tsam bsgribs pa de tsam du/ /zla ba gza' yis 'dzin zhes zer/ /mar ngos gcig nas nya yi bar//slar yang nyi ma'i phyogs su 'khor/ /ji tsam nyi ma dang nye ba/ /de tsam rang nyid sgrib par byed// nyi ma dang ni 'dzam gling bar/ /zla ba thad dkar slebs pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma gza' 'dzin zhes zer yang //don la zla bas bsgribs pa yin //'jig rten nyi zla 'dzin pa na//lus med gza' yis bzas pa dang / /lha dang lha min 'khrug ru /'i gtam/ /snyan ngag pa yi gna' sgrung tsam/ /de yang rig byed byed po 'gas/ /rdzun gyis 'jig rten rmongs pa byas/ /zla ba'i 'od zer bsil lo zhes/ /dged pa med par 'jig rten smra/ /don la tsha ba'i reg bya ste/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer ldog pa nyid/ /'od zer 'phro zhus med pa yi/ /gzugs can rags pa thams cad las/ /'phros pa'i 'od ni grib ma ste/ /grib ma'i ngo bo mi gsal ba'o/ /khyod kyi lus las grib ma ni/ /phyogs brgyar mnyam par 'phros gyur kyang / /phyogs gzhan nyi mas bathe ma pa na/ /rang gi gzugs dang mtshungs par snang //nyi ma'i 'od zer pyi ba pa na//phyogs rnams kun las grib ma 'byung //des na 'jig rten mun gyis gang / /mun dang grib ma srab mthug yin/ /mi yis gzugs dag mthong ba la/ /nyi ma gsal byed ji bzhin du/ /'byung pos gzugs rnams mthong ba la//mun pa 'di ni gsal byed yin/ /mi la gzugs rnams bsgribs pa yi/ /sgrib byed mun pa mthong ba bzhin//'byung pos nyi 'od mthong ba yis//gzugs na mas de yis bsgrib par byed//

132 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//mar me rang gis rang gsal yang / /mun pas mun pa sgrib ci dgos/ /mun pa rang gsal ma yin na/ /mar mes mun pa mi gsal zhing / /gsal byed gzhan yang med pas na/ /khyod kyis mun pa mthong mi 'gyur/ /ri bos ri bo bsgribs pa na/ /sgrib byed ri bo mthong ba bzhin/ /mun pas mun pa sgrib pa la/ /sgrib byed mun pa mthong ci 'gal/ /kha cig mun pa 'phros pa yi/ /bu ga nag po yod ces zer/ /nyi 'od 'gog pa'i khebs yod kyang / /mun pa 'gog pa'i yol ba med/ /yang na nyi 'od rags pa ste/ /mun pa 'di ni dwangs ba nyid/ /dwangs ba rags par mi thogs zhing / /rags pa dwangs ba la yang min/ /lha dang mi yi khyad pa 'ga'i/ /lus la mtshon sogs bsnun pa na/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' la brdegs pa bzhin/ /thogs pa med phyir de gnod min/ /de la 'jig rten 'ja' lus dang / /mtshan nyid pa yis yid lus dang / /na la 'byor dzul 'phrul ces bshad kyang / /don la dwangs gzugs brnyes pa yin/ /bar do'i lus ni dwangs gzugs phyir/ /ri brag thogs med thal byung 'gro/ /gal te yid lus 'ba' zhig na//dbyibs dang kha dog ldan pa 'gal/ /lha 'dres dwangs gzugs rnyed pa'i phyir/ /sa la rkang rjes mi 'byung zhing / /nyi 'od thogs med rgyu bas na/ /lus la grib ma med ces grags//'dod pa'i me yis bsam gtan gyi/ /skye dngos 'chig mi zhus gsungs pa/ /rags pas dwangs ba mi reg pas/ /yin gyi sra ba'i phyir ma yin/ /rags pas dwangs ba mi reg bzhin//rags pas dwangs ba mthong ba min//khyod kyis lha yul blta 'dod na//lha yi mig dbang thob par gyis/ /rags pa'i dbang pos ma mthong bas//lha sogs med par smra ba ni/ /lag mthil gyis ni ma mthong bas//ri bo med par smra dang mtshungs//1664 1

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/gleng gzhi/dgun gyi grang rlung 'ur 'ur ldang bas dpyid kyi me tog dang / dbyar gyi 'dab ma/ ston gyi 'bras bu thams cad dang bral zhing nyam nga ba'i rtsi zhing na mas ni grang ba'i ngar ma bzod par shur sgra yang yang du 'then/ rlung nag dang sprin nag lang long du 'khol bas rtsa du la nam mkha' la 'tshub cing bya rigs rnams ni skad ngan 'byin ba'in rang rang gi tshang du gros/'dzad pa med pa'i kha ba'i 'dab ma lngab lhub du babs pas sha shed nyam pa'i ri dwags dang sgo tsu gas de dag ni phal cher 'tsho ba'i re thag chad/ drod skyed kyi nyi ma yang nub ri'i phag tu bzhud pas 'jig rten khams kyi skye dngos srog chags yod tshad kyi las skal dang re ba thams cad ni smag tu gyur/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i rang byung khams kyi cho 'phrul de'i khrod du bkra shis dang / mgon po gnyis nas brel 'tshub ngang nor lug rnams lhas rar sdud zin nas nang du 'o1ga dus/ a ma ni do dgong gi gnam gshis des byas pa min nam/ nam rgyun gyi kha yag 'dzum mdangs de med par gdong la dngangs 'tshab cig sku da pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis me chen po zhig btang nas dgong thug bkol bzhin 'dug a pha nyi ma ni khams gsum 'di dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du sngar nas mthong zin pa'i nyams zhig bstan rte/shug pa'i tho bus bzos pa'i phreng ba de bgrang ba'in me'i 'khris su re ba rnga rtsid kyis brgyangs pa'i 'bol gdan ya gcig gi steng du bzhugs 'dug tshang ma bab bstun gyi gdan la 'khod rjes ja phor kha shas btung pa dang / ( po ta la yi gnas mchog nas/〉 tshes pā pas dbu bkol te dgong 'don sgrol ma tshar bcu gnyis de ser ba brgyab pa ltar 'don pa'i skabs/ 'byung ba 'khrug pa'i bgegs 'tshub kyi sprin nag de zhi nas bde skyid kyi nyi ma zhig

134 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//mgyogs myur shar ba'i smon lam brgyab skusnad pa ni phal cher gcig pa yin srid/ dgong thug 'thung bzhin pa'i skabs der mgon po'i sems la 'gro ba mi na mas ni 'di 'du'i khang bcas me btang / gos gyon zas g.yos byed thub kyang sems can dud 'gro sgo phyugs dang /ri kwa gas bya byi'u sogs ni grang ngar bu yug 'di 'dra'i na nga dka' sdug ji ltar myang gi yod dam snam nas bcos min gyi snying rje zhig skyes pa dang / ya nga sding rje bral ba'i rang byung khams kyi gdug rtsub de la mnon mi thub pa'i khong khro 'ig kyang skyes nas dbang med du kha nas tshig kha shas ldab ldib tu bshad/ don de go ba na pā pa sa da ni rang gi bshad snying 'dod pa'i gtam de 'bo 'dzugs par mtshams sbyar ba'am gleng bslang ba'i phyir yin kyang srid gang lngar bshad don/ ‘ bu/ mi zer ba de blo gros kyis phyug pa zhig yin mod mi la myang ba'i dka' sdug ni nyung nyung zhig dang chung chung 'ig gtan nas ma red/ a pha yang khyod rang tsam sku(da dus gnam gzhis 'di las sdug tsam nang mtshan mo gcig pur nga phad la brgyab nas thengs mang po skusnang myong /mi zhes bshad par/ mgon po nas (a pha khyod de 'du ga re byas nas yong ba yin/mi 'es sdus pas/ a pas khor gnyis kyi gdong la blta yag cig byas te lag pa sa me gtong zhes pa'i brda thig byas nas rang gi mi tshe'i nang dka' sdug gi khur po ji 'du zhig khur dgos byung ba'i skor sgod 'go tshugs/le'u dang po/pha ma shi zhing khral 'ul rgyug pa/ nga tho'i pha rgyud ni lnga'og nas chad pa zhig yin la de nas yar 'ded na chags med la thug giyod pa dang / chags med kyi stod pa 'di ni bod kyi khyal po 'od sdud ṣ+katsun pa gnyis smad phyogs su yong ba gcig lhung kha'i gyal pobyas pa dang /gcig bar khams 'dir bzhugs pa ngom lhagadong bul pozhes grags pa'i rgyud pa yin zhes dod grol yod pa red/ rgyu mtshan ji yin ma shes kyang nga'i pha ma gnyis ni

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring po/ 135rang khyim dang bral nas gang sar 'cham khyode byas mthar sa cha 'dir yab tshang ma'i nor ma byas nas skyid med sdug med kyi mitsho zhig bskyel bzhin lojo nyi zhum zin tsam phyin pa'i skabs der/ lung pa 'di la dud tshang gsum ba'i 'ig las med pa de la nad ngan zhig phog nas mibacu tsam zhi ba da nga nga'i pha ma gnyis kyang nyin gcig gokhyon rjes byas nas grodas pa red/ khyad mtshar ba zhig la nad ngan des mi rgan pa ma gtogs lung ba la gnod kyi med pas lung pa 'di la mi rgan pa gcig ma gtogs lhag med/nga tho'i nang giche ba ni om ni pad cha〉 wamozer ba 'ig yod pa lo 1/yin pa dang /nga lo1cadang /nga'i thog ma 'ig yod pa lo14tsam yin gyi red/de'i sog la da dung gsum yod pa 'i nang nas chung shos de ni zla ba kha shas las red med/ de ltobyar chag sgochen po'ig globur mgathog tu babs pa'i dus der/ skrag che na rgyug rgyu med/ sdug che na ngu gyu med/ zer ba ni dngos gnas bden pa red 'dugangs pha ma'i phud posas sa'i sa dong 'grubacin pa'i skabs der g.yonas 'dzin mas ba'o gi 'dug kyang 'dzirnams nas dri ma re bsnam 〉'phags mchod brgyab nas ba'o bcug gomi 'dugar co bzhus na snad yam byed yong bsams nas bzho mi dgos par btang thog lab pa yin kyang mo rang nas ngu ba' (pho ma med na phyagangu nas bsdad kyi 'dugad ngas ga re o dgas red/nyi ces ྾ ba dang khyim gyi nang nas kyang phyaga'aga' yis a pha dang a ma tshes 'bod de ngu saphyire byas byung bas ngas ci zed med nas samathud de sa dong brus pa yin/ nga rang tshang gcig pur mig par grod pa mitshang ga'an dag kyang gcig pa gcig rkyang red/ ltagazi tshang gi6tshe brtan zer ba 'ig lhag yod kyang kho rang gi nang la'ang 'gro ma phod par chu phar ka la bsdad nas gagu che ba rnams la rang gi pha ma dur 'jug byed stangs rgyang 'bod byed spyin bslabs kyi yod/pha ma'i phung po sa sbas btang zin la ma zin gong nas nged tshang re ba zam khar zla ba gcig ring rta bram gyi khral phog 'dug pa'i lan 'byor byung / rta zam 'es pa ni bod dus su 'grul lam sa tshugs re re nas re re bar rta khral rgyug dgos zhing skabs re a drung 'es pa'i bang che na kher rgyug dang / skabs re ci yin mi shes pa'i da pon g.yog mang po mnyam du yong gi yod la thon mchan nang gsal rta drel gra sgrig gis khor tsho 'gro sar rta'i bram rnga/

136 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//'dzugs dgos kyi yod pas de la rta zam zhes zer/ de yang khong tsho yong ba dang thon chog chotsheg dbosnas pa las phran tsam 'gyang pa yin na'ang da ni dmyal ba mi yul du slobs rgyu yin pas zla ba gcig ring sa tshugs der rta bzung bzung mar sdod dgos kyi sku da/ gal srid nga rang rta bram la song ba yin na khyim gyi dka' ngal de lha mo gcig pus gno nga len byed thub thabs med pa dang / ma phyi na na ni sngar bka' blosan bla ma byams pa bstan dar nas rkang lag bcad btub kyi khrims bcod btang lugs 'jigs ye re ba zhig bo cadang sku da pas skrag kyang sgrag nas ci bya galta la bral du gyur nas mig nas mchi ma chad tshuphang med pa'i lha mo'i gdong la balnga tsam byas pas/ lha mo nas dzu khyod rang rta zam la sku nga thig ngas 'dir ci drag byed chog gal srid ma song tshe bston 'jug lta bu'i nyes chad phog pa yin na skabs der nga rang ni rang zhi rgyag gi yin/ phru gu tsho/ phru gu tsho/nyi tshes skad cha'i mjug sdud ma thub par ngu ba'in 'dug de ni nad mug ge'i sgang la zla lhag zer ba de red/ da ni 'gro stod gnyis las 'gro ba las 'os med par bsam nas khral rta sgal pa ring po 'ig sku da pa de khrid de sems sdug gi phyi ltas kya'i ma zhus pa ra rta zam la phyin pa yin/nga da nga sa tshugs la slebs pa'i phyi nyin mo nas gdan chung gi go gnas sku da pa'i dpon gasku ga lnga byung bar rta drel bcu dgos 'dug pas rta zam ga'an tsho phyin pa red/de nyin gyi da bong mo nyi ma ri rtser bzhud skabs der a drung gcig 'byor byung ba der 'ag sdod byas song /spyir a drung kha shas kyi sked rag la dam phrug brgyab yod pas nyin mtshan stos med du 'gro dgos kyis yod pa dang / kha shas ni de tsam brel ba med pa de 'dra yang yod pa red/a drung 'ag sngod byas na rta zam pa la dka' ngal chung yang gra sgrig byed stangs 'grig min la bslad de za 'dod kyi rnyog du mang po yod pa dang tha na gnas mo zer ba 'ig kyang gra sgrig byed dgos kyi yod pa sa/ rta bram 'go pa rgan po zer ba 'ig yod pa des ni a drung de dag da lta rang song na ci ma rung snyam gyi yod pa red/ de nub rgan po nas ( bya khyod sang nyin 'gro res 'khel 'dug na 〈sna chas nyung tsam khur na 'grig gi red/ rang gi sgal par khyad dbo sa pa las

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/ 137rta la shad sa sku1da pa ma red/ lam bar a drung nas gang zer lags sku legs sdu gyis ma gtogs dung na sdug gyong red/bros ba sogs ma byed ma gtogs nga tsho tshang ma 'gro sa gcis las yod pa ma red/ ces bzhad byung /phyi nyin 'og zas legs par bzas rjes rta la sna chas byas nas a drung la sprad de/ ma go la lug chung tshar dkar gyis bzos pa'i zhwa po dang rkang pad phying lham 〈snan/ mig la gangs phyid mi theb pa'i rnga ma'i do ma ra jig bcings/ lus la lā ba dkar po'i tsu ra ba phu dung ring po yod pa zhig dang ra lpags kyi gos thung bar rta med pa zhig gyon/ khyab tu gro chas phran bu las grub pa'i khur tsha khur/ sked par ko shubs kyi nang du yu ba shing las byas pa 'i spu gri tsheg btsud/ las tu dbyug pa ran pa 'ig jo ga nas gom 'ing chen pos a drung gi rjes su song / lam bar nas khos nga'i gri de la yang yang lta gi 'dug kho rang la me mda' yod pas gri jig la mi sgrag mod 'on kyang do snang 'ig slebs kyi sku da pa 'dra/nyin gung tsam song rjes khos d+ku la/ci ge/khyod rang gi khur tsha de ljid gogo tsha po 'dug na 'dir rta la bkal cho sa bag leb kha shas 'dir rta thog la 'ib zhib chags kyi 'du ga pas rang gi am bras nang bcug sgoganyi zed nas nga la bag leb chung chung kha shas zhig sprad byung ba de ni gasku sgyu jig yin par ma shes par khotsheng ni mi sems bzang 'ig red 'du ga bsams nas rulags so 〉 zhus pa yin / cang ma 'bor bar tho chab dron sgang gi sa tshugs 'grul khang de mchodang gi 'dus pas khos rta la lcag gis brabs nas 〈snan la phyin sku nga / nga rang 'grul khang der 'byor ba dang rta de ka ba 'ig la btags 'dug zho drung gang kyu ltad do ba de sanyis ni nga tsho mthong ba dang the tshom med pa ra mchong sku nga gi 'dug snabs yag pa 'ig la nga tsho sa gad mtho bar slobs sku da pas tshang mas dus gcig la ki ba khyab nas sngo rub btang bas lam sang yar mcho nga ma thub par grog rong zhig gi nang du 'dzul/ gro stong de nga tshos mtha' bzhi nas bskor te gzig dang khyod zhi nga gson gyi 'dzing mo byed bzhin pa'i skabs shig la lung pa der 'brug grags zer ba'i pho sar skad grags chen po jig sku da pa des mchong thengs gcig la gzig gcig gi rnga ma nas zin te ngar skad brgyab nas mar 'then gyi 'dug tshul de mthong ba dang sngar gyi don gnad cig la bsam gzhigs ma thub par lam sang sta re khur nas gzig gi mabos la gzhu bar song ba yin/ nga gzig gi 'khris la slebs pa da nga rgyab nas mi zhig gis (sta re'i so gzhus na gzig pags gro brlag 'gro gi nged de las sta re'i mgo to gzhus kyi zhes 'bod kyin 'dug de'i bar la khos gzig wod pa brten snga re gzhu long med par nga ni gzig gi 'og tu tshud zin nas mgo'i pags pa yongs su dbral ba da nga lag g.yon ma'i dpung gong gi rus pa dang bcas pa 'ib 'ib bzos zin 'dug spyir gzig dang zhi mi gnyis ni gcig pa yin pas rnga ma nas 'jus zin na mdun kho nar 'then pa las phyi ltas bslog shes kyi med/khos gzig glod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni ga'ad min par nga thog mar kho tsho'i lung par g.yog po 'gro skabs/ kho ni blo khog chen po dang stobs shugs yag po red zer nas skad grags kyis lung pa de'i pho sar chung ba sems kho la sgrag nas kho rang gis gang byas red

148 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//'dug nga ni zhi na'ang phangs sems med rkyen ya lan bslog rkyang byed de kho la mgo rtsa ba nas sgur gyi med/lkog tu mi kha shas nas nga la bstod bsngags btang nas yang bskyar kho dang gtug dgos pa'i bskul ma byed kyi yod par brten kho dang thengs kha shas 'dzing myong ba'i gting nad yod pas da res khos ched du go skabs bzung ste glod pa zhig red/ 'on kyang khos rdzu gzig gi gzhug spu nas zin de 'then pa'i skabs mi tshos gzig la bzhus pa'i rdo kho'i lag par phog ste gzig sgor song rnya zhes bshad yod 'dugayang thengs gcig nyin gung rdzi bo la song nas dgong por lhas rar slebs dus 'bri bzang po zhig yod pa de tshang med par shes byung / nam rtsa dgun kha yin stabs sbyin bdag nas/2 do dgong 'gro thub kyi ma red/sang 'ogs pa snga po langs nas rgyugs/spyang zhis 'bri g.yag bsad dus lhusgogs pa snga the1 bsad kyi red/ mtshan mosna 'bri g.yag na mas nyal ba'am kha khar sdod kyi sku da pas spyang kis mthong mi thub la mthong yang bsad mi thub/ ces bshad byung / khos bshad pa ltar sang snga po langs ste kha sang 'ded sa'i lung pa'i phu la 'gro dus 'bri de ni spyang ki bcu tsam 'ig gis thur la 'ded bzhar glod yong gi 'dug de ring spyang ki de tsho sgrag snang chen po 'ig bskur dgos bsams nas nga rang rdo pha bong chen po zhig gi phag tu gab ste bsngad/ 'bri de ga'ogs nas mad rgyugs zin pa dang lam sang spyang zhi'i gdong la mchongs te ki chen po 'ga' brgyab rjes dang thog spyang ki thams cad sran phung 'thor pa ltar bros song /gang 'tsham nas kho tshos nga la tshur 'ga' bltas rjes rnga ma g.yug pa dang ngu zug rgyag bzhin nye sar bab ra sku nga gi 'dug sems la dngangs ma skrag gis dre sa na ni lam la 'khyag pa chags skusnad pas sbyang ki mang po de 'dra'i lag nas thar mi thub pas da ni pha 〈snang chen 〈sna 'di la rgyab gtad de gri gzhu yas las thabs shes gzhan ci yang med/ da res gri de yang yag po jig med pas ci 'dra byed yong bsams nas sku da pa'i skabs der spyang ki che ba de nga'i steng du mchongs nas pags slog gi phu dung ya gcig dbral te phar tshad rgyugs pa dang / yang tshur mcho ngas sku1nga nas pags chosags mtha' nas kha gang dbral te phar tshad

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/ 149rgyugs/ mthar spyang ki mang pos res mos kyis 'khor lo bskor ba ltar byas pas pags slog dang gos thung na mas yongs su dbral nas dmar greng mar gyur song / gri ni ji tsam bzhus kyang mi chod la btsugs kyang mi phig pas da nges spyang kis kha zas byed par the tshom mi 'dug bsams nas dgun gyi zhogs pa'i grang ngar nang nga ni dmar greng mar rdul nag sgor bzhin yod pa'i bar der sbyang ki rnams ni rnga ma 'do ba la bcug nas zhud zhud du gros 'a〈sna gi 'dug khyad mtshar gang yin nam bsams te phar tshur bltas dus la phar nang gi sgya ba bzhi lnga zhig gis phung po zhig mdzo la bkal nas dur 'jug byed par yong bar nga'i 'khris su slebs zin 'dugad ni dred mong gis nang khrol bsngogs pa dang / gzig gis rus gong gzhib pa/ spyang zhis dmar hrang phud pa sogs gtam rnyog bsgyur te gsham du song na/ nyin ma gcig la spun mched 'og ma de dar rtse mdo nas yar 'khor byung / kho ni lag do phyin rjes tshong dpon gyis ma rtsa g.yar te sgor du sger tshong gnyer du gcug pas da cha drel bcu grangs nyo thub pa ma zad/ de min gyi dngos chas kyang mang po khyer 'dug pas nga gnyis kyis mi zhi khyim stong du ma bzhag par sngar shul du slar yang 'jig rten khyim sa bzung bar rta nor bcu grangs zhig nyo sgrub byas te mna' ma zhig bsus nas chang sa stabs bde zhig brgyab pa yin/ de nas bzung ste zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs cha mi snyoms pa de'i nang dka' sdug myong ba'i mjug bsgril ba red/ces bshad pas bkra zhis dang mgon po gnyis nas mgo lcog tsam re byas te da ni pā phas skyid kyi nyi ma shar ba'i sgor zhig sgod rgyu'i re ba byas nas gdong la mig mi 'dzum par lta bzhin bsdad/ 'on kyang pā phas/ 'khor ba khab kyi rtse mo la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa'i lung drangs te gung khran ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang du'ang ches mi spyod las 'das pa'i gdug sbyong sno tshogs btang yod pa ni sngar ma las kyang rgya che ba/ dza dug pa/dngangs skrag che ba/thos pa tsam gyis 'jigs g.yer ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis bla 'dar ba/ bsam pa tsam gyis sgyug mer ba zhig yin tshul bshad pas khong gnyis kyang

150 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//'jig rten 'di la re thag yongs su chad de mgo bo dkrug dkrug dang shug ring nar nar du lus/ yang snying pā phas gung khran ring lugs kyis mi spyod las 'das pa'i gdug sbyong ji lngar btang tshul le'u phyi mar bshad yong pas der gzib/sa par 'tshal//le'u bzhi pa/rgya mi mthong zhing dmyal ba'ang ma〈snang ba/pā phas mu mthud de/ da ni lo bcu grangs zhig phyi gshegs brgyab ste bshad na/ mi khag cig mgo yi zhwa mo dang rkang gi lham sgrog yan chad g.yug ste mde'u med pa 'i me mda' re 'drud nas/ spyo rgya mtha' mi yong gi 'dug rgya mtha' mi yong gi 'dug ces 'bod ba'in dbugs nyal te kha nub la gtad nas bros yong gi yod pa de dag ni sngar 'bri chud sa srung 'gro dus d+ku tshor gzi brjid chen po ngom myong ba'i lha dmag de dag dang yul dmag khag cig bcas red 'dug don de go ba na nga tsho'i lung pa'i smad nas dmag sum brgya tsam bsdus te grong pa dang rgyang khad ring tsam gyi sa la dmag slar brgyab nas bsdad pa red/ spyir dmag sum bgya ni mang po zhig min kyang lung pa de'i mi 'bor gyi sum cha gnyis zin yod pa dang mi tshang pal cher ba'i bud med dang phru gu ma gtogs pha bu yongs rdzogs dmag la phyin yod/ yin na'ang phar dmag gcig kyang rgyag 'o1nga med par mtshan sngadro gcig la rgya mis phyi nang rim pa gsum gyis bskor te nam langs pa dang dus gcig tu me spyodags dang me mda' drag char 'bab pa lngar chu tshod bzhi tsam ring brgyab nas mi lta bzhag sbu gur yan mde'us brtsab te lag mthil tsam yang lhag med par/ dmag sgar 〈snad du thal dul lang 'o1nga 'khrigs/ /lung pa'i mad 'a nas khrag gi chu bo rgyugs/ /gzhis lus ma bu ngu sgra lhang lhang ngang / /yul de skyes pa pho yis stong par byas/ /tshul de lta bur mthong ba na mtshan gnyid lam nang du'ang dngangs skrag skyes zhing 'dog dgos pa zhig byung /

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/ 151nang 'gyel yod pa nang du khyer nas dran pa sos pa'i thabs shes spyod ba'in pa red 'dugagazugs med bar snang gi sgra de ni rtsa gsum lha yi lung bstan zhig min par nag phyogs bdud kyis gzugs med zhi ba'i dbyings su bgrod par bar chad btang ste nga la mu mthud sdug bsngal myong du 'jug rgyu'i ched yin pa 'dra/ da ni khong tsho nga la dogs pa za nas lta srung nan po byed kyi 'dug la khong tshos nga la bcol ba'i yid ches dang brtse dung de dag gis bsam blo gsar pa zhig rnyed pa red/ ma gzhi da dung lo gcig 'dang nges kyi sha mar yu ra ba sogs lhag yod pas 'phral du za rgyu'i dka' ngal de tsam med rkyen 'o gcig lhag de ltar du bsngad pa yi na/ mtshams re mi la rogs pa 'dra byas na 'o dang 'o ma sprad kyi red/mtshams re khong tsho rta nor ched dka' ngal sha thang thang gyur kyang nga tsho ni bag med sos dal 'dra po de 'dra yang byung / 'on kyang rang 'dod kyis mthong phyogs zhig yin yang srid pha ma med pa'i dwa phrug dang rgyu nor med pa'i sprang po la mi tshos gang byas kyang thong chung dang brnyas ba༄snas 'dra nge 'ig ma〈snang nas sems la rma kha yang yang snga da nas khengs pa zhig nam yang yong mi thub/ skabs zhig dgon pa'i gra khral bsdu mkhan slebs nas phru gu chung ba gsum gra pa byas pa red/ khong tsho 'o1 na chung bas sems la 'khreng pa zhig byung yang gcig nas ma 'ongs par nga la myang ba nang bzhin gyi dka' sdug las gasku1la thub re dang / gnyis nas pha ma 'das po'i rgyab tu phan pa'i chos zhig yong re dang / gsum nas da lta'i khyim gyi gnas stangs bcas la gzhigs te khosgong gsum dbosnan par btang ba yin/ de nas nga tsho che ba gsum po bar skabs zhig ring sems kyi dka' ngal cung zad yang du song ba red/ mi tshe ci 'khyol ngang yud tsam thig gis lo ngo kha shas 'das zin/ da ni cis kyang de ltar khungs 'khyesgol thabs med pas lha mo ni mi tshang gcig gi gasku1ga mosna byas nas bsngad mthar mi tshang de'i mna' ma lta bu gyur pa dang / 'og ma de ni nga las kyang gzugs stobs hrags stabs tshong pa zhig gi lag do byas nas phyin pa red/ nga dud tshang gcig gi g.yog po byas nas bsngad pas skabs re rdzi bo byed dgos pa dang skabs re zhing kha yang las dgose

152 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//de rjes spun mched 'og ma de dang rogs pa mi gcig bcas nas drel kha shas 'ded de lha sar 'gro skabs 'gu ro zam par slebs dus chu pha rol nas rgya mis don med du me mda' 'phangs nas rogs pa de bsad pa dang drel na mas 'phrog rtsis byed skabs khos bzod sgom ma thub nas tshur 'dzing yod 'dug kho la mtshon ma song stabs lam sang rgya mis bzung ma thub kyang mthar mde'u rdzogs te gri khur nas 'dzing pas rgya mis tar skud kyi zhags pa brgyab ste 'dzin bzung gis lam dkyil du rkang lag phyar pa la brgyangs nas me mda'i a zhing dang rdo rdzog bzhus te bsad pa red/ kho rang la mtshon ma song ba des sdig pa'i kha lho na rgya dmag bcu gsum bsad pa dang rang la mnar gce da 〈snal ba zhig las phan thogs ci yang byung mi 'dug don de thos pa na nga ni sems gnal du mi gnas pa lta bus mal du nyal yang gnyid mi khug bzas na zas kyi bro mi myong par gyur song / nga yi sring mo de yang sems sdug dang rgya mir khong khro lang bzhin pa'i mur nga tsho'i lung par rgya mi sa khra 'god mkhan red zer ba zhig yong bar kho mos nang du bos nas ja dang 'o ma sprad rjes kho'i lus la lin krung yod stabs bya thabs gzhan ma rnyed par gdong 'khru sa chu tsha po dung pan nang spud de gdong la yi tsi byug pa dang mnyam du mgo la sta re bzhus nas bsad de sha lan len pa'i khul byas pa red/ don gnad de ring po ma thog par rgya mis shes dogs byung ste 'dzin bzung gis dang thog zhag po bdun nang srog thog gtong rgyu gtan 'khel yang de nas kho mo'i khog par phru gu yod 'dug pas de ma skyes bar 'jog gi yin zer/ gang ltar ma bu gcig kyang rbad de go rgyu thos rgyu med par khrid song bas de ni rgya mis bsad yod par the tshom med/ chung chung skabs nas pha ma gnyis dang shi bral byung bas ma tshad da ni phu hūṃ che rim nas shi ba'i ro dang gson pa'i mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu med par gson bral 'gro dgos pa'i las ngan pa ci zhig bsags pa yin nam snyam ste rang dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di la yid ches dang re thag sku(ngas su chad de/ nub ma nyal mig la mchi ma 'khor/ /sems bsam pa sdug gi mun chu 'khrigs/ /sdu nga yar lang rgya la chig pa za/ /yid bsam zhing bsam zhing zhe zha 'khrug/

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/ 153de lta bu'i ngang nas da dung dgon par yod pa'i hūṃ bo gsum gyi gnas stangs la sems phral yod mus rim pas dmangs gtso bcos sgyur dang / rig gnas gsar brje zer ba sogs mang po zhig byas song / bcos sgyur byed par phyogs mtha' dbus mang po zhig nas ngo rgol byas yod la/ bla dpon/ mi drag phyug po khag gi rang la dbang ba'i sa khang / rta nor/de min pha tshe bu ring bsags pa'i dngul dngos yod tshad 'phrog bcom byas yod pas khag kyang med pa red/ 'on kyang rin chen rigs phud pa'i sa zhing dang sems can mang che ba ni de dag la ngal rtsol rgyugs mkhan zhing bran nam sngo ra zer ba dang /nor ma zer ba/ rdzis pa zer ba'i nyam thag mi mang de da ga la babordzo 'grem byas sku1da pas rgyu bdag nge sa ma〈snang sar mtsher snang dang mi mthong sar dga' snang skyes pa zhig kyang byung pa red/ yin na yang zing 'khrug nod 'jags zer ba zhig dang sbrel te yong dus rgyugs pa leb dung gi dpe ltar yug gcig gi rdung rdeg phogade 'dra'i skabs zhig tu dgon pa'i grwa pa mang po 'ig bkag nyar gyis khyim la 'osgog bcug gi med pa'i skad cha 'ig go gyu 'dug pas/ zho mar chur ba phran bu zhig khur nas grwa pa gsum por blta tsam byed par chab mdor phyin pa yin/ chab mdo ni phyogs mtha'i lam kha tshang ma rgya mis zin skusnad pa dang zam pa yang bsrungs nas mi gang byung gtong gi mi 'duga'on kyang nga ni khur tshong ba'i mnyam la snang med lce phyin pas bkag bsher 'dri rtsad byed mkhan ma byung bar dgon par slebs song / nga rang der slebs pa dang rdo bcal gzhung zhes sngar dgon pa'i 'cham rgyag sa zhig yod pa der mi tshogs mang po 'dzoms nas rnga bdungs pa dang / dar dmar phyar ba/ skad brgyab pa skusnags kyis mi gsum la 'thab rtsod gtong bzhin pa'i sgang red 'dug de'i nang nas sngon ma mtshan nyid mkhan po byas pa red zer ba'i dge bshes shig 'dug pa de'i lag pa re la thag pa sbom po re btags nas mi bcu tsam gyis phar 'then tshur 'then byed de 29khyod kyi nag nyes ngos len byed dgos/mi zhes 'bod kyin 'dug kyang khong ni dun med du brgyal te nag nyes ngos len zhu ga la thub/ mi gcig po de'i

154 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//kha nang thag pa blugs te rgyab tu mdud pa brgyab nas shugs kyis bsdams te sgang nas co na bzhin 'dug gcig la khyad mtshar ba ni shel dang dkar sku la bcag pa'i phye ma'i nang du pus mo 'dzugs su bcug nas rkub la khab btsugs te ( nag nyes ngos len byed dgos/mi zhes 'bod kyin 'dug la da dung rdo dang rgyug pa gzhu ba la ni tsham tshom tsam yang mi 'dug nga'i sems la 'tshab sha langs nas spun grwa gsum po gang rung zhig dang thug 'dod kyis de las g.yol te tshogs chen 'du khang gi phyogs su 'gro du sa mi ro bcu tsam zhig gi rkang par thag pa brgyab nas mar 'dud yong gi 'dug la ro gnyis ni grwa pa'i yin par mthong rjes de bas dngangs 'tshab che ru phyin nas ma〈snags myur sngar khong gsum sdod sa'i grwa shag der rgyugs phyin pa yin/de phyogs kyi grwa shag tshang ma ni sgo lcags kyang bgya ba med la sdod mkhan gyi mi yang med/ nang du 'dzul nas blta dus mi 1snad mkhan med nas ha lam rla ba kha shas phyin pa lta bu thal rdul dang sdom thag gis gang 'dug pas yang bskyar tshogs chen 'du khang gi phyogs su tshur rgyugs yong dus sngar bzhin mi ro gnyis mar 'dud yong gi 'dug nyang sang zhing ci bya gtol bral gyi skabs der dgon pa'i 'du khang gi bya 'dab 'og tu dpung rgyan dmar po dkris pa'i mi zhig tho se langs 'dug pa de ni phal cher de gar las ka byed mkhan zhig yin pa 'dra/ kho nga la 2 nga'i spun gcig pa'i grwa pa gsum 'di gar sku da pas gcig thug thabs 'dra byed rgyu yod na ngas khyod la drin lan 'jal thub pa byed kyi yin/mizhes lab dus khong nas 2 da khag po red/ ma gzhi pho gsar khyod ga nas yin grwa pa ga 'du zhig yod/kyi ces sdus byung / ngas de don zhib par bshad de rgyu gal srid ngo thug ma thub kyang mig gis mthong tsam zhig ma byung phyin cho sa bzod pa mi 'dug pas ci drags na/ 〉zhes zhu ba yang yang 'then pas khong nas blta yag cig byas rte/ ‘sna( na dog khres de zur 'ig la bzhag nas phyags ma 'di khur te nga'i rjes la shog skad cha 'dra 'dri mkhan byung na nga'i nye du yin pas 'dir gad brgyab bcug gi 〈snad ces bshad na 'grig sgo phye nas nang du 'gro ste blta sa med kyang khang steng gi rab gsal nas mar bltas na skusgod med ma〈snang shas che/ mabye gas dro

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/ 155'gro ma gtogs de ring gi tshogs 'du de grol na de nas dgon par mi gang byung yong bcug gi ma red/ da lta 'dir mi mang po 'tshogs nas mi drag tsho la 'thab rtsod byed pa dang de min btson pa gzhan tsho la'ang skad 'bod rgyag ste zang nge zing nge 'du po 'du khang gi yang steng de bar mi mang po 'gro bcug gi 'dug na mgyogs po 'gro/mi zhes bzhad byung bas thabs shes gzhan med par kho'i rjes su phyin pa yin/ dang po tshogs chen 'du khang de ra 'gro dus bston pa la lto sprad sa red zer ba'i sgo chen de la i khung zhig phug 'dug pa dang 'khris su srung bya dmag mi mang 〈sna 'dug khang pa'i khro ga kha la phyin te rgya ma〈snangs nas mar blta skabs khang pa'i nang ni rbad de mis gang sku da pa dang / sgo nas yar bcug dus ma chud pa rnams steng gi ma〈snangs 'khor nas mar g.yug ste rdza ma'i nang 'bru blugs pa ltar byas 'dug mi gcig gi sgang la ma tha mi bdun brgyad kyis mnan 61da stabs sna(ga ma thams cad mi zhi ba ga la bsngod thub/ nyung mthar yang nyin re mi brgya yan man zhi gi yod 'dug la dzu mi zhi 'dug mi ces skad brgyab pa na dmag mi bcu grangs tsam gyis me mda' dang thag pa khur nas zhi sku1da med la ma ltos pa ra de dag gi mgo la rdo ga pas rdzis nas yong ste ro nems phyir 'bor gyi 'dug nga'i spun mched yod med mthong mi thub la zhib par sems kyis blta bzod pa dang dus pa rtsa ba nas mi 'dug pas phyir don yong ba yin/ 'du khang de'i nang sngon ma grwa pa stong phrag ba'i lhag 'tshogs dus lha da 〈snad chags kyi sku da pas da ni de'i nang mi ji tsam zhig bcug yod med su yis shes/ de min grwa tshang phal cher ba'i 'du khang nang de dang gcig pa byas nas bcug 'dug dge 〈snang grwa tshang gi 'du khang nang rim pa ma〈sna ba'i mi sna rnams bcug 'dug la khor tshor 'tshogs 'du'i skabs 'thab rtsod gzed rgyu de ma gtogs 'du khang nang de tsam gyi tshang kha mi 'duga'on kyang da dung mi khyu dang khyu byas nas 'dzin bzung gis khrid yo nga gi 'dug pa de dag kyang 'du khang de dag nang snon rgyu las de min rgya mir bston khang yod pa ma re da/ dgon pa'i 'du khang de dag ni brtan cha che la bcon khang nang bzhin nag khung chen po zha stag yin stabs rgya mir phan thog chen po byung yod/ de 'dra'i khrod du pa'i grwa

156 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//pa gsum po gson pa'i re thag chad de zhi ba'i ro zhig mthong na'ang blo bde bar bsams nas sgor lam rgyab log gi mi ro g.yug sa de blta khar song ba yin/ der lung pa chung chung zhig yod pa de la lug ra mju zer zhing ling der mi ros gang 'dug da lta yang bskyar blta dus mi 'bum kha shas med na gang thub yas mi 'dug kyang de skabs rbad de gang nas 'dug pa dang kha shas ni ske la gzi byur mang po btags pa gser rna brgyab cing gos chen gyi phyur ba gyon pa de 'dra'ang 'dug da dung 'ga' zhig ni phal cher thi i yod na bsam pa de 'dra'ang 'dug mtshams re mig 'khrul te thams cad 'gul ྅rted brgyab byung snyam pa lta bus skrag snang skye dgos pa zhig 'dug pas zhib par blta zhus bral ba zhig red/zhi ba'i dgon de drag po'i khrims rar bsgyur/ /rnga dung dar phyar khrims gcod 'jigs su rung / /rten gsum lha khang na mas ni bston khang byas/ /mi rnams 'bru ltar blugs pas nems te zhi /zhi ba'i mi ro 'dud pas sa thun ral/ /gasgong gsum bem ros bkang bas 'bur du dod/ khrag med srog dbugs sdud pa'i khrims gcod 'di/ /'jig rten mi yul dmyal ba'i khyad chos nges/ /de ni ngas mi yu la gyi dmyal ba mthong ba thengs dang po de yin/ gang ltar skabs der grwa pa gsum gyi grib ma tsam yang ma rag nas tshur log yong dgos byung /de rjes zhig la grwa pa che ba de tsha ba sgom mda' la brdzangs song zer ba go byung bas yang bskyar chas ka phran bu zhig khur nas yong bas chab mdo la slebs dus dmag mi'i mo gror zhig nang khur rogs byas byung / spom mda' la babs nas rtsad gcod kyin 'gro dus lung pa zhig ni btson pa dang dmag mis gang yod pa dang / btson pa mi gnyis re cha byas nas thong bsgol btags te 'dud 'then gyis spang na mas slog bzhin 'dug pa ni zhing kha bzo ba red zer/ de ltar cha dang cha byas pa brgya phrag mang pos thang chen po 'ig ling der gang 'dug sa 'og nas rtsa dum dang rus pa 'dra po mthong yong dus bston pa mang po tshang kha brgyab nas ril 'gro gi 'dug la de skabs dmag mis me mda'i a zhing bzhus nas nyes rtags yang rag gi 'dug ma gzhi khong tshor nyin ma re la lu khol ka yol chen po do re las

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/ 157gzhan pa'i zas rigs gcig kyang med pas las ma'i zhor du rtsa dum dang rus pa sogs kyis 'tsho thabs byed dgos kyi 'dug khong tshos bshad dus (rus pa ni dum bu las kyang yag cing lo ji tsam song yod kyang rdos bdungs nas chu khol nang bkol na zhag rtsi skar ma kha shas don rgyu yod la de 'thung nas nyal na de nub gnyid skyid po khug thub 〉 zer/ ches sems phangs pa zhig la nga'i spun grwa pa de ni nga slebs pa'i snga nyin rang la grongs 'dug la bem po de 'khris kyi zam pa'i 'og la g.yug 'dug zam pa de ni bston pa rnams mtshan mo sdod sa dang nyin mo zhing kha las sa'i lam bar 'khel gyi yod stabs bston pa mang po zhig zam pa de'i steng du shi gi yod 'dugade ni chu de'i ngab kyis rlung slong ste mgo yur 'khor nas ril 'gro gi yod pa dang / gal srid ril ba yin na de nas zhi ba las skyob thabs kyi sman dang zas gcig kyang med pa red/ der brten zhogs pa phar 'gro dus dang dgong dag tshur log dus zam pa de'i sgang gcig pur nyung mthar yang nyin re bston pa nyi shu tsam shi gi yod 'dug btson pa de dag ni bla ma tshos chos bshad dus yi dwags zer ba zhig yod pa gsungs gyu de dang 'du bar sgra rnams ser po chags nas gyen du 'dzings pa/pags pa rus pa la 'byar zhing rtsa rgyus na mas phyir mngon pa/ mig gnyis sgong du debs shing mchu dang lag par se kha dod nas skrag snang yang byed dgos la sems kyi gting nas yid mug pa zhig dang snying rje ba zhig kyang chags 'dug da ni ngas grwa pa'i phung po de sa gtsang zhig la bskyal nas chas ka phran bu sku da pa rnams der skusnad btson rngu kha shas zhig la sprad nas nam nyin ltos med du log yong ba yin/de ni ngas mi yul gyi dmyal ba mthong ba thengs gnyis pa de yin/da dung chab mdo nas btson pa zhi 'phros rnams mo kra dang mo kra byas nas ngal rtsol bskul bar sa cha gzhan dag du dbor bzhin yod pas/ de rjes zhig la grwa pa 'bring ba de mi nyag khog la brdzangs song bar go byung / mi nyag ni sa thag ring zhing khyim la skyes dman dang phru gu ma gtogs med cing skabs der rgya mis ru ba yang yang spo bcug gi yod pa sogs kyi dka' ngal la ma ltos par/ yang chas ka phran bu zhig khur nas grwa pa gsum 〈sna gcig

158 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//dang yang ma thug na nam yang blo bde po zhig yong ba mi 'dug bsam nas phyin dus sde dger slebs song /der mi nyag gi bston pa de 'drar nang mis chas ka bsgyal nas yar 'khor ba de tsho'i nang nga tshe'i lung pa'i rgyab nas yin pa'i ngo shes pa de tshos bshad dus/ (mi nyag nang la btson pa 〈snang phrag kha shas sku(da pa dang las ka mang la za ma med pas mang che ba mug shi thebs kyi yod pa dang / lhag par kha sngon zla ba gcig tsam gyi gong la btson pa spu ga brgya yas mas 'ig la zas med nas nyin ma mang por sdu nga rkyen/ nyin zhig glo bur du dmag mis bkag kyang ma khosgog par nye 'gram gyi 〈snang gseb pa'i sran zhing nang 〈snar nas sran ma rgyag tshad re bzas stabs sdeb gcig tu zhi yod 'dug de ni lto med nas ring por song ba zhig gis dang thog nyung nyung za ba las thob ste mang po bzas pas zhi ba red zer/ stabs nyes pa zhig la khyod tshang gyi grwa pa 'bring ba de'ang de'i nang yod 'dug de min gcig ni chab mdo rang nas grongs 'dug pa dang gcig ni tsha ba spom mda' la brdzangs pa red zer der rgyus yod kyi bston pa tshos bshad kyi 'dug kho rang tsho ni grwa pa yin pas sdug po zhig yong gi ma red na sems khral byas kyang phan thog sku da pa ma red/ de las nga tsho cha la yar 'o ga na dga' gi red/mi ces bshad byung /don de go ba dang nga la sems sdug gi sprin nag mig chu gi sprang char/ skyo gdung gi shur sgra bcas phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'tshang nas bsdod pa las bya thabs ci zhig sku da dam/ da ni pha ma gnyis nas spun mched lnga pos 'jig rten 'di la gyes 'jal zhus te gtan du kha bral song snyam pa'i skyo gdung ni ci 'dra'i che ba 'ig yin na'ang / da dung re thag rkang gcig ma chad par lhag skusnad pa ni lha dang bla ma rnams kyis nam zhig sdug bsngal mtha' dag las sgrob kyi red snyam pa de red/ 'on kyang rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa 'i gnam sa mgo rting bslogs pa'i drag char rlung 'tshub de 'i khrod du rten gsum lha khang thams cad brag ri thog gis gtor ba ltar bcom ba'in yod dus da ni shes bya'i khongs nas re sa skyabs yul zhig brnyed mi thub bsam nas sems pa stong lhang lhang gis 'ji ga rten 'di la re thag thengs gnyis pa de chad song / nyin zhig glo bur du spun grwa pa

mi tshe'i dka' sdug ring mo/ 159chung ba de thob ste log byung bas shi gson 'phrad pa'i dga' ba chen po byung / kho rang ni sngar chab mdo btson khang nas shi ba ngos len byas te g.yug rjes ro'i gseng nas slar dran pa rnyed de mtshan mo gros byol song nas lo mang ring ri la gab g.yol byas mthar nang la 'o/ga skusnang ba zhig red/ slar yang 'dzin bzung ma byung tsam byung yang mi mang kung hre'i skabs mi rnams la za rgyu med nas rta sha dang / khyi sha de min ri bong gi sha phyi ba'i sha sogs kyis 'tsho thabs byas/ co(na kyang kho nga nas grwa pa byas pa nas sha bza' gi med pas da ni zhi na yang bza' gi min zer te mthar grongs pa red/ mi mang kung lha'i skabs su mi yul gyi dmyal ba thengs gsum pa de mthong ba dang myong ba gnyis mar yin pa de tsho ni ngas bshad mi dgos par khyod gnyis kyis kyang mthong ba de 'dra red/ da skabs dbugs sna cung zhig ltod pa yin yang mi yul gyi dmyal ba bzhi pa zhig mi yong ba'i nges pa med/ yid ches med/'jig rten 'di la yid che sa med/ dus nam yang yid ches med/ ces bshad zhor sgo la don nas blta dus skya rengs dang po lha'i lam gong mar shar zin par mthong/ /1664 2

rgyang ring gi pho brang dmar po/'di ni smra brjod kyi rang dbang yin la/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul yang yin/ skyo shas kyi mchi ma yin la/ gdung 'bod kyi ngu ngag kyang yin/ gna' bo'i rdo ring zhig gi 'khris su mnga' khongs kyi bdag dbang dang / dmag don sa tshigs sogs la zhib bsher gnang zhing /ma lha(ngas par rgyal khab sra brtan gyis ② ba 'bangs rnams ga'an gyi bran gasku1ga tu mi 'gyur ba'i thabs shes phugs gya nga ring po zhig mno bsam gtong bzhin pa'i lha yi sras po zhig dar dmar pos thod bcings nas krong nger langs myong la 'gyel yang myong / khyod kyis bdag tu bzung ba'i yul gangs can pa na mas la byas nyes dang sdig nyes phog tshad khyod kyi steng du g.yogs te dus rabs kyi khug so zhig na lang mi thub par mnan yod pa ni ci 'dra'i khrel med cig red la/ de las skyob thabs zhig ma byas pa ni de bas khrel med cig ma red dam gangs can pa'i bu rgod tsho/ khyod ni rang gi mes po rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / sku gsung thugs rten nems me la bsregs pa dang / chur bskyur ba/sa 'og la sbas pa/ rab byung zha mas bsad pa dang phab pa sku gas kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ming tsam yang mi grags pa bzos pas mthong mi rung ba'i dam nyams dang / thos mi rung ba'i sdig can/ brjod mi rung ba'i gdug 'dre/ smon lam log pa'i bdud rgyal mgo la dwa yod mkhan zhig red/ ces zer/ 'o na btsan po 'ga' shas nas gnam gyi khri bdun sogs yab mes snga ma na mas kyi mchod gnas kyi da gon sde bzhigs pa dang /chos byed mi sna bsad pa dang sgyugs pa sogs gna' bo'i rig gnas la gsar brje dug po byas pa dang / dga' ldan pho brang la srid dbang thob pa'i yas mas su'ang jo nang dang / lhag par bka' brgyud kyi

gyang ring gi pho brang dmar po/ 161dgon sde mang po rtsa gtor btang ba'i shul da dung mngon yang de dag la chos rgyal dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gi cho lo gnang nas/ jo zhag na ma pa gsum dang / gtsug lag khang rnam pa gnyis dang / bsam yas/ khra 'brug sku gas ni dkyil ma rdibs/ zur ma nyams par da dung yang 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs mus kyang / de dag gtor bzhig btang ba'i lo rgyus kyi khrims thag lci mo 'ig khyod la phog pa ni ci 'dra'i ham bshad dang phyogs lhung gis khrims gcod btang ba zhig red ang / jo bo rje bod na byon skabs kyang rgya gar las lhag pa'i bka' bstan bod na bzhugs shing / rgya gar la med pa'i rgya dpe yang mang po zhig bod na sku da par gsungs pas na de dag snga 'gyur gyi skabs las 'os med pas/ lha sras dar mas mer bsregs pa dang /chur bskyur ba de dag slar ldog pa jig yin nam/gnam nas babs pa zhig yin nam sa nas skyes pa zhig yin/ lhag par bla chen 'khrungs pa'i phyi 'o'i lcags bya la dar mas srid dbang bzung ba 'dod pa ltar na/ bstan pa 'o bdun bcu yas mas bsnubs pa khyed cag gis 'dod/ de nas jo bo ma byon bar gyi dus yun thung ngu zhig nang sngar rgya gar na med pa mang po zhig glo bur du phab sgyur byas pa red/ ces skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs sku1gas la bsam gzhigs ye nas ma byas par ham bshad kho na byed rgyu yin nam/ yang na nyi ma'i zer las babs ba'am lha 'dre'i 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa zhes pa'i rtog pa 'char yan gyi lha sgrung zhig bshad rgyu yin/ lha sras dar mas rab byung bsad dang phab pa ma yin gyi rab byung zhig gis na bza'i 'og nas lkog mda' 'phangs nas rgyal po bsad de rang nyid kyis rang nyid phab par su yis bston/ lha lung dpal rdor phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa yin na de drag gi/ de min rgyal khab chen po zhig gi bde sdug la thugs khyar chen po ba'es pa'i khya la po 'ig sgog tu bsad ba ni ci 'dra'i nam mkhar mi sgong ba'i sdig nyes bsags pa zhig ma red dam/ rgyal po 'di smon lam log pa'i gnag rdzi'i byis sgrung 'du ba de dag khyed cag gi khungs su 'dod na/ rgyu mtshan des rgyal po 'di bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor sgyur zhig tu mi 'dod ba'in du khas len dgos par 'gyur te/'char

162 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//yan gyi gna' sgrung de dag las bshad pa ltar na/ rgyal po 'dis skye ba snga mar bal yul gyi mchod rten bzhengs/ de nas bod kyi rgyal por skyes/ de nas la dwags kyi rgyal por skyes mthar shi 'phos ma thag nas rtsal chen gyis mda' 'phangs pa ltar 'og min du song bar bshad pas/ rgyal po'i skye ba ba rgyud mar bzhes nas mthar ngan song gi ming tsam yang mi grags pa'i zhing khams su song 'dug na de 'dra'i smon lam zhig khyed cag gis kyang 'debs dgos pa ma yin nam/spyir mgo la dwa skyes pa ni zhi zhing bag pheb pa'i ri dwags kyi brtul zhugs zhig mtshon kyi yod pa las/ rang bzhin gyis sdig la dga' zhing sha khrag la goms pa'i mche sder can gyi gcan gzan gtum po zhig tu 'grel bshad sus kyang rgyag mi thub/ da dung mi'i mgo la rwa skyes pa ni sangs rgyas kyi gtsug tor ltar legs byas bsod nams kyi phung po zhig tu brtsis te bsngags brjod kyi yul du byas kyang chog yod/ 'on kyang don dam du khong gi mgo la dwa skyes med la bka' blon lha klu ba'i rkub la rnga ma yang skyes med/ der brten de dag ni kha gtad phyogs khag tshos rnam dpyod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bo rmongs pa na mas 'jigs snang bskul nas rang gi 'dod ngo/na sgrub thabs su bzos pa sha stag red/ btsan po kha shas rang gi blon po la nan gyis 'thab zla bskul nas srog bskyal ba dang / 'ga' shas gson po dur du zhugs pa dang / la la rgyan rtsed kyis rta las lhung ste grongs pa dang / la la chang rag tshod med btung nas ra ror gyur te mgul ltag rgyab tu 'chos nas gzhigs pa sogs ni rgyal po zhig la rang gis bgyi bar 'os pa'i rgyal thabs la thugs khur de tsam ma bzhes par ches bag med kyi bya ba thal cha che na po zhig gis rang gi mi tshe mjug bsdus pa yin la/ khyod ni rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi don du rlabs chen gyi thugs khur bsnams nas zhum pa med par rang spog blos btang ba ni rgya gar gyi mes po dam pa ghan dhi dang sgo kun nas mtshungs/ lha sras zhig gi lus srog gi 'brel thag de bar chu da kyi mda' pos bcad skabs ‘ nga zhi ba ni lo gsum gyis snga drags song / mi 'es bar chad des rkyen pas nang 'khrugs/ btsan 'dzul/ sa sgor/ yul gyar sogs sdug dgu rgyun mar

rgyang ring gi pho brang dmar po/ 163myong rgyu'i sngon brda gsal po bstan nas yul gangs can pa la brtse ba'i spyan dkyus ring po de rim gyis zum pa'i snang tshul zhig krong nger langs ba'i lha ldan gyi rdo ring de mthong thengs re re bzhin blo yul du shar nas dbang med du mig chu'i thigs pa 'ga' sa la lhung myong / ya gling gi dbus 'gyur 'chu nga ba'i gangs can pho brang pa'i mnga' thang de 'dzam gling gi mdun gral nas mdun gral du slebs thub pa'i ches gdong mchong gi las 'gul de la pham nyes khel ba'i mjug 'bras ni da lta'i bar pham bzhin pa 'di yin/ kye ma khyod nyid gshegs pa ni ci 'dra'i glo bur 'ig min na mdang skyes byis pa la so skyes don med la/ de las gyes pa'i mtho sgang gi tshe srog la chu ga grum chen po 'di sgor don ci la yod/ mdor na khyod ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bzhig pa'i bdud rgyal zhig min la phu nu nang dme bslangs nas khri rtsor bcu gsum khrag la bsgres pa'i rgyal po sdig can zhig kyang min/ tā zhi dang tha'i sogs kyi go gnas dang / mu tig dang g.yang kri sogs kyi 'ja' sa zhig rag ma myong yang de dag gi ched du chos dang rgyal khab kyang khyod kyis bstong ma myong / chol kha gsum ni bod kyi bdag dbang du gnyug mar gnas pa zhig yin pas khyod kyis gzhan la sprad ma myong la ga'an gyis khyod la phul chog pa'i thob thang yod pa'ang khyod kyis khas mi len/ nang khul gyi phyogs khag bar gyi pham nyes zhig khel myong yang khyi phyi log 'bud par stag nang log tu gyod kyis khrid ma myong / khyod ni rang don du gzhan bsad pa min par gzhan don du rang 'chi ba kho na yin/khyod kyi lhag bsam ni rlabs che zhing brtse sems ni phyags rgyang ring / na ma dpyod ni mkha' ltar yangs shing snying stobs ni ri ltar brtan/ gnas pa ni don dang lngan 'ing gshegs pa ni gzi brjid che / 'on kyang gcig kho na las gzigs rgyang thung ba'i skye bo 'ga' yis dma' 'bebs dang 'phya smod sogs byed pa'i kha 'di bdud kyis phyes pa min na ga'an ci zhig yin te/ yang na/ khyi rgan ku co 'don pa la/ /rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyugs/ /zhes pa ltar dus dbang kho nas yin par gdon mi za/ ma gzhi nas bar skabs kyi lo rgyus smra ba mang po zhig nas rang gi mi rigs dang rig gzhung gang ci gzhan 'ig la khungs gtugs pa nyid

164 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//gzi brjid che bar brtsis nas mi rigs kyi la rgya dang rig gzhung gi rin thang nyam nyes su btang ba 'dis 'dzom gling mi rigs khag gi gral mjug tu sdod dgos pa'i thob thang zhig len srid/bod tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling mi rigs tshang ma spra sprel las chad la de yang thog mar bod nas chad par nyin dhi pa rnams dang / deng sang gi tshan rig pa khag cig 'dod pa bzhin rigs pas kyang bsgrub par nus mod/ 'dzam gling thog mi'i 'gro ba dar nas lo grangs med 'dod bzhin du bod kyi mes po spre'u de lo ngo nyis stong las mi brgal ba ji ltar yin nam/da skabs bod nas 'dzam gling rdo chas dus rabs gsar snying gi gna' rdzas mang po 'don bzhin yod pa des khyed cag gi tshod dpag de thung dugs pa'i 'gyod pa 'ig ma skyes sam/stong ldong smug se/ zhes pa'i rus chen ba'i po de bod kho na dang mi 'grig ba'in du sbyar dgos pa ci yin nam/ bod la mgo se yang nge ba'i tshan pa zhig med pa ni dbu nag bod ces pa'i tha snyad des kyang gsal bshad byas skusnad la/ rgas pa'i tshe yin na ni bod thams cad der thal ba'i phyir rus che na bzhir rtsis pa grangs mang bar gyur/gal te nad la sogs pa'i dbang gis gzhon dar 'ga' zung yod pas sgron med snyam na/ de ltar na sgo/ 'ar/ lkug ces pa'i rus ming 'ga' yang yong chog pas rus chen ba'i'i grangs 'dren nyung bar 'gyur/ de bzhin smug ni nag po'i bye brag ste rta nag po la rta smug po zer ba ltar yin pas/de dag ni ka khol ma las bshad pa ltar tshan pa tshan pa byas pa ces gling dang phe gling pa lta bu yin par sems/spu rgyal gyi gdung rgyud 'di spu mi las chad na chog pa la gnam nas babs kyang che rgyu ci 'is yod/ kun gyis rkang 'og tu rdzi ba'i kha ba'i 'dab ma dang thal ba'i bag spu la/ de bzhin mi gtsang blosnal ba'i bya 3snad dang sbrang ma dag kyang gnam nas/ babs pa ma yin nam/bod kyi rgyal po de bod mi zhig yin na chog pa la rgya dkar nag gnyis po gang rung zhig yin dgose pa ci yin nam/ rgya gar nas byang phyogs su bros pa dang rgya nag nas nub phyogs su gros pa thams cad bod kyi rgyal por yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci jig bshad rtsis yod dam/

gyang ring gi pho brang dmar po/ 165bod la skyes shing bod la 'tshar long byung ba/ bod 'di bdag tu bzung zhing bod dar gud la gdung sems mnyam skyed gnang ba'i lnga dang bcu gnyis dgu dang bcu gsum skusnags bod srid pa'i lha chen na mas gral mjug la mar bkar/ rgya lho ra gyi rgyal 'khyam 'dre 'khyam mang po zhig bod la tshur bslongs nas gral mgo la yar bzhag ste mchod mchod bstod bstod kyis lha 'og la lha bcug pa des mi 'og la mi 'dzul dgos pa 'i lta sa ngan zhig bsus pa ma yin nam/gri gum gyi skabs su ga'i nas lcags zangs gtso sbyang byas zer pa nam yang mi bden te/ lcags rigs mtshon cha ci yang med par mkhar las dmag 'khrug mi thub cing re ti 'go yag gi skabs nas dgra sta mda' gzhu sku gas brwadze ba'i lag shes dar bar bshad na/de ni nyung mthar yang gnya' khri'i gong gi lo lnga brgya yan chad yin par dpog thub/ gal te bod rang gis bzos pa thig med kyang gzhan nas nyos pa yod chog snyam na/ de yang stag ri gnyan gzigs gong na nyo tshong med par khyed cag gis khas len dgos te/ mdzangs mi gsum pa'i mdzad rjes su/ dga' gnyis tshong las mthun gnyis la lung bsdebs/ /de gong bod na tshong dang bre srang med//ces bshad pas so//de bzhin lo ngo stong mo ga lnga lhag sa 'og tu gnas pa'i lo tog khag cig rnyed tshor byung bas ru las skyes kyis so nam srol gtod pa'i bsngags brjod byed mi thub la/ spyir 'brog las las zhing las sngar dar yod pa ni mi'i brgyud rim las gsal bshad byed thub pa zhig yin/ de bzhin rdo chas dus rabs kyi mkhar shul mang po klung du yod pas stong btsan gyi skabs su grong sde klung la chags pa'i dbya brnyes pa'i dus dran kyang srung brtsi zhu mi thub bo//gnyan chen thang lha/10'ji/7/'don thengs nga dgu pa nas zur du phyung pa'o//

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi 〈snas motel /de ring ni grogs bo zhig gis sgor lnga brgya gsol stsal byung zhing gnam gzhis bsil ba'i skabs dang bstun/ nga rang gcig pur rgyal sa ldi li gsar pa'i g.yas g.yon du 'cham 'cham la song / yangs shing rgya che ba'i gnam thang / mkhregs zhing 'khod sgoms pa'i gzhung lam/ mtho zhing brjid pa'i thog khang / myur zhing mdzes pa'i mo ṭa/ me tog gis gang ba'i ldum ra/ rgyu nor gyis gang ba'i tshong ra/ ri li'i 'bab tshugs/ sbag si'i nyis seng / za khang dang mgron khang sogs mthong rim bzhin bod chol kha gsum gyi khyon la 'di 'dra zhig ga dus yong thub na snyam pa'i la rgyas 'byung 'gyur gyi tshe srog la 'dri rtags re rgyag bzhin 'gro ba ni/ji skad du rje mi las/nga 'gro bzhin 'gro la sgom zhig yod/pho nga la yod de gzhan la med/de gzhan la sku1da na dga' ba la/zhes gsungs pa ltar de nyin gyi 'gro 'dug gang la'ang rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs la bcangs pa'i brtse dung dang phugs bsam gyi dpyad sgom dang kha bral ma thub/ da ni 'cham 'cham des spro snang zhig ma byung khar skyo snang zhig skyes pas mgyogs tsam mgon khang du log nas nyal 'dod skyes /nyin mo'i chags zhen las mtshan mo'i 'khrul snang 'byung ba dngos bden red/ de ma thag (bod kyi rtsa don sgrub pa'i thabs lam skor gros mol byed kyi 'dug pas nyan khar

la rgyas bskyed pa 'i 'khrul snang gi gros sol/ 167'gro/kyi grogs po blo bzang gi skad red/ nga ni mkhas pa'i gsung tshig gcig thos na a sgor 'bum gcig 〈snab pa las dga' tshor che mkhan zhig yin stabs/ der mkhas dbang kha shas zhig phebs yod pa thag chod bsams nas brgyugs phyin/ de ni rkang gnyis mi'i tshogs 'du zhig min par/ g.yag dang 'grong / gangs seng dang dom phra/ skya ka dang khu byug gtsod dang gla ba sogs bod kyi srog chags thams cad hi ma la'i rtse mor 'tshos/sdog nas phra chem chem 'od mer mer du gnas/tshogs 'du gtso skyong pa g.yag na re/de ring ni bod kyi ri skyes srog chags kyi tshogs 'du thengs dang po rgyal kha'i ngang slong 'tshog thub par ngas spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas bkra zhis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ chag chag hrag hrag phag phag de ni srog chags de dag gis sder mo dang / ni khe/ po le bcas brdabs nas dga' bsu zhus pa'i sgra red/ mu mthud de brjod don/ tshogs 'du 'di'i thog bod rang da bang slar gso'i thabs lam spel phyogs ji dge bka' sdur lhug por gnang nas/ mtha' ma'i grub nge na khag lag len 'gel thabs su btsan gyol bod gzhung dang / gzhung 'brel min pa'i tshogs pa khag tha na skye bo mi re ngo rer brgyud bsgrags 'bod skul zhu rgyu yin/ bod kyi bdag dbang slar gso ma byung phyin mi rigs dang rig gzhung rtsa brlag 'gro ba dang chabs cig rang byung khor yug la'ang gnod skyon tshabs chen phog ste ri skyes srog chags gcig kyang 'tsho gnas mi thub par 'gyur rgyu'i nyen kha ha cang che/ der brten rang dbang sngar sor chud thabs byed gyu ni yul de'i srog chags grog bu yan chad la khe phan dang las 'gan yod pa zhig red/ nga tsho dud 'gro song gzhis rkang gnyis mi'i gral du 'tshang nas rang dbang rtsod len byed pa'i thob thang dang zhus pa med kyang / rang rang gi bsam tshul tsam zhig yul gangs can pa zha mas la bo bar byed rgyu ni nga tshos skabs bab kyi bsgrub bya de yin/ de 'dur song khyed na ma pas chen po dang btsan po nems kyis ci

168 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//gsungs mthun 'jug lta bu ma sku nga bar rang rang gi bsam tshul thad shar gsungs gnang rogs/ces gsungs/gtsod na re/bod rang dbang slar gso'i cha rkyen du chol gsum rdog rtsa gcig tu bsgril rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtug cig mthong gi 'dug deng sang yas kha bral gtong mkhan red/ mas kha bral gtong mkhan nged/ zer mang po zhig bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ mi 'dra zhig la cha bzhag na rkang pa lta bu gcig gzugs po dang kha bral na de ni ha cang gi skyon cha chen po zhig chags kyi re da/yan lag na mas kha ma bral par rkang pa'i ram 'degs lag pas dang / lag pa'i ram 'degs rkang pas thub pa'i gzugs ga'i thang po zhig yod na des ni ci yang byed du btub nges red/ chol gsum rdog rtsa chig sgril yag po thig byung ba yin na rang dbang rang btsan yin na'ang 'dra/ rang thag rang gcod yin na'ang 'du/ lam dbu ma yin na'ang 'du/ nga sgo'i 'dod don bsgrub thub nges red/chos nga//chol gsum rdog rtsa gcig tu bsgril rgyu ni ha cang gi rgya chen po/ phyags ring po/ gting zab po/bod kyi rtsa don zer na'ang ma 'grig pa med pa/ rtsa don bsgrub pa'i thabs lam gyi gtso bo de red zer na'ang de ga rang yin bsngad pa/mdod na thog ma dge ba/bar du dge ba/ma tha' ma dge ba zer ba nang bzhin chol gsum rdog rtsa gcig tu bsgril gyu de dang bod pa'i spyi tshogs gnyis nam yang kha bral du mi rung ba 'ig yin pa de rgyang ring po zhig la blta ma thub na'ang /dus rabs 'di'i 'das pa'i gyab ljong la rob tsam bltas na lam sang ha go thub kyi red bsam gyi sku da/ dper na/ lu'u cun dmag dpung lta bu zhig la mtshon na dmag 'bor dang /dmag sbyong / go mtshon sogs ha las dgos pa ci yang med kyang / bod kyi sa khul mang po

wa rgyas/ bskyed rwa/'i 'a9'a/ snang gi glos mol/ 169zhig tu gtor bzhig tshabs chen po de 'du gtong thub pa ni bod la chig sgril gyi zhus pa de med pas byas pa red/ lung pa phar nang nas gtor bcom gtong bsngad kyi yod na'ang la'i tshur nang nas stod shar re bsdad kyi yod dus/ seng ge ri dwags gseng du song ba ltar gang byas byas chags kyi skusnad pa red/ da nas bzung bod sa lag mthil tsam zhig gi steng la'ang chol kha gsum sha'i zhus shugs slebs thub pa zhig dgos kyi 'dus/go bo/khong ri dwags kyis gsung pa de ni bden pa red/ nga ni srid pa chags nas yod pa'i bya rgan 'ig yin pas sngar gyi lo rgyus kyi steng nas cung zad cig bshad na bsams byung / gnod sbyin nag po nas bzung gna' bo'i bod de gcig gyur yun ring byung yod/ ma sang gi skabs nas dang po rgyal phran bcu gnyis su 'thor ba red/ de yang phar 'thor nas sil ma bzhi bcu chags pa red/ de skabs khyim mtshes rgyal khab shar rgya nag wor rgya gar/ nub ta zi/ byang ge ser ba'is bod la 'dre lag brkyangs te skyes pa'i mi bsad/ bsags pa'i rgyu 'phrogabartsegs pa'i mkhar ba shig nas gtor bcom tshod med byas yod/ phyi spyang ki mi thub dus nang 〈sna khyi dung zer ba nang ba'in rgyal phran phan tshun dmag 'khrug dang / 'a〈snag bathe ma gyis mdor na dmyal ba mi yul du 'phos pa nang bzhin bde ba'i go skabs cung zad kyang med pa'i gnas stangs zhig byung yod/ de ga re la brten nas byung ba red zer na chig sgril gyi stobs shugs de nyams nas sil bur gyur pa la brten nas byung ba zhig red/chos rgyal srong btsan nas bzung sras dar ma'i bar tshig sgril yag po zhig byung sku da/bod zer dus mgo 'phang mtho ya le 'gro cho ga pa zhig dang / a ma'i mngal nas rang dbang du skyes shing 'jig rten 'di'i steng bsngad tshe rang dbang chen po 'ig longs su spyad nas mthar rang dbang ngang shi chog pa'i dus tshod bzang po zhig byung yod/ de ni sngar gyi sil bur gyi gnas snangs de las ldog ste chig sgril gyi stobs shugs la brten nas byung ba red/ lha

170 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//sras dar ma lkog bsad btang ba nas slar yang sil bur thengs gnyis pa de 'thor ba red/de'i mjug 'bras ni da lta'i bar nga tsho la myong bzhin pa 'di red/ da dung 'di'i phyi mtha' ga tshod yod med sus shes/ sa skya'i skabs su yin na'ang 'dra/ phag gru/ rin dpyang / gtsang pa/dga' ldan pho brang pa gang gi skabs la'ang chig sgril yag bo zhig byung med/ gtso bo thob thang red/khe phan/dmag don/sa tshigs gang gi cha nas kyang chig sgril yong ba'i gzhi rtsa med pa red/ de lta'i rim pas the gu sne sgor gyi mthar gnas stangs 'di la thug yod/ mdor na chig sgril byas na khe sang ga re yod pa dang / kha bral song na mjug 'bras ngan pa ga re yong gi yod pa de dpe dang / rgyu mtshan dang / lo rgyus kyi sgo nas mi mang gi blo ngor gsal po zhig bzo dgos kyi 'dug gsal po zhig ha go ba yin na bde ba 'dod la sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa zha stag yin dus rang shugs kyis chig sgril yong nges red/ de min kho kha bral gtong mkhan red zer nas mgo la dbyug pa bsnun pa'i sbyor ba brtsams pa yin na de ni tshig sgril gyi 'bosnag rkyen zhig chags kyi med dam snyam/khu byugartsa ba'i chol kha gsum bod la yod pa red/ btsan byol du slebs pa'i chol kha gsum gyi mi gang thig yod pa de mang nyung la ma ltos par lo rabs dug cu pa nas bzung 7gong sa mchog gis lam ston dang dbu khrid 'og rdog rtsa chig sgril yin pa las/ de snga med pa zhig deng sang mi kha bde ba kha shas zhig dang tshogs pa kha shas zhig gis bzo chog chog cig yin par bsam gyi med/yin na'ang 'di byas na chig sgril byas pa red/'di ma byas na chig sgril ma byas pa red/ 'di byung na chig sgril byung ba red/ 'di ma byung phyin chad chig sgril ma byung ba red zer ba'i chig sgril gyi go don da nga dbye mtshams de gsal po zhig de snga gzhung dang /sdurdogs pa/mkhas pa gang gis kyang ma gsungs/ma bzhad/gtan la ma phab par sdusang /mi nges chi ga sgril gyi go don re bzung nas rang dang ma mthun pa thams cad kha bral gtong

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros sal/ 171mkhan red zer bshad yong dus kha bral ba mang po zhig chags kyi yod red/dper na/gzhung la skyon brjod dang / chol kha dang chos lugs kyi thob thang rtsod pa ni kha bral gyi bya spyod cig red bsam bsdad mkhan gyi rigs gcig yod la/ chol kha be nga lung tshan gyi phyogs zhen de med par ma gyur par chig sgril yong thabs med bsam mkhan gyi rigs gcig kyang yod/khag cig nas chol kha gsum zer dus rta rgyug na rgyug mnyam dang gral brgyab na kha gtad/ thob thang dang khe phan gang ci 'du mnyam zhig byung ba yin na chig sgril yong thub ya zhig dang / de min chig sgril yong mi thub par bsam bsngad kyi yod red/ bsam tshul dang po de ni chig sgril dgos na dmangs gtso 'dor dgos pa dang / dmangs gtso dgos na chig sgril 'dor dgos pa'i lta tshul ha cang gu dog po zhig red/bsam tshul gnyis pa de ni rtsa ba'i cha nas bsam blo gtong sa thig skusgod pa red/a ri lta bu yin na mi rigs phyogs zhen gyi 'gal zla ni tshabs chen zhig yin par rtsis te/ mi rigs bar chang sa brgyab pa sogs phyogs zhen chung ngu 'gro thabs byed kyi yod/ dang po phyogs zhen med pas bzo dgos na de dmigs yul la bzung nas thabs lam mang po 'ig la gom pa brgyab dgos pa las/ phyogs zhen ma byed zer ba'i chig tsam gyis de med pa bzo thub yas zhig ma red/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sems can thams cad nye ring chags sngang dang bral ba'i btang stoms la bkod thub med/ phyi'i rgyu nor thog gser dang sa rdo mnyam pa'i rtogs pa zhig 'khrungs byung na gzhi nas nang gi nye ring phyogs ris de med pa 'gyur gyi red/de bas grogs byung dus gri rtses kham bgos byas pa yin na dgra byung dus mdung so mnyam gtad yong thub kyi red bsams kyi 'dugari bong /bod rang dbang byung ba'i skabs su chol kha'i phyogs zhen dang 'gran bsdur de sdung du 'gro gi red bsam gyi 'dugagang yin zer na/chol kha re mnga' sde re lta bu byas nas bsngad rgyu min par/da

172 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//lta'i rgya mis dbang sgyur sa khul btsugs pa dang mthun pa zhig gi thog nas chab srid skyong stangs de yong gi red/ de dus chol kha zhes pa'i ming chig de bed spyod gtong ba'i go skabs nyung nyung chags kyi red snyam/ gang ltar cho la kha gsum chig sgril byed dgos zer ba dang / 'cham po dang mthun po byed dgos zer ba ni go don gcig pa red/ mthun po byed nga/gos na nga tsho mthun pa spun bzhi la dpe bltas na 'grigs/ gcig 1snag gcig 'dzegs byas pa de rgan gazlobyun bo rim gyis brtsi bkur tsam zhig mtshon pa min par de ni stobs che chung gi go rim red/ phan tshun phyogs gnyis yod na'ang 'dra/ gsum yod na'ang 'dra/ 'cham po dang mthun po dgos na gang stobs che ba dang dpung mang ba des gyong che ba de khur dgos pa mtshon yod/gal srid glang chen lags nas nga snang la 'dzegs kyi yin/ ri bong khyod tsho gsum gyis 'og nas 'degs zhig ces bshad pa yin na/de nas bzung mthun po yong ba'i re ba bral ba red/gang stobs che ba des gyong che ba de khur ba yin na/ gyong khur zer ba tsam las ya rabs sems bzang bzod pa'i rang ba'in can zhig tu kun gyis bkur nges red/ phar phyogs stobs chung ba des kyang nga la thub tshod ma byas par rgyal kha sprad pa ni ci 'du'i bsam shes byas pa zhig ma red dam snyam nas/ rang dbang med par kho'i 'og la 'dud dgos pa zhig gis rang ba'in gyis mthun po chags kyi nged/ stobs chung ba de la gyong phran bu las med kyang sems kyi rma kha ni ha kyang chen po 'ig yong gi yod/ des na chig sgriladang mthun po zer ba de tsho ya rabs spyod bzang zhig gi thog nas yong dgos pa las/ btsan po dbang skusnad kyis sku nga thabs med pa zhig yin par snyam/sdurdogs gatherdo g.yagachi ga sgril gyi skor bka' sdur lhug po gnang song bar rjes su yi rangs zhu rgyu dang / da nas gnad don gzhan pa'i thog gros yol byed rgyu yin/

la gya sa bskyed pa 'i 'khrul snang gi gros mol/ 173sha ba mchu dkar/btsan byol bod gzhung gi las byed pa'i nang lce na gzhon shes yon can mang tsam slebs thub thabs byed dgos kyi 'dug nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod 'di dza drag can gyi 'thab rtsod cig yin dus/dgra med 〈snags med rkub kyag srung thub tsam gyis 'o1 mang 〈sna zhig bsdad bzhag na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug shes yodan med na las ka byed thub kyi ma red/ las ka ma byas na nor 'khrul sku nga gi ma red/ las ka ma byas pa de sbas nas nor 'khrul med pa de 'phyar te spobs pa che mdog byas na 'thus sgor 'gro rog las med/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs la'ang gal srid rkub kyag cig rag pa yin na/ de nas bzung de brtan po yong ched nor 'khrul mi yong ba gtso dmigs su bzung nas las ka ma byas par 'thus sgor phyin 〈snad pa red/ da lta'i skabs 'dir 'thus sgor phran tsam phyin pa yin na'ang 'gag rtsa la thug pa'i dus 'dir ha cang phangs po red/khrung khrung ske nagartsa ba'i gzhi byes gnyis kyi mi mang gi shes yon yar rgyas yong thabs byed dgos pa red/las byed pa'i nang na gzhon shes yon 0 na mang tsam sku nga thabs byed dgos kyi 'dug ces snga mo nas bshad bsngad kyi yod red/ shes yon yod na rgan gzhon sgya ser pho mo su yin na khyad par mi 'dug 'on kyang shes yon zhes pa de'i khyab khongs su ci tsam zhig tshud kyi yod med shes kyi med/ deng sang bod mi'i spyi tshogs nang kha lag pa gnyis kyi yon tan la shes yon zhes bshad kyi yod red/dbyin ji dang hin ju sogs kyi skad yig shes min de shes yon yod med kyi tshad lta bu bzung gi 'dug de dag yon tan zhig los yin kyang / de ni skad bsgyur dang yig tshang gi gnas rim 'ig las/ mi mang 'go khrid thub pa'i shes yon de ni de las gzhan pa jig klad pa'i sgugs na sku1da pa ra snam/

174 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//ba/na' ba/shes 〈snan zhes pa de shes bya dang sku na tan zhes pa'i ming gnyis bsdus pa zhig yin nam/dpyad stobs kyi shes rab dang sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan zhes pa'i tshig bsdus pa yin/ yang na ming rang skya ba yin blta dgos kyi 'dug kho la shes yon dang yod red de lo na chung bas nyams myong yod kyi ma red zer/ de ltar na nyams myong de shes yon gyi khongs su tshud med/gang ltar shes yon yod na 'jon stangs dang ldan pa zhig yin dgos kyi red/ 'jon stangs can gyi mi zhig yin na nyams (snang sku1da med kyi khyad par gang yang med/ nyams tshuphang gi lag rjes ni 'jon stangs de red/dgo ba/ma gzhi nyams tshuphang zhes pa de la lus tshor 〈snag tu tshuphang ba bsags bzhag pa'i nyams 〈snang zhig dang / gzhung lugs deb ther khag nang bsags pa'i myong ba blangs pa'i nyams myong gcig dang gnyis yod kyi red snyam/ mi tshe gcig nang gi lus tshor gyi myong ba ni ji ltar ring yang lo brgya'i nang gi nyams myong zhig yin la de yang phyogs re ba zhig red/ 'grog pa rgan po'i nyams myong des zhing pa'i sku nam la phan thog mi 'byung zhing / zhing pa rgan po'i nyams myong des phyugs thog gso skyong byed mi thub/ lo rgyus deb zer nas blangs pa'i nyams myong ni lo khri phrag mang po'i nyams myong zhig yin pa dang / phyogs re tsam min par chos srid/dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs nyams rgyud dang 'phel rgyas kyi nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa zhig red/ de'i phyir nyams cadang che chung de shes sku na la rag las pa ma gtogs lo na che chung gis 'byed pa ni rbad de nor 'khrul red bsams kyi 'dug

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros mol/ 175rkyang /mi mang gi 'go khrid mkhan de la skabs dang dus la mkhas pa zhig nges par dgos kyi 'dug bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang las 'gul kha shas ngo bo'i cha nas rlabs che po de 'dra yang /'go 'dzugs pa nang bzhin zhig gis gzhug bskyal thub kyi med pa ni thog ma'i 'char gzhi nas skabs dang dus la yag po zhig blta ma thub pa'i skyon red snyam/ gling sgrung zhib 'jug pa'i tshan rig pa ri mas kyis 'di 'dra zhig bshad kyi yod red/ mi tshos ge ser gyis bdud rgyal mang po zhig chams la phab pa ni khong gi stobs dang rdzu 'phrul des byas pa red bsams kyi yod red/ 'on kyang bdud rgyal de dag la'ang stobs dang rdzu 'phrul yod pa ma zad srog gi khug pa mang po zhig kyang yod pa red/ de ni gzhan gang yang min par nam mkha'i dbyings nas slob dpon cos rgyan pad ma dang /lha chen tshang pa dkar po/ma ni ni gnam sman dkar mo gsum gyis 'a〈sna snod las gsum lung bstan nas skabs dang dus la mkhas pa zhig chags kyi skusnad pas red/ dmag 'thab sesgogs las 'gul ga 'du zhig yin kyang skabs dang dus la blta nas rgyal kha len dgos kyi yod/ de'i phyir gling sgrung ni bslab bya'i rin thang ches cher ldan 'dug ces zer/ dper na/ so nam zhig byas pa yin na'ang son de ston la btab/ chu lud gnyis de dgun la byas nas lo 'khor mo yug la dka' las brgyab kyang 'bras bu mi thon zhing / rgyal khab bco brgyad kyi skad brgyab kyang ljang bu tsam yang mi skye na 'bras bu lta ci smos/ bya ba gang 'dra zhig yin kyang thog ma'i 'go 'dzugs pa nas mtha' ma'i rgyal kha'i dbar skabs dang dus la bstun nas 'a〈sna dgos par sems/ skabs dang dus la bsdun dgos zer dus ma 'ongs pa 'ig bsgug dgos pa'i skad ca zhig ma red/skabs dang dus la yag po zhig blta shes pa yin na dus tshod skar cha gcig kyang 'a phyo rlag 'gro gi ma red bsams kyi yod/

176 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//gnyan/las byed ni mi mang gi 'go khrid cig yin la mi mang gi 'bas 'degs zhu mkhan zhig kyang red/ bod skad skyon nas bod mi mang gi 'go khrid dgos pa las dbyin skad skyon nas bod mi mang gi 'go khrid mi thub/ bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung dang gom srol nang dngos su zhugs nas bod mi mang gi zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa yin gyi/ de dag la mthong chung khyad gsod kyis zhe mer lang bzhin bod mi mang gi zhabs 'degs nam yang zhu mi thub/ phyi lugs la dbyings rtsa 'phar bzhin pa'i gang zag des rang lugs kyi rig gzhung rgyud 'dzin byed mi thub/ dbyin skad ma shes na las ka mi thub par ngos 'dzin byed pa ni rtsa ba'i cha nas nor 'khrul 'ig red/ stobs chen rgyal khab a rgya gnyis kyi phyi srid blon chen na ma gnyis gros mol byed skabs mi re'i skad sgyur re brgyud dgos kyi yod/ rgyal khab de gnyis nang dbyin skad dang rgya skad shes mkhan med pa ga nas yin/ 'on kyang khong gnyis la rgyal khab kyi phyi 'brel thad gzhan las dmigs bsal gyi khe phan yod pa'i klad pa ldan yod pa red/ mdor na bka' zhag dang /spyi 'thus/sku tshab/gzhis 'godon gcod/tshogs pa gang gi'ang tshogs gtso'i rkub kyag steng nges par klad pa zhig slebs dgos kyi yod pa da nga / de dag gi yig tshang nang gi rkub kyag de kha dang lag pas zin na'ang 'grigs/'phyi phigagazhung gi 'go khrid de la sngon gyi ri la bya ra dang rgyab kyi ri la phyi ltas shes mkhan/ 'das pa las nyams myong blangs nas 'byung 'gyur la tshod dpag shes mkhan/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs dang gya la spyi'i 'gyur 'gros la ga'igs nas da lnga ba rnams lag len du bsgril thub mkhan/ skyon brjod las bslab bya dang pham kha las rgyal kha len thub mkhan/ rang gi rgyus rang la yod mkhan/rang gi lta grub la rang gis yid ches yod mkhan/yid rton che la do gas

la gyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros mol/ 177zon shes mkhan/ spyang grung 'dzoms la sems thag chod mkhan/ bshad pa nyung la lag len mang mkhan/ rang nongs len cing bzod gasku la len mkhan/ lhag bsam che la dung tshugs zin mkhan/ bstod kyang smad kyang shing bzhin gnas mkhan/ sbyi don che la rang don nyung mkhan/sgam tshugs che la 'dzum mdangs rgyas pa zhig dbo|sa par sems/bya thegeg ma/sgom chen 'phyi bas bshad pa de ni bden par mngon/ lhag par du rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi gnad don ni rang gi srog las kyang lhag par lta 'ing gces par 'dzin pa'i lhag bsam dang /rgyal gces kyi bsam blo shugs chen po 'ig yod na/ de dag gi don du rang srog btang ba yang las sla po chags kyi yod red/ bdag nyid chen po lhan dhe lta bu sku'i nyen srung gcig kyang med par rang nyid gcig pur lcags lam brgyud gom bgrod gnang gi yod/de 'dra'i sems shugs dang snying stobs de ni lhag bsam dang bden par yid ches pa las byung ba zhig red/ bden par yid ches zhi'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa zhig med na/ mi rigs dang rigs gzhung gi ched rang nyid gcig pur srang lam dang lcags lam zhugs par dka' ngal 'phrad kyi red/khub/ rta/ming stong snyan grags g.yo sgyus thob pa'i go sa na mas ni rgyud pa'i ga'i rtsa dang / blo gcig sems gcig gis rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi zhabs 'degs zhus pa ni bla na med pa'i gzi brjid da nga / snyan grags kyi me lce 'bar ba'i bud shing zhig yin par shes dgos kyi 'dug lhan r+bhe ni 'dzam gling na skad grags che shos kyi mi sna zhig red/ khong gis 'tshe med zhi ba'i thabs lam spel ba de gcig pus mtshan snyan de byung ba re da bsams kyi med/ gal srid khong nas dbyin ji'i mthun phyogs bzung nas rgya gar de bzhin ji srid dbar dbyin ji'i bdag dbang 'og gnas thabs su 'tshe med 'i ba'i las 'gul de 'du zhig spel ba yin na/

178 'bras ring chu 〈sna dal 'bab//'tshe med zhi ba'i las 'gul byas pa 'du na'ang de ni 'dzam gling mi mang gis 'khrel dgod bya yul zhig tu 'gyur nges red/gong mo/dmangs gtso'i spyi tshogs nang gi gzhung 'dzin mi sna de la rgya gar gyi rtsed mo marakaṭa'i nang gi bhaṭaman lta bu zhig dgos kyi 'dug de yang tse( lbir bzhi brgya las brgal ba'o stobs chen rgya nag gi kha gtad gcog dgos dus/ rang gi zhus thugs gang yod kyis seg se phor rkyang rkyang gtong thabs byed dgos pa las/31 wer yang med la coṭi yang med pa ra dal dal sgod stod kyis po lor bkag thub tsam byas nas bsngad pa yin na pham nyes kyi mthar thugi pa zhig 'khel rgyu yin pa ni gdon mi za ba red/'erdogs gatherdo g.yagang tshor dang po nas dud 'gro'i gral las med gzhis gzhung 'dzin mi snar skyon yon zhu dag mang dugs na nyen kha 〈snad/ me phar 'bud lce sa a ra tshur tshig zer ba nang bzhin nga tshos lngag bsam gyis bsam 'char phar bshad dus/ khong tshos tsudan mtshang bsngogs byung snyam pa'i 'khon lan gyis gnod pa tshur bskyal ba'i nyen kha sku da/ de las rjod pa gzhan 'ig gi 〈snag la phebs na/'grong /bod rang btsan slar gso dgos na dug po'i stobs shugs zhig la nges par brten dgos/sngar chos rgyal me dbon na ma gsum gyis 'dzam gling sum gnyis dbang sgyur byas te/ chos 'byor bde dge'i dpal la spyod rgyu byung ba de'ang drag po'i stobs shugs la brten nas byung ba red/ de rjes sa skya dang / phag gru gtsang pa / dga' ldan po brang pa'i srid dbang yang dug

la rgyas bskyed pa 'i 'khrul snang gi sngo nu/ mosnal/ 179po'i stobs thugs kyis bsgrag pa zhig red ma gtogs/ 'tshe med zhi ba dang / 'i ba'i gros mo la zer ba'i ming snyan ngo sdo 'du la brten nas bag chags bzhag rabs bo ma 〈snang /sngasam khra/ 'i ba'i gros mol zer ba de ni phyogs gnyis mar drag khro'i stobs thugs sku gas gang ci gnas stangs 'du mnyam zhig gi swā ga nas sku nga dbo sa pa zhig red/ de min nyam chung lu gu lta bu zhig gis za 'dod che ba'i spyang ki la 'i ba'i gros mol byed dgos na/ spyang ki khyed rang lug chung nga 'dzin pa ra dka' las sgron mi dgos par nga rang dwang lang gis khyed kyi tshang sgo bab ra gyi yin 'es khas len dgos pa de red/ rgya nag gis tshod dpag dka' ba'i dug po'i stobs shugs shig gsog thub pa'i nyin mo der gzhi nas rgya rgya yul na skyid/bod bod yul na skyid/ zer ba lnga bu'i 'i ba'i gros mol 'ig yong thub shas che/ ma ga'i nas bod sgor ba de pe ga po 'i stobs shugs kyis ma 'dang nas thor ba 'ig red ma gtogs/ byams pa dang snying rje 'tshe ba med pa sogs zhi ba'i stobs shugs kyis ma 'dang nas bod thor ba jig ma red bsams kyi yod/spre'u/ dug po'i skad cha bshad pa de la mos mthun med/ de ni 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs ga'i 'tshe med 'i ba dang 'gal ba 'ig re da/ zas bcad ngo rgol byed pa'ang mos mthun med/ de'ang 'tshe ba'i bya ba jig red/ 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs ga'i dang ma ma thun pa 'ig gis rang btsan sang nyin la 'thob thub pa 'i thabs lam 'ig sku da kyang de ni sung bya yin/de 'du 'ig gis mi rigs dang rig gzhung rtsa brlag tu phyin kya'i de ni sngon las yi na pa sa 'gyod pa med/
