180 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//spyang ki/drag po yin na'ang 'dra/ 'i ba yin na'ang 'ape / rgya nag la kha gtad sku nga ba'i re ba byed pa ni gnyid lam nang gi stong bsam rang red/ de las rgya gar gyi gsang ba'i mi sna dang skor srung ba khag cig la dadul sprad de/ 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs pa dang 'gal ba'i rang btsan bshad mkhan dang / 'tshe ba'i las 'gul spel mkhan/ gzhung 〈snags mi snar 〈snan ba༄ted byed mkhan/ dmangs gtso'i khe dbang dang khro ba thang rtsod mkhan de dag la/ rgya dmar nag gi phogs zan da nga / 7gong sa mchog gi sku la bsdo mkhan/ bod rgya'i 'brel lam gtor ga'ig gtong mkhan / rgya dmar dang pā khi mithan gyi gsang nyul yin pa sogs nyes ming sna tshogs bkal te gci ga kyang med par gtsang ma bzo thub pa yin na/ de ni da lnga'i skabs bab kyi rgyal kha che thos de red snyam/dred mong /'tshe med zhi ba zer ba de'i go don gsal po zhig da res bzo dgos kyi 'dug a jo spre'u gsungs pa ltad ga /〈snan pa lam gyi gnas skabs su rang lus la mar me lha nga phrag spar ba dang /byang sems rtag dus rla g.yas pa'i sha rnams bkog ste rkang gi don du rus pa gcog tu rtsigs pa'i drung du song ba dang /tshong dpon gyi bu mo lnga brgya pos martson don pos lus kun phug nas khrag gis sa ༷༷gas khyag khyag btab pa dang / rgyal sras 11gas med kyis rang gi lus gi sa sgo bcad de khyi las bsal ba'i 'bu la ster ba sogs kyang bgyi ba mi rung ba'i 'tshe ba'i las byas pa yin nam/ ston pa mchog zan ma gasku la ba 'o/ drug dka' ba spyad pa'ang 'o/ drug ring 'tshe ba'i las byas nas bzhugs pa 'ig yin nam/ rgyal bu snying stobs chen ngo/5sa sngag mo gcig dang stag phrug lnga'i don du da nga lus bdang ba yang ches cher bsngags na/ sa ya drug ṅga don du rang lus btang ba ni de las kyang gzi brjid che ba jig yin dgos kyi ma red dam/

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros sal/ 181dbyi/pha rol gyi lus srog la rgol ba'i dug mtshon gyi sbyor ba ni drag po'i las yin la/ mtshon cha de dag mar bzhag nas rang dbang dang thob thang gang zhig rtsod pa de ni 'tshe med zhi ba zer ba de yin dgos kyi red/ gnod pa byas pa dang 'tshe ba byas pa don cig tu byas nas/ rang gzhan gang rung la gswā da pa byas pa tsam gyis 'tshe ba byas pa 'gyur gyi red ces bshad na/bod don gyi 'thab rtsod gang zhig byas kyang 'tshe ba chags kyi red/ 7gong sa mchog a rir phebs pa dang / bod don rgyal spyi'i thog bshad pa tsam gyis rgya nag la gnod kyi yod red/des kho rang tshos skad brgyab kyi yod red/ 'on kyang 7gong sa mchog gis gzhan la phan ma thog na'ang gnod ma bskyal gsungs kyi yod pa red/ ces bshad de de dag mtshams 'jog byas na 'grig gi red dam/che/ba/sman gang zhig bsten kyang nad las grol na nad pa'i dgos 'dun 'grub pa red/thabs lam gang zhig bsten kyang bod la rang dbang byung na 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs 'dun 'grub pa red/ rgyal ba rin po che'i dgongs 'dun gtso bo de thabs lam gyi khyad par tsam min par bod khyon yongs la rang dbang zhig 'byung dgos pa de red/ kha thebs la ma ltos par drag po'i las 'gul spel rgyu ni thabs shes yag sgos de yin par bsams/ 'bu lta bu chung chung zhig yin na'ang so rgyag mkhan zhig yin na dogs zon byed dgos kyi yod dus/ mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas ya len zhig slog pa yin na de ni snang chung du bzhag mi thub pa zhig chags kyi red/ rgya mir nam yang sdod sos mi bde ba zhig bzos pa yin na/bod don gyi dka' rnyog de sel rgyu'i bsam blo zhig ga'i nas 'khor srid/

182 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//gangs seng /'tshe med zhi ba'i las 'gul spel sa'i yul de la byams snying rje can gyi bdag nyid cig dgos pa dang / de ltar ma byung yang ma tha la ngo tsha bka' khrel yod mkhan zhig nges par dgos kyi yod/ ngo tsha khrel gzhung gtan nas med pa'i mi'i mdun du zhi ba'i las 'gul ga 'du zhig spel kyang grub 'bras ci yang thon mi srid/ ma shi bar zas bcad ngo rgol byas kyang de ni rang sdug rang red/spyang tshang mdun du g.yag gis ma shi bar zas bcad byas na de ni kho par dgos rgyu de red/ dred mong mi zan zhig dang thug na bla mas chos bshad dang / dpon pos khrims bshad/ zhi ba'i ngo rgol dang gros sal yong thabs byed pa ni ches blun pa zhig yin la/de las yang na bros thabs dang / yang na ya len zhig bslog thabs byed pa de ni thabs shes yag sgos zhig red/ bya ba gang 'du zhig yin kyang yul dang dus la ltos dgos kyi yod/sangs rgyas kyis kyang sems can rnams zhi bas 'dul ba bzhed kyang / sems can gyi khyad par 'ga' zhig la drag po'i skur bzhengs nas mgo la rdo rje bzhag ste 'dul dgos pa de 'du'ang byung yod/ mdor na/ gang la gang 'dul de la de ston pa/ /zhes pa ltar dgos pa las zhi ba gcig pus ga nas 'grigs/gzigalo chung khag cig la 'jab dmag gi sbyong rdar sprad de gnyis las ma nyung zhing bcu las ma brgal ba byas nas/ bod nang gi rgya mi'i gnas ga'i khag la rgol gtor byas pa yin na gzhis byes gnyis nas rgyab skyor byed nges red/ rgya mi ga tshod mang yang sgrag dgos don med/ dmag 'khrug gi rgyal kha ni thabs jus dang dpal rtsal la rag las pa las mang nyung la rag las med /

la rgyas bskyed pa 'i 'khrul snang gi gros/ mol/ 183bya glab/lhag par bod kyi sa cha ni dbyar dgun gyi khyad par che la/ ri bo'i g.yang gzar dang lu bo'i 〈snag rong mang 'ing / lam phrang snga ga la khag khug mang ba'i sa khul 'ig yin pas dmag 'bor dang / gtor tshabs che ba'i 'bar mdel dang 'phyar mdel sogs kyis 'jigs snang bskul mi thub/ mtshon cha med bsams nas sems khral byed dbo sa ngo na med/ med pa nas yod pa dang / yod pa nas gra rgyas su gtong dgos/ bod pa mi nges sgor re re 'al 'debs phul ba yin na 'ang des lan khru dang me mda' sbag sbag brgya phra ga kha shas snyasna thub//ga /thu/bu la dpa' yod na mtshon la gor mo rdos chog ces bshad srol yod/ rgya dmar gyis kyang dang thog zor ba dang tho ba 'phyar nas drag chas spras pa'i khri dmag brgyad bcu'i kha gtad bcar yod/ rim pas de dag gi mtshon chu na mas kho tho'i lag par slebs pa red/ deng sang rgya mis bod nang phung gsog byed bzhin pa'i go mtshon de dag kyang nam thig kho pa tsho'i mgo la gzhu thub pa byed dgos/ rgyal pham gyi gnad don ni sems thugs dang snying stobs kyi gnad don zhig yin pa las/ mtshon cha dang dpal 'byor gyis thag gcod byed mi thub/ ma gzhi nas snyan grags can gyi skyes bu dam pa ghan dhe lta bu'ang bkrong byed mtshon cha sprad mkhan rag gi sku da na/ btsan 'dzul rgya dmar lta bu mthar spyod gtong bar 'dzam gling rgyal khab mang po 'di'i nang nas rogs ram zhig mi thub pa ga nas srid/shā/ca/ pa/sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du mdo rgyud rnams su mngon spyod kyi rigs mang po zhig gsungs yod la/ na la 'byor pa'i nang gi nyams rtogs la mi ltos par rdzas kho na'i

184 'bras ring chu bo da la 'bab//rten 'brel gyi zhus pa mang po zhig kyang gsungs skusgod/dper na rdzas kyi ril bu 'ga' shas 'chang ba tsam gyis nam mkhar 'a〈sna thub pa dang /'ga' zhig gis mi snang ba 'gyur ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis sa co(ga nas 'gro thub pa dang /'ga' zhig gis chu la mi byings pa dang mes mi 'chig par 'gyur ba sku gas gsungs sku(da/de tsho nges par brtag dpyad dang tshod lta byed dgos pa'i dus la bab yod/ gal te sangs rgyas kyis de ltar gsungs pa la dgos pa yod pa dang mi bslu ba 'ig yin na de la nges par grub 'bras thon nges red / da dung cho ga 'ga' sgos kyis gzhan gyis sbas pa'i gtad rdzas na mas rul du 'jug gi yod/ des na mtshon cha nems gyi khog pa'i rdzas rnams rul du 'jug nas nus pa med par bzo thub thabs byed dgos/'ug pa/bod mi rigs kyi snying nor bla na med pa de ni nang pa'i chos kho na red / bod pa la nang pa'i chos de ma gtogs gzhan bstan ya dang ngom ya ci yang med/ nang pa'i chos de ji srid gnas kyi dbar bod zer ba de gnas rgyu yin pa dang / de med pa'i nyin mor bod zer ba de 'dzam bu gling 'di'i steng nas yal nges red/ des na bu thams cad gra pa dang / bu mo thams cad a ni bzos te bod chos ldan gyi zhi'i khams ming don mtshungs pa 'ig bzo dgos par snyam/pho rogabod kyi snying nor dang mi rigs kyi bla srog ngo ma de ni bod kyi skad yig dang goms srol de dag red/ bod kyi skad yig goms srol de dag brlag pa yin na/ bod de mi rigs sazhan las logs su 'byed pa'i 'byed chos ci yang med pa yin/ nang chos kyi 'byung khungs ni rgya gar yin la de nas thog mar rgya nag tu dar zhing / deng sang e sha ya'i rgyal khab mang po'i nang khyab nas yod pas des bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo bo mtshon mi thub/

la rgyas bskyed pa 'i 'khrul snang gi gros yol/ 185tan tā/a jo pho dog gis gsungs pa de ni bden pa red/ dbang phyug lha na mas las logs su dgar ba la dur khrod kyi dbyug pa dang / zla phyed kyi cod pan/ sprul gyi mchod phyir thog pa sdu gas lha gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos 'ga' zhig 〈snad dgos pa ltar/ bod 'di mi rigs zhig gi ngo bor 'bur du thon pa la mi rigs gzhan la med pa'i skad yig dang goms srol de dag ldan dgos pa yin/ nang pa yin pa'i cha nas sog po dang / rgya nag nyi hong sogs las tha dad pa'i mi rigs zhig yin par bsgrub mi thub/gang yin zer na/de dag la nang pa bod las mang ba yod pa'i rkyen gyis red/ bod kyi skad yig goms srol ji ma ji bzhin ldan pa'i gang zag cig gis/ rang nyid rgya nag dang nyi hong pa sogs yin zhes ji ltar brjod kyang de da ga dang nam yang 'dra thabs med par rang bzhin gyis tha dad par mngon gyi red/de sa na bod kyi skad yig goms srole rnams yar rgyas rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu ni/ rgyal khab gcig dang mi rigs gcig chags 'jig gi 'ga' rtsa la ha cang gal chen po mthong gi 'dugaspro/bka rnga//bod ga'is byes gnyis nas skad yig yar rgyas gtong gi yod pa red/ bod skad gyi glog 'phrin dang / tshags shog dus deb 'dra min mang po zhig yod pa red/ deng sang lo gcig la bod yig thog par sgrun byas pa'i spyi'i sdom 'bor de spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lo brgya phrag kha shas las ldab kyi mang ba 'phar gyi sku da/ des ma chog pa zhig sku da kyi ma red/ ma gzhi nas drag po'i zing 'khrugazhi ba'i gom bgrod/zas bcad ngo rgol/rig gzhung nyams gso zer ba serdzogs srid don gyi las ka de dag ni dka' ngal sprad mkhan zhig dang / na co tsha rog zhig las mi 'dug de las phyi rgyal gyi spyin bdag mang tsam btsal nas dka' las de tsam

186 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//brgyab mi dgos par/ dal dal lhod ltod kyis chos 'dra byed thub na byed de nyal bsdad pa yin na mi tshe don dang ldan pa zhig gyur pa red/mi rgod/bod kyi skad yig yar rgyas gtong zer ba de bod yig gi dpe tshogs mang tsam par skrun byas pa la zer ba ma red/ bod pa'i na gzhon rnams la bod kyi skad yig bslab pa'i go skabs dang mthun 'gyur ji tsam thob kyi yod med dang / bod mi rigs kyi nang bod kyi skad yig la nang byan chud pa'i mi 'bor ji tsam yod med/ bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang bod kyi skad yig bed spyod byed pa'i khyab khongs ji tsam yod med dang / des skad yig gi go gnas ji tsam zhig 'dzin gyi yod med sogs la blta dgos kyi yod pa red/ gal te bod kyi skad yig de bzhin bslab mkhan ne+e nga shes mkhan med la bed spyod gcig kyang med par gyur pa'i nyin mo der/bod yig dpe tshogs ri rab dang mnyam pa zhig par skrun byas kyang de ni don gyis stong pa'i gad snyigs zhig red/co ka/bod kyi tha snyad gcig gyur byed dgos kyi 'dug gzhan yang rgya mis bod la zhin tsang zhes bos nas de'i khongs su 'bri chu yan chad ma gtogs tshud kyi med pa dang / bod kyi sa khul kha shas la ching he dang / kha shas la zhin khams zer ba sku gas ming 'dra min mang po 'ig btags nas yod/ de dag ni chab srid kyi gnad 'ga' zhig tu shes par byas te gdong len byed dgos kyi 'dug

la gyas bskyed pa 'i 'khrul snang gi bo sa sal/ 187'jol/ mo/deng sang gi tha snyad gsar pa 'i rigs kha shas dang / de min sgra sgyar byas rigs bod phyi nang gnyis gcig gyur yong thabs byas na yag po 'dug rtsa ba'i bordo kyi tha snyad de gcig gyur yin pas slar gcig gyur zer ba 'ig dgos don med/ chol kha gsum gyi khyon sku ngas la yig thog nas go bad spyod thub kyi yod pa des bod kyi tha snyad gcig gyur yin pad mtshon yod/ 'on kyang ngag thog na sa phan tshun go brda 'phrod thub kyi med pa ni tha snyad kyi khyad pa ra jig mi na par skad gdangs kyi khyad pa ra 'ig red/ yi ge'i grub gzugs gcig la sgra gdangs tha dad par bklas gi sku da sngabs dka' ngal de byung ba red/ des na yi ge'i grub gzugs gcig la sgra gdangs gcig gyur sku nga thabs byed par gal che ba mchodang /nga ngur/ rgya mis bod la zhin tsang zer ba de chab srid kyi gnad don zhig yin par bsam gyi me da/rtsa ba'i bod la rgya mis ming ga re btags na kho rang tsho'i rang dbang red/ shin tsang zer dus da lnga'i rang skyong ljongs zer ba de gcig pur go 'gro ba ni zhin tsang 'es pa 'i ming des byas pa 'ig ma red/ de ni a mdo dang khams kyi sa khul khag ci ga 'ing chen ga'an du cha bgos byas pa'i rkyen gyis red/ dper na/ gya gar zer dus pakhi si than dang / byungal rji shi gnyis la khyab thub kyi med pa ni rgyal khab de gnyis rgya gar las logs su chad pa 'i rkyen gyis re da/gal te de gnyis rgya gas las 'o/gas su don med na rgya gar zhes pa 'i ming des de gnyis ka la khyab thub pa yin/ de ba'in nam 'ig khams dang a maro'i sa khul de dag da lnga'i gya mis shin tsang zer ba de dang jing chen nam rgyal khab gcig tu blo sgril byung tshe/ rgya mi bo da nga tshos kyang shin tsang zer dus bod sa yo ngas rdzogs la go dgos pa 'ig chags kyi re da de 'i phyir de dag la gnad 'ga' de tsam mi 'dug snyam/

188 'bras ring chu ro/ dal 'bab//mthing ril//chab srid kyis ba〈snas pa'i tha snyad ni rgya mi'i btsan 'dzul 'bo ga pa'i dmag 'khrug dang sgrig 'dzugs byed par gyen 'o/ga dang / gyen langs/ ngo log 'o/ga spyod pa/ de min bod sa gnas srid gzhung zer ba/ bcings grol btang ba zer ba/ krung go'i bod ljongs zer ba sogs la go dgos zhing / ngo log dang gyen log zer ba sogs ni bdag dbang cha tshang yod pa'i sa khul nas don de brtsi med gyis ngo rgol byed pa'i skad cha zhig las/ rang dbang cha tshang yod pa'i rgyal khab gnyis dbar btsan 'dzul dang 'gog 30la ba su la'ang ngo 'o/ga dang gyen 'o/ga gi ming de 'jug gi med/ de da ga ni rtsa ba'i cha nas bod kyi bdag dbang rgya nag la yod mdog zhig gam/ yang na sku da par masngaran thabs kyi gasku/ sgyu 'ig yin par shes dbo sa/ de snga sus kyang ma bcings pa la de las dkrol rgyu zhig med pas bcings gro la zer ba yang bod mi 'bum phrag mang po bsad pa de la ngo so gtong dgos zer ba'i skad cha zhig red/ krung go'i bod ljongs 'es 'brel sgra 'ig btsan sbyar byas kyang sna 'ben na sa kha nang slebs mi thub/ bod rgya rgya bod ces bsdus rte 'bod pa'ad bar gyi 'byed byed ke nga sgra bsdus pa 'ig las 'brel sgra bsdus pa 'ig min pa ni mjug tu gnyis tshig 'byung bas shes dus pa yin/ni tso/sgra sgyur byas rigs lung pa sdud so'i skad gdangs gang yin pa de da bang btsan pa byed dgos/rgya mi'i ming la lha gas pa sgra sgyur dbo sa tshe rgya skad kyi sgra gdangs chadan thabs dgos pa las dbyen skad la bstun rgyu med/legs sbyar lta bu la de'i sgra tshab bod la yod pas de nyid bed spyod chog mod/ de min gyi skad rigs gzhan pa sgra sgyur byed dus mgo 'dogs dang / rtsegs 'phul/yangs 'jug rnams mi dgos pa gtso 'don byed dgos/dper na sgra sgyur ( cang tsi min mi (cang tsa'i min nyi lta bu la 2 lcang rtsi min kyi cakyang phyi min ’ dzu brkyang rtse min mi lcangs brtse dman ’ lta

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros yol/ 189bu 'bri mi rung ba yin/ da dung don sgyur byas par bod nang 'bod bzhin pa (zhing chen mi lta bu btsan byol khrod dzu mnga' sde kyi zhes pa lta bu mi mthun pa mang du skusnad/mnga' sde zhes pa ni mnga' 'bangs sde dud gcig gam rgyal khab de'i mnga' ris su gnas pa'i mi tshang khyim dud gcig yan chad la sgra bshad de 'jug pa yin/ de'i phyir yul 'khor che ge mo zhig gi don du go bar rnam gzhag zur pa zhig la brten dgos pa 'gyur/ zhing chen zer ba de 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i skabs nas rtsis srol byung la/yul/lung pa/1snangs/glid /khams/zhing zhes pa rnams che rim bzhin gnas kyi ming du bod kyi srol rgyun gyi tha snyad cig yin par sems/skrurdogs ga༄rdo g.yagarig gzhung dang tha snyad kyi sgor dmigs bsal gyi bgro gleng tshogs 'du zhig ring min 'tshog 'char yod pas de skabs bshad chog gi red/ de min gyi blo ston jus 'god gang yod lhug po gnang rogs/wa mo/da skabs mi kha shas kyis bod kyi gan sa stangs nyen kha dang dza drag rkyang pa bshad nas mi rnams sems thugs chag bcug gin 'dugades na btsan ༷ la ro da gzhung gis grub 'bras son la nye ba dang / 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'du ba zhig yod pa de mi tshor ngo spyod yag po byed de khong tshor spro sems dang sems shugs 'phar thub pa byed dgos/ de dang chabs cig zhi ba'i gros mol gang mgyogs yong bar 'bad brtson byed dgos kyi 'dugazha ba stag ris/me/da kyang yod mdog bshad de rang yang mgo 'khor/ gzhan yang mgo bsgor nas sgod g.yeng gis las ka spu tsam yang ma byas na sems shugs ri tsam zhig sku da kyang phan mi 〈snag sems

190 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//shugs chag min la ma ltos par sems la dza dug dang dngangs skrag cig byung ba yin na/ de las skyob thabs cig ma byas par sdod tshugs med pa zhig rang bzhin gyis 'byung nges red/zha ba ser chen/grub 'bras sku na la nye dang ma nye de gang la ltos nas bshad pa jig red/ ngas bltas na grub 'bras de hi ma la yi rgyab log la smin dgos kyang de la ni nyin re las nyin re dza dug che ru dang / nyin re las nyin re nyen kha che ba chu gas kyi yod dus/ 'o na grub 'bras de sa phyogs gang zhig la son la nye ba bshad kyi yod dam/ rda ram sa lar son la nye ba zhig yin na de ni yag rtags zhig rtsa ba nyid nas yin gyi ma red/ btsan byol bod gzhung gi dka' las brgyab pa de bod col kha gsum gyi khyon la rang dbang zhig yong ba'i ched du brgyab kyi yod red/ sa ya drug gi mi mang la smra brjod kyi rang dbang gtsos pa'i 'gro ba mi'i thob dbang khag gi gnas stangs de yar rgyas kyi phyogs su skyod kyi yod na/ lha brten mi brten/ me rub chu rub kyis bod gzhung gis dka' las brgyab pa'i grub 'bras zhig thon kyin yod par bshad na 'grig gi nged/ de min 'dzub po 'dzugs sa gcig kyang med par grub 'bras son la nye ba de gang zhig gi grub 'bras son la nye min shes kyi med/sh-i ba ra leb/btsan byol bod gzhung de 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba ci yang ma red/ tha'i wan de yang btsan byol gyi gzhung zhig red/ stobs 'byor gyis rgya dmar po la kha gtad bcar thub kyi yod red/ de phar bzhag ari'i nang gi rgya mi btsan byol ba de dag dang bsdur na'ang dpal 'byor dang shes yon gang ci'i cha nas kho tsho sngon la slebs yod/ a ri'i nang gi rgya mi'i tshong pa gcig gi ma rtsa la a sgor bye ba kha shas yod mod/ bod gzhung gi lo 'khor 'char rtsis sogs su nyin sgor sa ya lnga bcu drug cu'i skad cha bshad bsdad kyi yod red/

la rgyus bskyed pa 'i 'khrul snang gi gros sol/ 191'phar ba/'dra 'du'i nang nas mi 'dra ba yin dgos byung / deng sang yo rob khul nas abin niya'i rigs gros byol du 'gro mkhan na mas dang / 'bar ma'i nang nas thayin du btsan byol 'gro mkhan rnams la ga 'dra'i myangs kyi 'dug za gyon gyi dka' ngal dang / tsha ba dang 'bu yis sku brgyab pa sogs las nad gzhi 'du min gyis gnar bzhin 'dam nyog khrod lce sdod gur kyang med par gnas skusnad/ 〈snad pa'i btsan 〈snal ba na mas yul mi rgya gar las rdzog pa lta bu bsdad rgyu yod pa 'di 'du 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba zhig min na gang yin/ra rbod/sku 'bas 'phar bas bshad pa ltar na 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra zhes pa'i 'du bsdur sa de dag ni btsan byol gyi gnas sdings skyo ba'i gras de tsho rang red 'dug de yang dus skabs dang 'pho 'gyur gyi 'brel ba de yag po 'ig lta ma shes pa'i skyon cha che na po thig 'dug khyod kyis bshad pa de dag ni btsan byol thog ma'i skabs kyi gnas stangs jig red/ bod pa 'i btsan byol na mas la'ang dang 〈snag ma myangs ba 'ig rtsa nas ma red/ dang ngo lam kha'i nas rgya mis rjes 'ded kyis ga tshod bsad yod/ ga yang la zag nas ga tshod zhi yod/ chu la ga tshod mchong sku da/ gangs khug la ga tshod thebs skusnad/ rgya bal sku gas su slebs nas kyang lam bzo dang 'jab dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs skabs na mas su dka' ngal ga tshod 'phrad yod/ de da ga ni nam yang rjed thabs med pa'i don da ngos kyi lo rgyus dran gso gtong 'os pa thig red/ de nas mi lus len skal yod na rtsam pa bza' skal yod 'gro zer ba ltar 'gro ba mi 'ig gi rnam nasad ldan yod du sa rim pas yar rgyas 'gro ba ni 'jig rten gyi chos nyid dang 'dzam gling gi 'gyur 'gros zhig regar+sha

192 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//rtsib nyag pyi bo ra rgod kyis bshad pa de ni bden pa red/ da dung ngas dpe mtshon ga'an zhig bshad na/bcom lngan 'das kyis/ khyim pa na mas sen mo'i tshod tsam la sdud nam byed dbesnas par gyur kyang da 'i rab tu byung ba na mas la 'tsho bas phongs nga/ mi 'byung / 'es gsungs yod yod/btsan byol thog ma'i skabs dge 'dun pa na mas sbag sa bzhugs ring nyin re'i 'tsho ba gtor skam ril bu re tsam las med cing / tha na 'thung chu yang yag po zhig rag gi med/da dung tsha ba che 'ing 'bu srin sna tshogs kyis so brgyab nas dka' d+ku la ga tshod 'phrad yod/de 'du'i rkyen pas sems gnal du ma gnas nas spyod mkhan de ga tshod byung sku da/ rang shi rgyag mkhan ga tshod ga tshod byung yod/ de dag gi tho gzhung lta bu 'phrod bsten nam chos rig sogs su yod shas che/ min na sbag sa'i bla rgan na mas la sdus dang bshad nges red/ zas kham gang sku da na phul sa dang mchod sa de dge 'dun pa na mas byed bsdad kyi sku da na khong rnam pa la dka' ngal de tsam zhig 'phrad dus/ de min gyi skye bo ro/ mo rnams la ni bshad ma dgos pa zhig red/ de nas rim pas yar rgyas 'gro ba ni deng dus kyi 'dzam gling 'di'i nang bshad rin 'os pa ci yang ma red/spro/ ngasajur /dpal 'byor dang shes sku na gyi cha nas 'du 'dra'i gi nga nas mi 'du ba zhig sdin zhes bshad kyi yod ma red/ gang bshad kyi yod red ce na/ bod don de 'dzam bu gling gis do snang dang lhag pa ra nub lcogs pas rgyab skyor shugs chen po 'ig thob kyin yod pa sa bshad kyi yod red/'dzam bya gling 'di'i sgang la btsan byol ba mang po thig yod red de/ bod pa'i btsan byol ba nang ba'in rgyab skyor thob kyi yod ma red/ rgyab skyor de yang nyin re las nyin re che cher 'gro ba'id yod pa red/byas tsang 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'du ba jig yin 'es bshad kyi yod/

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros mol/ 193ni li/gang ltad nub phyogs pas rgyab skyor yod med la ma ltos par bod don 'thab rtsod kyi lo ngo bzhi cu'i ring / 'dzam gling shar nub gang sar nas rgyal khab mang po zhig rang btsan thob zin pa red/ de min yo rob nang gi nosipho zhing chen lta bu mtshon na/ a min niya'i mi rigs rang btsan don gnyer ba tshor drag mnon gyis nyin re mi ser bcu grangs kha shas la srodag skyon 'byung gi skusgod/de skabs a ris gtsos pa'i rgyal khab mang po'i 'thus tshab sa gnas de ga rang du phebs nas don de mtshams 'jogs ma byas tshe mjug 'bras ngan pa yong rgyu'i sdig ra bskul yod la/ dngos su mkhar dmag gis rgol gtor bya rgyu'i gra sgrig kyang byas yod /'on kyang bod nang mtshon cha spu tsam med pa'i zhi ba'i ngo rgol ba brgya phrag mang po dmar bsad btang ba dang / 'ju bzung btson 'jug gis mi spyod las 'das pa'i sdug spyong gtong bzhin yod kyang / de skabs sa gnas der rgyal spyi'i mi sna cig kyang ched phebs mdzad med la de ltar phebs dgos pa jig sus kyang bzo thub med/ rgya nag gis rang gi mi rigs dmangs gtso don gnyer ba'i slob phrug tshor dug gnon byas par a ris nas tshong 'brel bkag sdom byas yod/ 'on kyang mi rigs dang skad rigs sogs gang ci tha dad cing /dmangs gtso dang / rang dbang / 'i bde bcas don du gnyer ba'i bod mi de tsam 'ig dmar gsod btang yang / de la a ri srid gzhung nas dpe zhag dmar po cig kyang bkag sdom byas sku da pa ma red/'o le/cung po ni les bshad pa de ltar red/ rgyab skyor byed kyi yod med de lag len gyi steng nas blta dgos pa las kha bde mo sus kyang bshad shes kyi red/ lo rabs 'di'i nang du'ang a ris mi rgyu gnyis ka spyad de khuliri nas dbyi rag mthar skyod kyis rang btsan bskyar gso

194 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//byas skusnad pa dang /rgya dmar gyis the wan mtsho 'gag du 'jigs skul byed skabs/the wad la rgyab skyor byed par a ri'i mtsho dmag gi dpung sde khag zhi bde'i rgya mtsho'i nang dngos su 'byor gyi yod/ 'on kyang bod don skor tshig rtsub gcig bshad kyang rgya mi khong khro langs nas grub 'bras thon gyi med sgor bshad bzhin pa de gzhan dang ma 'dra ba'i rgyab skyor thob pa zer ba de yin na las/ de min a ris rgyab skyor byas nas bag chags bzhag sku da pa zhig mthong gi mi 'dugabya khyung /a ris sngar bod la gyab skyor ma byas pa min par deng sang byed thabs med nas bsdad pa zhig yin gyi red/ gal rte dug po'i thabs lam zhig srel ba yin na a ri nas rgyab skyor shugs chen po 'thob kyi red/ gang yin zer na/ dug pa'i 'thab rtsod la da gos pa'i mtshon cha dang de min gyi 'gro song khag kyang nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa lta bu mkho spyod byed thub nges red/ gal rte zhi ba'i thabs lam cig pur phyin pa yin na a ris nas bsngags brjod 'dra byed khyal las ci yang byed thabs med pa yin/gang yin zer na/'tshe med zhi ba la dbo sa pa'i byams pa dang snying rje'i bsam blo gnyis po de a ris nas 'don sprod byed thub kyi med pa'i rkyen gyis red/ 'das pa'i cha la mtshon na/ nor we sogs rgyal khab mang po jar min dbang 'og tu bcug skabs dang / sham po ṭi yar we nam gyis dbang sgyur srid gzhung 'dzugs skabs sogs dang bsdur na 'dra 'du'i nang nas mi 'dra ba zhig yin min shes pa yod/gung /nga tshos bshad pa de ni btsan byol gzhung gis bshad pa'i grub 'bras dang / a ri la re ba'i bod do na 'thab rtsod kyi nang ma byung ba'i stong cha zha mas gsed dkrol gyis thabs shes gsar pa jig dang / snying stobs gsar pa zhig lam kha gsar pa 'ig 'thob pa'i ched du bshad pa

la gya sa bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi 〈snas yol/ 195zhig yin 31da/ na ga 3snag tsag 'gel che drags na mi khag cig nas ma byas byas masnga gam 'asdudan 'jo na mngo ga gasku sgyu rdzun gsum gyis brgyangs pa'i che tshugs dang snyan grags kyi lgang bu de ral bar 〈snags te/ de ltar smra mkhan de ni rgya dmar nag gi 〈snags gcetshegs pa/bod gzhung la cos 'o/ga rgyag mkhan/ khyad gaskusnad byed mkhan/ mtshan smad zhu mkhan/ dkrug shing rgyag mkhan 31gas nyes ming sna therdogs shig 'ge'/ rgyu yin pa las/ bsam 'char 'a/sa gros sdur dang / skyon brjod las sku bsrang byed mkhan zhig ha lam med/ de'i phyir kha che pa lus/ /nar nar lce la bdag po ma bgya ba na/ /ril ril dbu la 'o brgyal bzo sku nga ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi don de nyams su blangs na dge mtshan mi che 'am/rbe/rang la 'o brgyal yong dogs kyis spyi skyon yo bsrang yong bar bsam tshul ma ston na de ni lhag bsam lpu tsam yang ched pa ra spyi'i 'thus thor las da nga gi 'o brgyal gal che ba rtsis pa 'ig re da/ btsan byol bod gzhung 'di ba'ig kun gyi phu la zhig min pa bden pa yin mod thams cad kyi tha shal 'ig min pa de'ang bden pa jig red/ rang yul bsgyur nas bros byol du yong yang slar rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs gyi don du 'thab rtsod byed pa 'i sgrig 'dzugs shig gi ngo bor gnas yod pa de ni gzi brjid red/ da lnga'i dus tshod 'di ni rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi don du phu la lce byung ba'i byas rjes 'jog 'dod yod mkhan rnams la ha cang gal 'gangs che ba'i dus tshod cig red / de'i pyi ra gang zag sger ngos nas kyang bod do gi gyi 'thab rtsod nang zhusas te brgya tham pa 'i gral mgo la ma slebs kya'i stong tham pa'i gral mjug la ma lus pa 'ig byed ghu de yang ha cang gi gal chen po thig red snam/ mdo don rgyal khab dang mi risas kyi don du rang gi na ma ༄1da kyi blo phros kyang ston dgos la rang gis thub tshod dang 'os tshod kyi 'bas 'degs kyang zhu dgos/ thob thang khag kyang len dbo sa la las 'gan khag kyang bsgrub dgos pa las g.yag 'ad gyis rtsa za ba ltar byed rgyu med/

196 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab// sturdogs gatherdo g.yagakhyod tshos bshad pa de ni brtse ba'i ma yis bu la stsal ba'i kha ta nang ba'in yin kyang / nad drag pa'i sman la kha tig cig ma gto gas med pa yin dus de ni nad pa bsam med 'ga' yis srog gcod kyi dug lta bu zhig rtsis kyi yod red/ de yang nyung nyung jig min par bod mi'i spyi tshogs nang gi mi mang che ba'i sems la 'phrod kyi sku da pa ma red/ gang yin zer na/khong tsho ni de snga chab srid kyi lag len khrod du myong goms thob pa'i lam kha med cing rmongs dad dang chos lugs kyi bag chags 'thug pas/ bod kyi gnas stangs yar rgyas gtong bar bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam 'don pa nang bzhin dgos par bsams kyi sku da pa red/da ni skabs su babs pa nge da rgya zhi ba'i 〈snas mosnal zer ba de la na ma pa come bsam tshul ga 'du 'ig yod dam/de gal chen po zhig chags bsngad kyi yod red/tse( dkar/gong du a pho dom khras bshad pa ltar za 'dod che ba'i mi ser srel mkhan gyi rgyal khab dang mi ser srel yul gyi rgyal khab gnyis bar zhi ba'i gros sal byed par khe sang su la 'thob pa ni 'o rgyus kyi thog nas thag gathe da byed thub/ me mda' brang la tshad mkhan zhig la 'i ba'i gros mol byed pa ni ñtsa thug las kyi tha ma de red/ gang ltar 'i ba'i gros sal zer ba des po tshod sgor ba lta bya 'ig chags song snyam/dzo// gya dmar bod la thog ma'i btsan 'dzul skabs kyang kha nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang 'i ba'i gros mol zer ba de 'bod bsngad kyi yod red/yin na'ang bshad ba'in bshad bzhin lag pa sa me mda' rgyug mtshams bzhag med/ gal te sems kyi gting nas 〈snas mo la

la gya sa bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros mol/ 197byed 'dod sku da na de la thag gcod cig ma byung dbar me mda' rgyag mtshams 'jog dgos pa yin/ 'o na des ga re mtshon gyi yod zer na/ zhi ba'i gros mol zer ba de kha'i gasku sgya zhig dang / me 'phen mtshams 'jog ma byas pa des don gdeng ma bo da de drag shugs༄ kho nas len 'dod yod pa de mtshon pa yin/ de bzhin da lta'i bod nang 7gong sa mchos ga la mtshan smad tshabs cher zhu ba'i las 'a gul mtshams 'a11ga ma byas par mu mthud spel gyin sku da pa des/ sems kyi gting nas 7bosnang sa mcho ga dang grub 'bras thon pa'i zhi ba'i gros yol zhig byed 'dod med pa gsal po chags yod/ de'i phyir zhi ba'i grerdzos mol las bod gsar 'dzugs sgrun byed 'dod pa ni rla ba grags pa'i rnam thar bskyangs pa zhig rang red/phu ngon/byu mi kho rang tsho la zhi ba'i gros mol byed 'dod yod pa ma red/ kho rang tsho gros mol byed mkhan ma ru ga nas bsngad sku1da pa ma red/ khosgro rang tsho la mi mang 〈snan las med pas btsan byol ba na mas phar log rogs dgos kyi yod pa ma red/ 'o na kho tshos kyang gros mol sgo phye nas yod ces bshad pa der gang zhig dgos kyi yod pa red ce na/ de la brten nas khong tshor rgyal spyi'i ngos nas kha dung 'gog thabs dang / bod don gyi 'thab rtsod de dus tshod kyi steng nas pham nyen 'gro thabs kyi gasku sgya 'khrab kyi yod pa red/ gal te khong tshor phan thog yod pa 'ig mthong ste sem sa kyi gting snas gros mol byed 'dod yod pa zhig yin na/ zhag po bdun gyi nang gros mol 'go 'dzugs thub kyi red/mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yang ldan yod pa ma red/ mdor na/ zhi ba'i gros mol zer ba de ni khe se dgal 'gul gyis a nyog mgo stor gtong zer ba de rang red/

198 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//'ang dkar/btsan byol gzhung phyogs nas rgya nag srid gzhung de bzhin bzang phyogs su 'gro gi skusnad pa dang / srid 'dzin cang ni ha lam dmangs gtso'i dasakhrid cig yin pa sogs bshad bzhin pa de ni tshabs ches nor 'khrul zhig red/ rgya nag de bzhin rgyal spyi'i thog zhi bde dang drang bden gyi rgyal khab cig tu mi mthong dang cha 'jog yong thabs byed kyin yod pas/rgya nag la dgos pa'i skad cha ni de ga rang yin gyi red/ gzhan pa zhig gis ba〈snad pa brgya brgyab pa las btsan byol bod mis tshigardzogacig gis bstod pa de rgya nag la phan thog che ba chags kyi yod/des na gros mol byed mdog byas pa tsam gyis rgya nag la khe sang zhig thob thub kyi yod pa red/phya shud/rgya mis bod nang 'gro ba mi'i thob thang khag brtsi med dog rol gtong bzhin yod ces bshad nas/ srid 'dzin cang dang de'i srid gzhung ni bod thog na ma 'gyur yag tu dang bzang du 'gro ba bshad na/ 'o na bod nang de ltar brtsi med rdog rol gtong mkhan su yin nam/ mi rigs dang rig gzhung rtsa brlag dang / bod yul rgya yul du bsgyur bzhin pa de sus byas pa yin nam/ bod du yod pa'i bod pa tshos byas pa red zer ba yin nam/ skad cha de su la go dgos sam/sus bdag po rgyag dgos sam/de dag ni gad mo thor ba'i skad cha zhig red/'o byis/rgya mis bya ngan spyod ngan gang zhig byas kyang de ni srid 'dzin tsang dang de'i srid gzhung la 'dzub mo btsugs nas bsgod dgos/ srid 'dzin kho rang bi ming shas su 'gyur ga'i zhig chags pa yin na nges par bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa zhig chags kyi red/ de min su la'ang 'dzub mo 'dzugs sa zhig mi brnyed la brnyed kyang don de bcos sgyur dang thag gcod thub pa'i dbang tshad dang zhus pa ci yang med nges red/ srid 'dzin cang dang de'i srid

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros mol/ 199gzhung ni bzang phyogs su 'gro bzhin yod par bshad de/ phyogs gcig nas rgya mis bod nang nyin re las nyin re gdug rtsub che ru gtong bzhin yod ces ga tshad bshad na'ang /de ni rgya nag srid gzhung dang lhag par srid 'dzin cang gis jus gto gas dang bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa zhig chags kyi med/ de'i phyir srid 'dzin cang dang de'i srid gzhung gnyis rgyal spyi'i bod don 'thab rtsod kyi nang gab g.yodal byed sa'i lam kha 'ig phar sprad don med par snyam/ba/ngatra/ byis//nga tshos bod gya gnyis phan zer gyi yod red de rgya phyogs nas blta dus rgya nag rang la gyong 'ig med par bod la khe sang rdo da yas kyi lam kha zhig ma〈snang gi skusnad pa ma red/ lhag par bod don gyi dka' rnyog de 'phra la sel ma byas tshe rnyog du che ru 'gro rgyu yin par mthong na'ang / mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta ba'i 'og 'tshar 'o/nga byung ba'i skye bo phal pa thig yin phyin rang nyid srid 'dzin las thog tshe nor bu phyir sgor gyi ming chad cig las g.yol thabs byed mi srid pa ga nas yin/ de'i phyir sgo phye yod ces ga tshod bshad kyang don la sgo nang 'dzul thabs gtan nas med pa'i nyo na 'botsware chu rkyen zhig 〈snan nas nyi ma 'a〈snal thabs byed kyi yod red/tsher byis/rgya nag la bod kyi mi rigs 'di dgos kyi yod pa ma red/ chos lugs 'di dgos kyi yod pa ma nged/ rig gzhung dgos kyi yod pa ma red/ skad yig goms srol gang yang dgos kyi yod pa ma red/ 'o na ga re dgos kyi yod pa red ce na/ bod cho la kha gsum gyi sa cha de dgos kyi yod pa red/ bod kyi sa cha'i steng rgya nag gis bed spyod rdzogs pa yin na bod rang btsan be nga rang skye ngas la khyad pa ra med par bsams bsdad kyi sku da red/ nga tsho la'ang rang

200 'bras/ ring chu bo dal 'bab//btsan dang rang skyongs gang ltar yang bod chol kha gsum gyi sa cha 'di dgos kyi yod pa red/chos lugs dang rigs gzhung sku gas ni mi rigs zhig la brten nas sku/da la/ mi rigs de'ang rang nyid 'tshar long byung bar rkang pa 'dzugs sa'i sa cha zhig nges par dgos kyi yod pa re da/glang byis/a/ jo tsher byis kyis bshad pa de ni bden pa bden rkyang red/srog chags shig yin phyin dgos gal che sgos de ni rang nyid 'tsho gnas byed sa'i sa cha zhig dgos kyi yod pa de red/ pu ron lta bu ni 'i bde mtshon byed cig tu rtsis kyang rang rang gnas sa'i ched nang khul rtag par 'dzing re sa sgor gyin sku da/ 'bu srin grog ma na mas kyang da nga nyid gnas sa'i sa khul nges can 'ig 'dems kyi yod la de'i ched grog tshogs phan tshun g.yul 'khrug gyun mar byed pa mthong rgyu yod/ mala'i sheng5ra srul pas da mag chen bakhya ba pa'ang sa cha'i ched yin pa ra tshan rig pa tshos bshad yod sa ni 'gro ba kun gyi rten yin te/ /gsu'i sa pa ba'in chus lugs/ rig gzhung /chab srid/ dpal 'byor sogs thams cad med na mi 'byung ba'i brten sa'i gtso bo ni sa cha de nged/ dper na/ bya zhing la brten kyang shing sa la brten dgos kyi sku da pa sa mthar gtugs na bya yang sa la brten dgos kyi yod pa ni rig pa'i gzhung lugs zhig red/skyar 31/bod re bas phung zer ba ni bden nges can zhig nged/ 'i ba'i gras mol la re ba brgyab nas dus tshod de tsam phyin pa red/ da lce nga re 'bras ga dus son rgyu yin min sus shes/ ma 'ongs pa ni ma 'ongs pa rang red ma gtogs ma 'ongs pa de de ring red zer ba'i nyin mo 'ig ga dus yang tshes rgyu med/ bod nang gi skad yig rig gzhung tha na goms gzhis tshun chad skad cig skang cig gis nyams ① ga 'aX bzhin sku1da pa las ma tshe(ngas pa thig bsgug gi med/

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros sol/ 201des na zla ba drug gam yang na lo gcig gi dus stod bzos nas de'i nang tshud gros mol thub pa dgos rgyu las/ de min thabs lam gzhan pa zhig nang 'dza rgyu'i nyen brda gtong dgos la sems thag gtsang bcad byed dgos/ gal srid zhi gros byed 'dod yod tshe dus tshod de 'i nang mi thub pa 'i dka' ngal ci yang med nges yin/ da dung ma 'ongs pa zhig bshad pa yin na de ni 'i gros byed 'dod med pa gsal po yin pas u tshug brgyab pa ni dgra bo'i g.yo sgyu lam du stong ba zhig rang red/shug shag7gong sa mchog dang rgya nag dbar ngo 'phrad kyis bod don gros mol tsam yong srid kyang grub 'bras thon pa jig sa dus kyang phar phyogs nas byed 'dod yod pa ma red/ nam jig srid mtha' tsam du bod la khe phan yod pa'i 'i gros thig thub pa byung ba yin na/de ni de skabs kyi don rkyen gang jig las gya mir bsam blo gsar pa 'ig skyes pa red ma gtogs da lta'i gya mi 'i dbar 'dzin pa rnams la bsam blo de 'du 'ig rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/'khu yong /grel sri be gya mi dang 'i ba'i gros mol gyis chings yig 'du jig ba'ag thub pa'i dbang du btang ya'i de la su yid ches kyi re da dam/ spyir rgyal khab gnyis dbar chings yig bzhag pa ni phyogs gnyis mas mos mthun skusnad pa 'ig gi thog na sa 'jog dgos pa yin/ gnyis shas rmo/se mthun skusnad na chings yig bzhag min la ma 〈snas par 'gal rkyen de 'dra 'phrad don med/ rang la khe phan yal ba'i nyin mo nas chings don brtsi 'jog byed mkhan gyi rgyal khab su yang byung myong med pa lo rgyus kyi thog nas ra spyod gsal po byed thub/ lhag par rgya nag ni rang gis btsan dbang gis ba'ag bcug pa'i chings ro na kyang lag len mi bstar mkhan zhig yin pa shes gsal red/ ma gzhi su 'du zhig yin kyang kha nas bshad pa dang

202 'bras ring lu bo dal 'bab//lag len bstar phyogs gnyis kyi nang nas gang zag rang gi dgongs pa ngo ma de lag len gyi steng la babs kyi yod red/ de'i nang nas rgya mi'i bsam phyogs ngo ma gang yin de lag len bstar 〈snags kyi steng la blta ba las kha nas bshad pa la cung zad kyang blta rgyu med par nga tshor myong bas grub pa de red/(graḥri /graḥr bya/be| 9thu/de dag ni gal che ba'i rtsa don zhe cig yin kyang ma 'ongs pa'i bya ga'ag cig yin pas tshod dpag byed rgyu tsam las ma 'das/ de las ma tshe(ngas pa zhig sgug sdod mi dgos pa kha sku da lag yod kyi phan thog sku da la lag len kyang 'grel thub pa'i gnas sngangs khag cig skusnad pa ste/ gzhung gi 'go byed nang nye dga' phyogs lhung dang / rtsog za rul sung / mgo bde dun 'phrul sogs tshul min gyi bya spyod gtsang sel gyis btsan byol srid gzhung de ba'in kun gyis yid ches da nga brtsi 'jog thub pa'i gzhung zhig yong thabs bya rgyu dang / da yod bod phrug slob gra khag gis bod dbyin zung 'brel gyis gtso bo chab srid dang / rig gnas sgyu rtsal/tshan rig lag rtsal sogs kyi slob sbyong sprod par sgo kun nas thugs ston rgyag rgyu dang / bod don khyab bsgrags byed pa'i gsar lam khag ste/ gzhung gi langs phyogs dang las don mi mang la gsal 〈snan thub pa'i gzhung 'brel tshags 〈snag khag dang / gzhung gi las sngasan khag gi nang skyon yon ther 'don byed par mi mang gi bsam tshul mtshon pa 'i rang dbang can gyi gsar gnas khag srung skyob bya rgyu dang / las med bod mi mang po las 'tshol phyi ra skyod mi dgos par lag shes bzo las kyi snge tshan mang tsam sku nga thabs dang / de dag kyang khe phan dang yong 'bab lngan pa zhig yong thabs bya rgyu de tsho gal che po red shag

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros sol/ 233shing rta mo/ma 'ongs bod mi'i spyi tshogs de bzhin dmangs gcu'i sbyi tshogs zhig tu 'gyur thabs byed dgos na/ long ba 'dren byed kyi dmigs bu dang / zhar bo 'dren byed kyi zhing rta lta bu gsar 'god khag gi smra brjod kyi rang dbang khag srung skyob thub thabs byed rgyu de gal che po chags yod/ lhag par rgyal khab phyi nang gi gsar 'gyur brjod bya sna mang phun sum tshogs shing bod phyi nang gnyis su khyab thub pa/ nyan mkhan rnams la shes bya na ma mang 〈snag rgya che ba'i bo| rig ster ba'i a ri'i bod skad rlung 'phrin dang e sha ya'i rlung 'phrin lta bus ni gang ci nus shugs chen po zhig thon gyi yod/ 'on kyang ches pangs pa zhig la da dung bod nang gi lung pa khug kyog de 'dra'i nang rlung 'phrin de dag brnyed tshor nyan shes thub kyi med/ des na rlung 'phri na de dag nyan shes kyis sa khul de dag chab srid kyi blo mig lngan pa'i yul gru zhig tu 'gyur thabs byed dgos kyi 'dugadom ser/smra brjod kyi rang dbang sogs 'gro ba mi'i thob thang khag gal chen yin pa smos med nged/'on kyang ma 'ongs bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed dgos na rgya mis bod nang gi bod pa 'e ma/sa la ni mo ṭa'i 'khor lo rje mo rgyag rgyu las lhag pa 'i lag shes ci yang bslab med pas/ btsan byol khrod nas bod phrug blo no ba khag cig 'dems sgrug gis mthun phyogs rgyal khab gang sar 'bod skul gyis deng lce sa kyi mtshon cha dang dam phe 'u ṭa sogs tshad mtho'i las rtsal khag bong du chud thabs byed gyu de yang gal che na po jig yin pa bsams/ bsngad kyi 'dus

204 'bras ring chu bo dal 'bab//sprin rna ka ra/deng sang chab srid kyi kha phyogs du ma can du gyur pa'i skabs 'dir gtso bo rgyal spyi'i thog bod don khyab bsgrags byed rgyu tsam zhig las brgal te dmigs yul gang zhig gi ched las 'gul ci zhig spel ba 'gal rkyen 'phrad kyi yod pa red/ des na bod don dril bsgrags byed par dang po nas chab srid cig bshad bsdad dgos pa zhig min par rgyal spyi'i thog mthong snang bde ba'i lus rtsal 'gran sdur dang / glog brnyan 'khrab mkhan dang / bi'i sa'i gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan lta bu dang / gyan bo1sa khyab bsgrags nang gi ga31ba tshab pa lta bu dang / tha na 'chal po 'chal mo na mas kyi khrod du 'gro rgyugs che ba'i sgyu rtsal brnyan par sogs kyi nang nas kyang bod don la do snang dang tshor snang gsar pa de 'dra sprad thub pa yin/lhag par bod rgya da mag 'thab kyis mtshon lo rgyus gal che khag na mas 'du ris dbyin bod mchan ldan gyi brnyan deb mang tsam bgasnas nas rgyal spyi'i 〈snag 'grems thub thabs byas pa yin na/de ni bod don dri la bsgrags byed par phan rlabs che sgos chags nges red//'erdogs gatherdo g.yagad nges 'di tshogs shes lngan mang che bas rang gi bsam tshul thad shar gsungs gan nga ba thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/'on kyang da dung phyogs mang po zhig gi gnas tshul lhag yod pa dang /phan thog yod med la ma ltos par mtha' sdom gros chod cig kyang 'a jog thub med pa ni rgyu mtshan med pa zhig gtan na sa min/ gang ltar de ring gnam gzhis kyis rkyen pas phyi 'o'i dpyid kyi drod rlung phran bu 'ig ma lngang dbar dus tshod nges med du bar mtshams ba'ag pa yin / tshang ma la bkra zhis bde legs zhu ba dang chabs cig sngon bsags las kyi bdag 'bras bod gad sa can gyi ljongs su 'phos pa'i rkang gnyis mi dang 'dab chags/ rkang bzhi phyugs dang gcan gzan/ ka ra mang 'bu dang sdig srin sogs tshang ma rang dbang bag phebs

la rgyas bskyed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gros mol/ 205ngang chos 'byor bde dge'i dpal la longs spyod rgyu yong ba'i smon 'dun kyang yang yang zhu rgyu yin/ chag chag hrag hrag phag phag 11ga chags de dag gis dga' bsu'i thal mo yun ring da ba bzhin pa'i mur nga ni rang gi nyal sa'i nang nyal yod pa dang / rtsed mo'i rigs la do dbyings 'phar ba'i grogs po shes rab nas 'ogs pa snga po langs te ma〈snan khang nang gi glog brnyan gyi sgrom kha phyes nas yod pa de'i nang / thalen du ya gling gi rtsed 'gran skabs rgya gar la gser gyi rtags ma 〈snab par ltad mo ba sku1ngas nas dga' bsu'i lag pa rdab bzhin 'duga'adir smras pa/nam mkha'i dbyings su rgod po dar ma'i tshogs//cir dgar 'phyar lding byed dus rang dbang dran//gtsang chab gting du 'gyur cam nya mo'i tshogs//rang dgar 'khyug 'gros byed du rang dbang dun//rngams/ gnag smag gis btum pa'i ma35na 31 'i/sa//zhogs pa'i nyi 'od 'phro dus rang dbang dun//dgun gsum grang bas bdungs ba'i ljon zhing las// dbyed ma'i me tog 'bud dus rang da bang dran//rgyal spyi'i tshogs che na 'tshogs dus rang dbang dran//'dzam gling lus rtsal 'gran dus rang dbang dran//'gro sdod lag 'khyer zhu dus rang dbang dun//phyi'i mis brnyas bcos byed lce sa rang dbang dun//

206 'byas ring lu bo dal 'bab//nyin mtshan kun du rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal//rtse gcig bsam gtan byed pa'i na la 'byor des//rmi lam zhing khams nyul ba'i mthong thos dngos//brjid med ting 'dzin pir gyis yi ger bkod//ma shes log bshad nyes ba'i cha mchis na//ma rig gnyid lam 'khrul ba'i ngang du bshags//legs bshad don ldan gtam gyi dge mchis na//gzur gnas dasad lngan tshogs na mas dgyes phyir 'bul//'brel gtam 'di 'dra kun nas slong byed lhag bsam na ma par dag pa'i stobs//sngon gshegs dpa' bo khri phrag mang po'i bla tshe sgog gsum 'khun pa'i stobs//da yod pho rgod 'bum drag mang po'i snying stobs dpa' rtsal gsar pa'i stobs//rtsa ba'i bod rgya rgyal khab tha dad bsu ba med lo rgyus bden pa'i stobs//stobs ba'i'i rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi zegs mas rang dbang gtsang ma'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs//phun tshogs sde bzhi'i char rgyun bzang pos bsil ldan ra ba'i 'khor yug brlan//phas rgol dpa' kong stobs shugs drag rtsal gnam lcags thog gi gzi 'od 'khyug/gling bzhi bsgul ba'i grags snan 'brug sgra srid 'dir nyams med sgrog gyur cig/170ji

mtho zhes pa dang /1760'o1ra ( gangs ri'i zhol gyi brda ྅sgod pa'i gzhung rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel 〈snan mi bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs mi zhes pa'i deb gnyis 'bras blo gling par khang du par skrun gnang /2༷༷༷ lor dus rabs 'di'i dkyil sked tsam du mdo khams chu bzhi sgang drug gis rgya dmar gyi btsan 'dzul la 'be|ga rbestol byas pa'i da11sa byung zha khrag gi lo rgyus gson po thu chu sgang lo rgyus deb phreng dang po nya mtha' ma'i rtsom sgrig gi rkang 'gan khur zhing / de'i zhor du dpyad rtsom dang sgrung rtsom sogs bsdus pa'i deb dzu seng ge dkar mo'i gad rgyangs zi zhes pa zhig kyang par skrun thub pa byung 'dug1000'o1ra bal yul bod kyi khor yug sgor gyi rtsom rig 'gran bsdur nang ang dang gi gzengs rtags thob cing / ched rtsom de bzhin lo de'i dus deb na gzugs brnyan me 'o1nga nyi zhes par bkod thon byung /btsan byol du 'byor nas bzung da bar smyo dmangs gtso zi dang / dzu gnyan chen thang lha ri drang bden sa tsa mtho sgang gi rgyab mdun ri sdu gas tshags par dang dus deb ci rigs nang dbyad rtsom dang / snyan tshigasgrung rtsom sdusags mang dag cig brtsams spel gnang 'dug pa bcas so//1580 81—86227—27 tsho
